tools.name: open-browser-tab
tools.description: Opens a new tab for the current user and begins loading the provided URL, returning the created tab’s metadata (including its tabId and initial status/state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing/invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to create tabs for this user/session, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the user has reached the maximum allowed open tabs or tab-creation rate. Raises CONFLICT if a new tab cannot be created because the browser session is not in a state that accepts new tabs (for example, shutting down).

tools.name: close-browser-tabs
tools.description: Closes the specified tabs owned by the current user and returns the set of tabs that were successfully transitioned to closing/closed along with any per-tab failures. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tabIds is empty or contains non-numeric/duplicate IDs, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if any referenced tab is not accessible to the caller, and NOT_FOUND if any tabId does not exist for the user. Raises CONFLICT when a tab cannot be closed because it is already closed or is in a non-closeable transition state.

tools.name: get-list-of-open-tabs
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of the user’s tabs matching the provided filters (windowId, activeOnly, includeClosed) and sorted by sortBy/sortOrder; the response includes up to limit items and an opaque cursor for fetching the next page (omit cursor to start from the first page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination or sort parameters (including limit outside 1–500 or an unrecognized cursor), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the user’s browser session. Raises NOT_FOUND if windowId is provided but no such window exists for the user.

windowId.description: If provided, only return tabs from this browser window.

activeOnly.description: If true, only return the currently active tab(s).

includeClosed.description: If true, include tabs whose status is "closed" (otherwise only "open"/"closing").

limit.description: Maximum number of tabs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sortBy.description: Field to sort returned tabs by.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction for the returned tabs.

tools.name: get-recent-browser-history
tools.description: Returns the user’s most recent browsing history entries, optionally filtered by searchQuery, ordered from most-recent first. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if searchQuery is not a string, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access this user’s history. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if history queries exceed configured rate limits for the user/session.

tools.name: get-tab-web-content
tools.description: Returns the tab’s extracted web content starting at offset, including the page text and the list of links for that same snapshot; use subsequent calls with a larger offset to page through long documents. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tabId is missing/invalid or offset is negative, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the tab, and NOT_FOUND if the tabId does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the tab is closed or the content snapshot is not available (for example, still loading or content not yet captured).

tools.name: reorder-browser-tabs
tools.description: Reorders the user’s open tabs to exactly match tabOrder and returns the updated tab list/order for the affected window/session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tabOrder is empty, contains duplicates, or does not represent a valid ordering of the user’s currently reorderable open tabs, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot modify the user’s tabs. Raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced tabId does not exist, and CONFLICT if one or more tabs are closed/closing or otherwise not eligible to be reordered at the time of the request.

tools.name: find-highlight-in-browser-tab
tools.description: Searches for queryPhrase within the specified tab’s current captured content, records the find/highlight action for auditing/rate-limiting, and returns match metadata (for example, count and locations) for the highlights applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if queryPhrase is empty or tabId is invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the tab, and NOT_FOUND if the tabId does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the tab is closed or has no captured content to search yet, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if find/highlight actions exceed the allowed rate for the user/session.

tools.name: update-browser-session-status
tools.description: Transitions the caller’s current browser session status according to the supported lifecycle (active↔inactive, active/inactive→revoked). Returns the updated session record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid targetStatus, NOT_FOUND if no active/inactive session exists for the caller, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot modify the session, and CONFLICT if the transition is not allowed.

targetStatus.description: Desired new status for the current session.

tools.name: get-browser-tab

Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if tabId is invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the tab, and NOT_FOUND if no matching tab exists in the active session.

tabId.description: Numeric tab identifier (browser_tabs.tab_id_numeric) within the active session.

tools.name: update-browser-tab

tabId.description: Numeric tab identifier (browser_tabs.tab_id_numeric) within the active session.

windowId.description: If provided, moves the tab to this windowId (null for single-window implementations).

url.description: If provided, navigates the tab to a new absolute URL (http/https).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to delete (e.g., PROJ-123).

tools.name: get_issues
tools.description: Lists issues for the given project_key in the specified connection, optionally including subtasks, and returns a paged result set filtered by the provided fields (status, issue_type_id, assignee_account_id, reporter_account_id, parent_issue_key) and sorted by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: pass cursor from the previous page to fetch the next page; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/ranges or incompatible filters (e.g., parent_issue_key provided when include_subtasks is false), UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, and NOT_FOUND if the project key does not exist in this connection.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

project_key.description: Project key to fetch issues for (e.g., PROJ).

include_subtasks.description: Whether to include subtasks in the results.

status.description: Filter issues by local cached status.

issue_type_id.description: Filter issues by Jira issue type id.

assignee_account_id.description: Filter issues by assignee Jira accountId.

reporter_account_id.description: Filter issues by reporter Jira accountId.

parent_issue_key.description: Filter to subtasks of the given parent issue key.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Updates an existing issue’s editable fields (summary, description, assignee/reporter accountId, parent_issue_key, and/or fields_json) within the given connection and returns the updated issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed (including invalid connection_id format) or if no updatable fields are provided, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue_key does not exist in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if the issue is deleted/archived or if the requested parent change is not allowed (for example, setting a parent on a non-subtask issue type).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to update (e.g., PROJ-123).

assignee_account_id.description: Set the assignee by Jira accountId.

reporter_account_id.description: Set the reporter by Jira accountId.

parent_issue_key.description: Set/change the parent issue key (for subtasks).

fields_json.description: Arbitrary Jira fields payload to apply (mirrors Jira 'fields' object).

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Lists cached Jira field metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–500). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

tools.name: list_issue_types
tools.description: Lists cached Jira issue type metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

status.description: Filter issue types by metadata status.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of issue types to return.

tools.name: list_link_types
tools.description: Lists cached Jira issue link type metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

status.description: Filter link types by metadata status.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of link types to return.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Resolves a Jira user by email within the specified connection and returns the matched user identity, including the Jira accountId when found. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email is missing/invalid or connection_id fails format validation, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if no Jira user can be resolved for the provided email in this connection.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

email.description: User email address to resolve to a Jira accountId.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Creates a new Jira issue in the given project using issue_type_id and summary, optionally setting description, assignee/reporter accountId, parent_issue_key (for subtasks), and additional Jira fields via fields_json, then returns the created issue record including its issue key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, if fields_json is not an object, or if parent_issue_key is provided for a non-subtask issue type; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_key, issue_type_id, parent_issue_key, assignee_account_id, or reporter_account_id cannot be resolved in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if the issue cannot be created due to an incompatible project/issue type combination.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

project_key.description: Project key to create the issue in (e.g., PROJ).

issue_type_id.description: Jira issue type id for the new issue.

parent_issue_key.description: Parent issue key if creating a subtask.

fields_json.description: Arbitrary Jira fields payload to set at creation (mirrors Jira 'fields' object).

tools.name: create_issue_link
tools.description: Creates a Jira issue-to-issue link between inward_issue_key and outward_issue_key using the named link_type_name in the given connection, optionally attaching a comment, and returns the created link record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required inputs are missing/invalid (including identical inward/outward keys or invalid connection_id format), and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if either issue key does not exist or the link_type_name is not available in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if a link of the same type between the same two issues already exists or if the link is not allowed by Jira for the current issue states.

connection_id.description: Jira MCP connection id that scopes the Jira tenant and credentials.

link_type_name.description: Jira issue link type name to use when creating the link (e.g., "Blocks", "Relates").

inward_issue_key.description: Issue key on the inward side of the link (e.g., "PROJ-123").

outward_issue_key.description: Issue key on the outward side of the link (e.g., "PROJ-456").

comment.description: Optional comment to attach to the issue link in Jira.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetches a single issue by issue_key from the specified Jira connection and returns the cached issue record, refreshing from Jira when the local cache is missing or stale. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id or issue_key are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller; raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist in Jira (or is not visible to the caller).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to fetch (e.g., PROJ-123).

refresh.description: When true, forces a refresh from Jira before returning.

tools.name: update_connection
tools.description: Updates a Jira connection's mutable fields and/or transitions its lifecycle status, returning the updated connection record. Only transitions declared by the connection lifecycle are permitted (active↔disabled, active→error, error→active/disabled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed, if no updatable fields are provided, or if the requested status transition is not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage the connection; raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the update would violate restrict rules (e.g., attempting to remove required defaults while child rows exist).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to update.

status.description: New connection status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

default_project_key.description: Default project key used when a caller does not provide project_key.

auth_secret_ref.description: Reference to stored auth secret material used to connect to Jira.

tools.name: get_whoami
tools.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for this Jira MCP server, including the active connection context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credential is presented.

connection_id.description: Optional connection identifier to verify/access-check; if omitted, the server reports the configured active connection.

tools.name: modify_material

tools.name: get_material_info

tools.name: get_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Looks up the customer record associated with the provided phone number and returns the matching customer when found. The request is refused if the phone number is missing/blank, not in an acceptable phone-number format, or does not match any customer’s primary contact number or any active line number on the account.

phone_number.description: The phone number to search for.
phone_number.title: Phone Number

tools.name: get_customer_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves and returns the customer record for the specified customer_id. The request is refused if customer_id is missing/blank or does not correspond to an existing customer.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

tools.name: get_customer_by_name
tools.description: Searches for customers by full name and date of birth and returns any matching customer records (which may be more than one when names are similar). The request is refused if full_name or dob is missing/blank, if dob is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, or if no customers match the provided name and DOB combination.

full_name.description: The full name of the customer.
full_name.title: Full Name

dob.description: Date of birth for verification, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
dob.title: Dob

tools.name: get_details_by_id
tools.description: Returns the full details for the object identified by id when it refers to a Customer, Line, Device, Bill, or Plan. The request is refused if id is missing/blank, if the id is not a recognized identifier for a supported object type, or if no object exists for that id.

id.description: The ID of the object to retrieve.
id.title: Id

tools.name: suspend_line
tools.description: Suspends the specified line for the given customer and returns the updated line details with its status set to Suspended and a recorded suspension start date. The request is refused if customer_id, line_id, or reason is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line is not currently in Active status (including cases where it is already suspended).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to suspend.
line_id.title: Line Id

reason.description: Reason for suspension.
reason.title: Reason

tools.name: resume_line
tools.description: Resumes service on the specified line for the given customer and returns the updated line details with its status set to Active and any suspension start date cleared. The request is refused if customer_id or line_id is missing/blank, if the line does not belong to the customer, or if the line is not currently in Suspended or Pending Activation status.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to resume.
line_id.title: Line Id

tools.name: get_bills_for_customer
tools.description: Returns a list of bills for the specified customer ordered from most recent to oldest, honoring the provided limit (default 12). The request is refused if customer_id is missing/blank or does not correspond to an existing customer, or if limit is provided but is not a valid integer.

limit.description: Maximum number of bills to return.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: send_payment_request
tools.description: Marks the specified bill as awaiting payment and sends a payment request notification to the customer, returning the updated bill details. The request is refused if the customer or bill cannot be found, if the bill does not belong to the customer, or if the customer already has another bill in an awaiting-payment state (to prevent multiple concurrent payment requests).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the bill.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

bill_id.description: ID of the bill to send payment request for.
bill_id.title: Bill Id

tools.name: create_ppt_from_text
tools.description: Creates a PowerPoint generation job from the provided userText (which may be plain text or a YouTube URL) for the given accessId, and returns the created job details/identifier for later status and output retrieval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if userText or accessId is missing/empty or not a string, UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid or not permitted to create jobs, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has exceeded allowed generation limits. Raises CONFLICT if a generation job for the same accessId and identical input is already in progress or cannot be enqueued due to the current job state.

tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetches the transcript for the YouTube video referenced by ytUrl and returns the extracted transcript content for downstream use (for example, as input to PPT generation). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ytUrl is missing/empty, not a string, or not a valid YouTube URL, and NOT_FOUND if the video does not exist or no transcript is available for that video. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if transcript fetch limits are exceeded, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the transcript service.

tools.name: get_ppt_generation
tools.description: Fetches a single PPT generation job by id and returns its current status plus any output metadata. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the provided accessId, UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid or not permitted, and VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are missing/invalid.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id used to authorize viewing this job.

tools.name: list_ppt_generations
tools.description: Lists PPT generation jobs for the provided accessId in reverse-chronological order with optional filtering by status and created time. Returns a paginated page of jobs. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid/not permitted and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id used to scope the list.

status.description: If provided, only return jobs with this status.

createdAfter.description: If provided, only return jobs created strictly after this timestamp.

createdBefore.description: If provided, only return jobs created strictly before this timestamp.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in this page.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: cancel_ppt_generation
tools.description: Requests cancellation of a PPT generation job. If the job is in queued or running state, transitions it to cancelled and returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is already succeeded/failed/cancelled, NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist/is not visible to the accessId, and UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid/not permitted.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id used to authorize cancellation.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason to record for observability.

tools.name: get_ppt_download_url
tools.description: Returns a fresh, time-limited download URL for a succeeded PPT generation job output. Updates refresh metadata on the job (updated_at) but does not mutate immutable terminal fields. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is not succeeded, NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist/is not visible to accessId, and UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid/not permitted.

pptGenerationId.description: The ppt_generations.id whose output URL should be refreshed.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id used to authorize retrieval.

expiresInSeconds.description: Requested lifetime for the returned URL, subject to service limits.

tools.name: get_access_identity
tools.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided accessId, including access key status, granted limits, and current 24-hour usage for requests/PPT generations/transcript fetches. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid, revoked, or suspended, and VALIDATION_ERROR if accessId is missing/invalid.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id to introspect.

tools.name: get_youtube_transcript_status
tools.description: Fetches the stored transcript record for the given YouTube URL (and optional language) without forcing a refetch, returning status and any cached transcript_text when available. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if ytUrl is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if accessId is invalid/not permitted, and returns a typed error when status is unavailable or error.

ytUrl.description: A YouTube video URL to look up.

language.description: Optional language code (e.g., 'en', 'en-US'); if omitted, the service uses the default/unknown bucket.

accessId.description: Caller access key access_id used to authorize read and apply transcript quota policy where applicable.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Closes the currently attached page/tab in the active session and records the close in the session event log; returns an acknowledgement when the page is closed. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page to close (already closed or no page attached) and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resizes the active browser window to the requested width and height and records the resize in the session event log; returns the updated viewport/window dimensions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if width or height is missing or not a positive number, NOT_FOUND if there is no active page/window to resize, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Returns the collected console messages for the currently attached page in the active session; results are returned as a single list (no paging) and include messages observed since the page was created/attached. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accepts or dismisses the currently open JavaScript dialog (alert/confirm/prompt) on the active page, optionally supplying promptText for prompt dialogs, and records the decision in the session event log; returns an acknowledgement once the dialog is handled. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if accept is missing or promptText is provided for a non-prompt dialog, NOT_FOUND if there is no open dialog to handle, and CONFLICT if the dialog has already been handled or is no longer present.

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Uploads one or more files by setting the active file chooser/input on the current page, then records the upload action in the session event log; returns an acknowledgement once the chooser/input has been populated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if paths is empty or contains non-string values, NOT_FOUND if there is no active file chooser/input waiting for files, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be a single file or multiple files.

tools.name: browser_install
tools.description: Install the browser specified in the config. Call this if you get an error about the browser not being installed.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Sends a key press to the active page (including named keys like ArrowLeft or printable characters) and records the input event in the session event log; returns an acknowledgement once the key event is dispatched. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key is missing or empty, NOT_FOUND if there is no active page to receive input, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigates the currently attached page to the provided URL and records navigation (and resulting browser outputs) in the session event log; returns navigation completion status and the final resolved URL when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is missing or not a valid URL string, NOT_FOUND if there is no active page to navigate, and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

url.description: The URL to navigate to

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Navigates the active page back one entry in its history and records the navigation in the session event log; returns whether a back navigation occurred. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page and CONFLICT if there is no previous history entry to navigate to.

tools.name: browser_navigate_forward
tools.description: Navigates the active page forward one entry in its history and records the navigation in the session event log; returns whether a forward navigation occurred. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page and CONFLICT if there is no forward history entry to navigate to.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Returns the network requests observed for the currently attached page since it was loaded/attached; results are returned as a single list (no paging). Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page and FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the session.

tools.name: browser_pdf_save
tools.description: Renders the currently active page to a PDF and returns the PDF artifact metadata (and, when supported by the client, the PDF bytes), optionally saving it under the provided filename (defaulting to page-{timestamp}.pdf). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if there is no active session/page to render or the target page has been closed. Raises FORBIDDEN if your token cannot access the session, CONFLICT if the page is mid-navigation/closed while rendering, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed request or artifact limits.

filename.description: File name to save the pdf to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.pdf` if not specified.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a screenshot of the active page viewport, or of a specific element when both element and ref are provided, returning screenshot artifact metadata (and, when supported by the client, the image bytes) and optionally saving it under the provided filename; raw=true returns PNG, otherwise a JPEG is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if raw is not boolean, if element/ref are not provided together, or if the filename is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active page or if the referenced element cannot be found in the current snapshot. Raises FORBIDDEN if you cannot access the session, CONFLICT if the page is closed or changes state during capture, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request or artifact quotas are exceeded.

raw.description: Whether to return without compression (in PNG format). Default is false, which returns a JPEG image.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Captures and returns an accessibility snapshot of the active page (the structured representation used to reference elements for subsequent actions) and appends the snapshot event to the session log. Raises NOT_FOUND if there is no active session/page to snapshot. Raises FORBIDDEN if your token cannot access the session, CONFLICT if the page is closed or navigating in a way that prevents snapshotting, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed request quotas.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Clicks the target element identified by ref (as obtained from a prior browser_snapshot) and records the interaction and resulting browser events in the session log. element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

fields.description: Fields to fill in

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

tools.name: list-events
tools.description: Lists calendar events between timeMin and timeMax for the Google OAuth connection identified by accessToken and returns up to maxResults events (if provided), along with any paging token/marker the service uses to fetch the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when timeMin/timeMax are not valid ISO timestamps, timeMin is after timeMax, or maxResults is not a positive number; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is missing/invalid/expired or does not match a stored OAuth connection. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate limits are hit and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google Calendar cannot be reached or rejects the request.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: Fetches a single calendar event by eventId using the OAuth connection identified by accessToken and returns the event details from Google (and may read/update the local cache/log for that event). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when eventId is empty or accessToken is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection. Raises NOT_FOUND when no event with eventId exists or is not accessible to the connected account, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google Calendar fails the lookup for non-404 reasons.

tools.name: create-event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with summary, startTime, endTime and optional description/location/attendees/timeZone using the OAuth connection identified by accessToken, and returns the created event (recording the request/response and normalizing attendee emails). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, startTime/endTime are not valid ISO timestamps, endTime is not after startTime, timeZone is invalid, or attendees contains non-email values; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, CONFLICT when Google rejects the create due to calendar state/constraints (for example, duplicate iCalUID or other write conflicts), and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Google Calendar API failures.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity resolved from accessToken, including the associated oauth_connection id, status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for that connection. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection; refuses with FORBIDDEN when the connection is revoked.

includeQuota.description: When true, include rolling-window request counts and remaining allowance for the current 60-second window.

tools.name: list-oauth-connections
tools.description: Lists stored OAuth connections visible to the caller (typically the connection resolved from accessToken) with optional filtering by status/provider and standard pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

provider.description: Filter by OAuth provider.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by.

tools.name: update-oauth-connection-status
tools.description: Transitions an OAuth connection to a new lifecycle status (active/revoked/error) as allowed by the service. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when the transition is not permitted; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

oauthConnectionId.description: ID of the stored OAuth connection to update.

status.description: New status to set; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

errorMessage.description: Optional human-readable error description when setting status='error'.

tools.name: update-event-status
tools.description: Updates the local cached event status via allowed lifecycle transitions (tentative/confirmed/cancelled/deleted_local) without calling Google, and returns the updated local event record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the local event id is unknown; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when the requested status transition is not permitted; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

status.description: New local status to set; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

note.description: Optional audit note describing why the status was changed.

tools.name: list-api-requests
tools.description: Lists API request logs for the OAuth connection identified by accessToken, optionally filtered by toolName/status/time window, and returns paginated results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

startedAfter.description: Filter to requests with started_at >= this ISO timestamp.

startedBefore.description: Filter to requests with started_at <= this ISO timestamp.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: get-oauth-connection
tools.description: Fetches a single stored OAuth connection by id and returns its metadata (never returns raw tokens). Refuses with NOT_FOUND when no such connection exists; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

oauthConnectionId.description: ID of the stored OAuth connection.

tags.description: Tags for additional categorization

tools.name: update_documentation

force.description: Force update even if recently updated

tag.description: Filter by tag

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: pokemon-card-search
tools.description: Searches the normalized Pokémon TCG card catalog using a required free-text query plus optional structured filters and returns a page of matching cards sorted by the requested order; results are paged with an opaque cursor you pass back to retrieve the next page, and each request is recorded for auditing and rate-limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty/invalid, if any filter keys/values are not supported, or if limit/cursor/sort are malformed or out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if your token is not allowed to search this catalog, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your allowed request quota.

query.description: Free-text search query for matching cards (e.g., card name or keywords).

filters.description: Structured search filters to narrow results (e.g., set_code, set_name, supertype, rarity, artist, status).

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: pokemon-card-price
tools.description: Returns the best available market-price snapshot for a single card identified by card_id or lookup_key, optionally selecting by source_preference, currency, and/or a point-in-time at; the response includes the chosen snapshot and its effective timestamp/source, and the lookup is recorded for auditing and rate-limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither card_id nor lookup_key is provided, if card_id fails the required format, or if source_preference/currency/at are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND when the card cannot be resolved from the provided identifier or when no price snapshot exists that matches the requested constraints, plus UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access control failures and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your allowed request quota.

card_id.description: Internal card id (ULID) to fetch pricing for.

lookup_key.description: Alternate lookup key (e.g., external id / set+number string) to identify the card when card_id is not provided.

source_preference.description: Preferred marketplace/source to use when multiple price snapshots exist.

currency.description: ISO-like currency code to prefer when selecting a price snapshot (e.g., USD, EUR).

at.description: Optional point-in-time for price selection; if omitted, returns the most recent current snapshot.

currency.description: Filter snapshots by currency (e.g., USD, EUR).

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

high_price.description: High price observed for the card at snapshot_at.

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Returns a detailed snapshot of the currently loaded Unreal scene, including high-level metadata and the current set of tracked entities/assets for this session (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required scene context is unavailable or request parameters are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read scene state, and NOT_FOUND if no active level/world is loaded.

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Creates a new in-level object/actor of the requested Unreal type and optionally initializes its transform and label, returning the created object's identifier/name and resolved properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if type is empty/unknown or if location is not a 3-number vector, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify the level, NOT_FOUND if there is no active level/world to spawn into, and CONFLICT if an object with the requested label/name already exists or the engine refuses spawning for the requested class.

tools.name: modify_object
tools.description: Updates the transform of an existing object/actor (location, rotation, and/or scale) and returns the updated object state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/invalid or any provided transform is not a 3-number vector, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot edit the level, and NOT_FOUND if no object with the given name exists in the current scene or there is no active level/world.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Deletes the specified object/actor from the current level and returns a deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot modify the level, and NOT_FOUND if the named object does not exist in the current scene or there is no active level/world.

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Creates a new material asset at the given package path with the given name, optionally applying provided material properties, and returns the created material's asset path and resulting property state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package_path or name is invalid or if properties are not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create assets, NOT_FOUND if the target package path does not exist/is not resolvable, and CONFLICT if a material already exists at the resulting asset path.

tools.name: modify_material
tools.description: Applies the provided property updates to the material at the given full content path and returns the updated material info. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is invalid or properties is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot edit assets, NOT_FOUND if no material exists at the given path, and CONFLICT if the requested property changes are not compatible with the material/state (for example unsupported values for the underlying asset).

tools.name: get_material_info
tools.description: Returns metadata and current properties for the material at the given full content path (single item, not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read assets, and NOT_FOUND if no material exists at the given path.

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Executes Python in the Unreal environment from either an inline code string or a script file path and returns captured stdout/stderr and the execution result, while recording an audit entry of inputs and outputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither code nor file is provided or if both are provided, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to run Python, NOT_FOUND if a provided script path cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT if execution is refused due to the current editor/runtime state (for example when scripting is disabled).

tools.name: my_custom_tool
tools.description: Runs the custom tool using the provided ctx string and returns the tool's output for auditing/debugging. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ctx is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to invoke custom tools, and CONFLICT if the tool cannot run in the current session/state.

tools.name: get_actor_count
tools.description: Returns the total number of actors in the current Unreal scene as a single integer (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ctx is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read scene state, and NOT_FOUND if no active level/world is loaded.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: Lists Unreal Engine sessions visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and project/map metadata. Returns a paginated list ordered by most recently updated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot enumerate sessions and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination.

project_name.description: Filter sessions by exact project name.

map_path.description: Filter sessions by exact map content path.

engine_version.description: Filter sessions by exact engine version string.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tools.name: set_session_status
tools.description: Transitions a session's lifecycle status according to server rules (connected↔disconnected, and either to expired). Returns the updated session record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist/visible, CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed (for example expired→connected), and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage sessions.

session_id.description: Session id to update.

status.description: New status to set for the session.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: Lists tracked in-level actors/objects for a session with pagination and optional filters. Returns actor rows as stored by the backend (including transforms and lifecycle status). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read scene state and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination.

name_prefix.description: Return only actors whose name starts with this prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

Returns material rows including commonly extracted fields (shading_model/blend_mode/two_sided) when available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read assets and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination.

path_prefix.description: Return only materials whose full path starts with this prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of materials to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

wait.description: If true, wait for the capture to finish and return a terminal snapshot; if false, return immediately with status='capturing'.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Executes the provided SQL text against the PostgreSQL project identified by `project_id`, using `schema_name` (default `public`) as the schema context for access control and metadata caching, and returns either result rows (`result_format=json_rows`, up to `max_rows`) or only an execution acknowledgement (`result_format=none`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` does not match the required format, required fields are missing, `max_rows` is negative, or `result_format` is not supported; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to run queries on the project or schema; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if server-side row/usage limits are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id` does not exist or is not accessible, and QUERY_ERROR if the database rejects the SQL (syntax, permission, or runtime errors).

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection to run the query against.

schema_name.description: Schema context for the query (used for access control/caching); defaults to 'public' when omitted.

result_format.description: Whether to return result rows or only run the statement without returning rows.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (server may further clamp based on API key limits).

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: Lists schemas visible to the caller for the given `project_id` and returns a paged result set controlled by `limit`, with an opaque `cursor` used to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is invalid, `limit` is < 1, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot introspect the project. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id` does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing exceeds allowed introspection limits.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection to list schemas for.

limit.description: Maximum number of schemas to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous call.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists objects in the requested `schema` (default `public`) for `project_id`, optionally including views/materialized views when `include_views` is true, and returns a paged result set controlled by `limit` with an opaque `cursor` for continuation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is invalid, `limit` is < 1, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to introspect the project or schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id` is missing/inaccessible or the schema is not visible to the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if introspection limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection to list tables for.

schema.description: The schema name to list tables from (defaults to 'public').

include_views.description: Whether to include views/materialized views in addition to tables.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous call.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns detailed catalog metadata for `table_name` in `schema` (default `public`) for the given `project_id` (for example, columns and types) as a single, non-paginated object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is invalid or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot introspect the project or schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project, schema, or table does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if introspection limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the table.

table_name.description: The name of the table to describe.

tools.name: get_foreign_keys
tools.description: Returns the foreign key constraints for `table_name` in `schema` (default `public`) for the given `project_id` as a single, non-paginated result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is invalid or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot introspect the project or schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project, schema, or table does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if introspection limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the table.

table_name.description: The name of the table to get foreign keys from.

tools.name: find_relationships
tools.description: Analyzes `table_name` in `schema` (default `public`) for the given `project_id` and returns both explicit relationships (foreign keys) and implied relationships inferred from compatible key/column patterns as a single, non-paginated result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is invalid or required fields are missing; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot introspect the project or schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project, schema, or table does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if relationship analysis exceeds allowed introspection limits.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the table.

table_name.description: The name of the table to analyze relationships for.

tools.name: get_query_job
tools.description: Fetches a single stored query job by `query_job_id` for the given `project_id`, including its final status, timings, and (when available) persisted result rows truncated to the caller's limits. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the API key is not active, not scoped to the project, or lacks introspection permission; raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the job.

query_job_id.description: ID of the query job to fetch.

tools.name: list_query_jobs
tools.description: Lists stored query jobs for `project_id` in reverse-chronological order, optionally filtered by status and schema/table statement type, returning a paged result set controlled by `limit` with an opaque `cursor` for continuation. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view query history for the project; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection to list query jobs for.

status.description: If provided, only return jobs in this lifecycle status.

schema_name.description: If provided, only return jobs executed with this schema context.

statement_type.description: If provided, only return jobs with this classified statement type.

created_after.description: If provided, only return jobs created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: If provided, only return jobs created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing from a previous call.

tools.name: cancel_query_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of a query job in `queued` or `running` state for the given `project_id` and returns the updated job. Refuses with CONFLICT if the job is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled); refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to manage jobs for the project; raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the job.

query_job_id.description: ID of the query job to cancel.

tools.name: refresh_catalog
tools.description: Starts (or idempotently reuses) a catalog refresh for `project_id`, updating cached `catalog_objects` and `foreign_keys` from the underlying PostgreSQL system catalogs and marking missing previously-present objects as `dropped`. Returns an acknowledgement including the refresh scope applied. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to introspect the project; raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is disabled/deleted.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection whose catalog should be refreshed.

schema_names.description: Optional subset of schemas to refresh; when omitted, refreshes all schemas visible to the caller under allowed_schemas.

force.description: When true, forces a refresh even if the cache is considered fresh; still idempotent for identical source snapshots.

tools.name: get_catalog_object
tools.description: Fetches a single cached catalog object (schema/table/view/materialized_view/column) by identifier for the given `project_id`. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot introspect the project or schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the object does not exist, is not visible under allowed_schemas, or is `dropped` unless `include_dropped` is true.

project_id.description: ID of the PostgreSQL project/connection that owns the catalog object.

object_type.description: Type of catalog object to fetch.

object_name.description: Name of the object (for columns, this is the column name).

parent_object_id.description: Required when `object_type` is `column`: the catalog object id of the parent table/view.

include_dropped.description: When true, allows returning objects with status `dropped` (still subject to access control).

tools.name: add-memory
tools.description: Creates a new memory for the specified workspace and actor, stores the provided content plus optional source/metadata/importance/expiration, and returns the created memory record (including its assigned id and timestamps) once it has been accepted for indexing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/actor_id do not match the required formats, content is empty, expires_at is not a valid RFC 3339 date-time, importance is not a number, source is not one of the allowed values, or unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot write to the workspace or on behalf of the actor, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the request attempts a state that cannot be applied (for example, an expiration in the past or other rejected lifecycle constraints).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to store the memory in.

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata associated with the memory.

importance.description: Optional importance score used for ranking/retention decisions.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the memory.

tools.name: search-memories
tools.description: Searches memories within a workspace for the given actor using the free-text query (and optional structured filter) and returns up to top_k matching memory records ranked by relevance; this endpoint does not paginate and uses top_k as the only limit on result size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/actor_id formats are invalid, query_text is empty, top_k is less than 1, the filter is not an object, or unknown fields are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read from the workspace or scope searches for the actor, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if search/rate limits are exceeded, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or actor does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to search within.

actor_id.description: Actor performing the search (used for scoping/auditing).

query_text.description: Free-text query to search for in memories.

top_k.description: Maximum number of memories to return.

filter.description: Optional structured filter object applied during retrieval (recorded for auditing).

tools.name: list-memories
tools.description: Lists memories for a workspace/actor with optional status and expiration filtering, returning a paginated result set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests with invalid ids, FK mismatches, or when the workspace/actor are not accessible to the caller.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list memories from.

include_expired.description: When true, includes expired memories (still excludes deleted unless status='deleted' is requested explicitly).

include_deleted.description: When true, includes deleted memories.

created_after.description: Return memories created after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Return memories created before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

expires_before.description: Return memories with expires_at before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tools.name: get-memory
tools.description: Fetches a single memory by id within a workspace. Returns the memory record if found; refuses invalid ids or FK mismatches, and returns NOT_FOUND if the memory does not exist in the specified workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the memory belongs to.

include_deleted.description: When true, allows fetching a deleted memory (still returns NOT_FOUND if it does not exist).

tools.name: update-memory
tools.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing memory (content/metadata/importance/expires_at). If content is changed, the service recomputes content_hash and schedules reindexing by upserting memory_index with status='pending' or 'stale'. Refuses FK mismatches, attempts to modify deleted memories, or writes that would violate workspace quotas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the memory belongs to.

metadata.description: New structured metadata (replaces existing object).

expires_at.description: New expiration timestamp (RFC 3339) or null to clear expiration.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the memory. Allowed transitions: active->expired.

tools.name: delete-memory
tools.description: Deletes a memory by transitioning it to status='deleted' and setting deleted_at. Also invalidates or cascades the associated memory_index (by deletion or by marking it stale). Refuses deletion if the memory is already deleted, or if ids are invalid or mismatched.

workspace_id.description: Workspace the memory belongs to.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded for auditing.

tools.name: list-search-requests
tools.description: Lists recorded search requests for auditing within a workspace/actor, returning a paginated set ordered by created_at descending. Refuses invalid ids, FK mismatches, or unauthorized access.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list search requests from.

actor_id.description: Actor whose search requests to list.

created_after.description: Return search requests created after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

created_before.description: Return search requests created before this RFC 3339 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of search requests to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tools.name: get-auth-context
tools.description: Returns the calling identity, authorized workspace ids/scopes, and current quota/rate-limit state as observed by the service (including active-memories usage and per-actor search rate consumption). Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to return scoped quota/limits for; when omitted, returns the caller's default/authorized workspaces summary.

tools.name: deploy-site
tools.description: Creates a new deploy for the linked Netlify site from the provided directory, optionally annotating it with a message and associating it with a branch and/or marking it as the production deploy; returns the created deploy record and its initial state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is not a valid local ULID, dir is missing/invalid, or mutually incompatible deploy options are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist or is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available for the site’s account, FORBIDDEN if the token lacks permission for the target site, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream Netlify API rejects the request due to quota/limits.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to deploy.

dir.description: Path to the directory to deploy (typically the publish directory).

is_production.description: Whether this deploy should be treated as the production deploy.

branch.description: Git branch name to associate with the deploy (for branch deploys).

tools.name: list-sites
tools.description: Lists local site records for the specified (or active) account, optionally filtering by link state and local status, and returns results ordered by the requested sort/order with cursor-based pagination (limit items plus a next cursor when more results exist). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid account_id, cursor, limit, sort, or order value. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, NOT_FOUND if the specified account_id does not exist locally, and RATE_LIMITED if listing requires upstream calls that are rejected for quota.

account_id.description: Optional local Netlify account ULID to list sites for; defaults to the active account.

is_linked.description: If provided, filters to only linked (true) or unlinked (false) local site records.

status.description: Filter local site records by status.

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: set-env-vars
tools.description: Upserts environment variables for the given site, either merging provided keys or replacing the tracked set when override=true, and returns the resulting environment variable set for that site. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is invalid, env is empty/invalid, or keys/values fail required constraints; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist or is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot manage site configuration, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream Netlify API refuses the write due to quota.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to set environment variables for.

env.description: Map of environment variable names to values to upsert.

override.description: If true, replaces existing env vars not present in the request; if false, only upserts provided keys.

is_secret.description: Whether to store the provided env var values as secrets in local tracking (site_kv).

tools.name: delete-site
tools.description: Deletes the remote Netlify site corresponding to the provided local site_id and returns a confirmation of deletion; this operation is irreversible. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if confirm is not true or site_id is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist or is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, FORBIDDEN if the token lacks permission to delete the site, CONFLICT if the site is already deleting/deleted in local tracking, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream API rejects the delete due to quota.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the irreversible delete operation.

tools.name: get-logs
tools.description: Returns function log lines for a site, optionally filtered by function name, deploy, and time window, using cursor-based pagination (limit lines plus a next cursor when more logs are available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id/deploy_id are invalid, since/until are malformed or inconsistent, or limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist, is not linked, or the referenced deploy is not found for that site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access logs for the site, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream log provider/API enforces limits.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to fetch function logs for.

function_name.description: Optional function name to filter logs to a single function.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to scope logs to.

since.description: Only return log lines at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

until.description: Only return log lines before or at this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: trigger-build
tools.description: Triggers a new Netlify build for the linked site (optionally for a specific branch and with cache clearing) and returns the created build/deploy reference with its initial queued/running state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is invalid or provided options are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist or is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot trigger builds for the site, CONFLICT if a requested branch deploy is not allowed by the site’s configuration, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream API rejects the trigger due to quota.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to trigger a build for.

branch.description: Git branch to build/deploy (defaults to the site's configured branch if omitted).

clear_cache.description: If true, requests a build with cache cleared.

tools.name: link-site
tools.description: Links a local directory path to the specified local site record so subsequent operations can resolve the site from that directory, and returns the updated link mapping. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is invalid or dir is missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced local site record does not exist, and CONFLICT if the directory is already linked to a different site or the site is already linked to a different directory (unless explicitly unlinked first).

site_id.description: Local site ULID (or a newly created local record) to link to the directory.

dir.description: Local repository root directory path to link.

tools.name: unlink-site
tools.description: Removes the link between a local directory and a site and returns the removed mapping; if site_id is omitted, we unlink whichever site is currently linked to that directory. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dir is missing/invalid or site_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if no link exists for the given dir (or if a provided site_id does not match the site linked to that dir), and UNAUTHORIZED if the operation requires an active account context to resolve the mapping.

dir.description: Local repository root directory path to unlink from any linked site.

site_id.description: Optional local site ULID to unlink (if omitted, uses the site linked to the directory).

tools.name: get-status
tools.description: Fetches and returns current Netlify status information using the specified account context or the active account when omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, NOT_FOUND if the specified account_id does not exist locally, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream status endpoint enforces request limits.

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to use for the status check.

tools.name: import-env
tools.description: Parses environment variables from the given file in the specified format and applies them to the target site in the requested Netlify scope (or reports the planned changes when dry_run=true), returning a summary of created/updated/skipped keys. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is invalid, file_path/format/scope are invalid, or the file content cannot be parsed; raises NOT_FOUND if the local site does not exist or is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/token is available, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot manage environment variables for the site, CONFLICT when overwrite=false and a key already exists in the target scope, and RATE_LIMITED if the upstream API rejects the write due to quota.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to import environment variables into.

file_path.description: Path to a dotenv-style file containing environment variables.

format.description: Format of the environment variable file.

scope.description: Netlify environment scope to apply the variables to.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing variables with the same key.

dry_run.description: If true, parses and reports changes without writing to Netlify.

tools.name: build-site
tools.description: Triggers a new build/deploy for the linked Netlify site identified by site_id, optionally targeting a specific git branch, clearing the build cache, and attaching an audit message; returns the created deploy record and any known linkage metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is malformed, branch/message are invalid types, or unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the local site is not linked to a remote Netlify site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no account/token is selected or it lacks permission on the site, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream API rejects the request due to limits, and CONFLICT if a build cannot be started due to the site/deploy state refusing a new build (e.g., upstream rejects the transition).

site_id.description: Local site ULID to trigger a build/deploy for.

branch.description: Git branch to build.

clear_cache.description: Whether to clear the build cache before building.

message.description: Optional build/deploy message/summary for audit metadata.

tools.name: get-env-var
tools.description: Fetches a single environment variable by key from the specified site_id and scope, and returns its metadata and value (redacted unless reveal_secret is true and permitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is malformed, scope is not one of the supported values, key is empty/invalid, or unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the site link does not exist or the key is not present in the requested scope. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated or not allowed to read env vars for the site, and FORBIDDEN if reveal_secret is requested but your token is not permitted to reveal secret values.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to read the environment variable from.

scope.description: Netlify environment scope to read from.

reveal_secret.description: Whether to return secret values in plaintext when permitted.

tools.name: unset-env-var
tools.description: Removes/unsets the environment variable identified by key from the given site_id and scope, returning the updated variable state (or a confirmation of deletion). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is malformed, scope is invalid, key is empty/invalid, or unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the site link does not exist or the variable does not exist in the requested scope. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated or lack permission to manage environment variables for the site, and CONFLICT if the upstream API refuses the change due to site/state restrictions.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to remove the environment variable from.

scope.description: Netlify environment scope to unset within.

tools.name: clone-env-vars
tools.description: Copies environment variables from from_site_id to to_site_id within the selected scope, returning a per-key summary of created/updated/skipped variables based on overwrite and include_secrets. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either site id is malformed, scope is invalid, overwrite/include_secrets are invalid types, or unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if either local site is not linked to a remote site. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you are not authenticated or lack permission on either site, FORBIDDEN if include_secrets is true but your token cannot read/reveal secret values, and CONFLICT when overwrite is false and one or more destination keys already exist (the operation is refused for those collisions).

from_site_id.description: Source local site ULID to copy environment variables from.

to_site_id.description: Destination local site ULID to copy environment variables to.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite destination variables when keys collide.

include_secrets.description: Whether to include secret variables when cloning.

tools.name: create-site
tools.description: Creates a new Netlify site owned by account_id with the requested name and optional repo/build settings (repo_url/repo_branch/build_command/publish_dir), optional custom_domain, and optional local_repo_root used for subsequent linking workflows; returns the created site record and the local-to-remote link. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/site name are malformed or invalid, repo_url/custom_domain/local_repo_root are invalid types/formats, or unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if the local account does not exist or is not selectable. account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID that will own the new site.

custom_domain.description: Custom domain to associate with the site.

local_repo_root.description: Local filesystem path to the repository root for linking workflows.

tools.description: Returns detailed information for the site identified by site_id, and when include_deploys is true also returns up to deploy_limit recent deploys embedded in the response. site_id.description: Local site ULID to list deploys for.

tools.name: get-deploy-info
tools.description: Fetches and returns details for a single deploy identified by deploy_id (local) or netlify_deploy_id (remote), including current status and related site information when available. tools.description: Returns the set of supported automation recipes, optionally filtered by the provided query across recipe name/description; results are returned as a single unpaged list.
