query.description: Optional search string to filter recipes by name/description.

tools.name: run-recipe
tools.description: Runs the specified recipe and returns a run result describing the actions performed and any outputs produced; if site_id is provided, the recipe is executed in the context of that linked site. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if recipe_id is empty or if inputs is not an object. Raises NOT_FOUND if recipe_id does not exist or if site_id is provided but does not refer to a known linked site, and raises CONFLICT if the recipe cannot run for the site’s current state (for example, required site linkage or prerequisites are missing).

recipe_id.description: Identifier of the recipe to run.

site_id.description: Local site ULID the recipe should operate on.

tools.name: build-function
tools.description: Builds the named function for the given linked site and returns a build result (and, when debug is true, includes verbose build output in the response). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id/function_name are missing or invalid, or if deploy_id is provided but is not a valid deploy ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the site_id (or provided deploy_id) does not exist, and raises CONFLICT if the function build cannot be associated to the referenced deploy or the requested build context is not compatible with the site’s current configuration.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to build the function for.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to associate this build with.

branch.description: Git branch context for the build (if applicable).

debug.description: Whether to include verbose build output in the event response.

tools.name: invoke-function-advanced
tools.description: Invokes the specified function on the given linked site using the provided HTTP method, path, query, headers, and optional request body, returning the function response (status, headers, and body) and optionally recording an observability event when record_event is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid method, timeout_ms, or when both body_text and body_base64 are provided, or when source fields (e.g., headers/query) are not objects of strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the site is not linked or the function route cannot be resolved for that site, and raises TIMEOUT if the invocation exceeds timeout_ms; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access to the site/function context.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID containing the function.

method.description: HTTP method to use for the invocation.

path.description: Additional path appended after the function route (for splat routes).

query.description: Query string parameters to send with the request.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with the request.

body_base64.description: Request body as base64 (use for binary payloads).

content_type.description: Content-Type header value to set when sending a body.

record_event.description: Whether to record an observability audit event for this invocation.

tools.name: init-site
tools.description: Creates and links a new Netlify site under the specified local account and returns the linked site record, applying optional repo/build settings, persisted local_repo_root, branch_deploys, and environment variables (marking keys in env_secrets as secret). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/name are invalid, if env is not a string map, or if env_secrets contains keys not present in env. Raises NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist, and raises CONFLICT if a site with the same identity cannot be created/linked (for example, the name is already taken or the local link would duplicate an existing linked site).

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to create/link the site under.

repo_branch.description: Default branch to use for builds (optional).

custom_domain.description: Custom domain to associate with the site (optional).

local_repo_root.description: Local filesystem path for the repo root to store for this site link.

branch_deploys.description: Branch deploy configuration blob stored on the site record.

env.description: Environment variables to set on the site (key/value).

env_secrets.description: Environment variable keys that should be treated as secret.

tools.name: open-site
tools.description: Resolves and opens the requested URL for a linked site (default site URL, admin URL, or a specific deploy URL) and returns the resolved target URL that was opened. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target is 'deploy' but deploy_id is not provided or is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if site_id is unknown, or if target is 'deploy' and deploy_id does not exist or is not associated with the site.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to open.

target.description: Which URL to open (default site URL, admin URL, or a specific deploy).

deploy_id.description: Local deploy ULID to open when target is 'deploy'.

tools.name: call-netlify-api
tools.description: Makes a proxied call to the Netlify API using the specified method/path and optional query/headers/body, returning the upstream response (status, headers, and body) and optionally recording an auditable request/response event when record_audit is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid, if both body and body_text are provided, or if an account_id/site_id/deploy_id is provided but fails format validation. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the selected (or active) account is not authenticated, NOT_FOUND if the referenced local account/site/deploy association does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED or TIMEOUT when the upstream enforces quotas or the request exceeds timeout_ms.

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to use for authentication (defaults to active account if omitted).

method.description: HTTP method for the Netlify API call.

path.description: Netlify API path beginning with '/api/' (or full path portion expected by the broker).

query.description: Query string parameters to include.

body.description: JSON request body to send (for non-GET calls).

body_text.description: Raw text body to send (alternative to 'body').

record_audit.description: Whether to record an auditable observability event for this API call.

site_id.description: Optional local site ULID to associate the audit event with.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to associate the audit event with.

tools.name: list-api-methods
tools.description: Lists the available Netlify API methods/paths exposed by this broker, optionally filtered by the provided substring, and returns results paged by cursor with at most limit items per page (a next cursor is returned when more results are available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is outside 1–200 or cursor is not a string. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active account/session is available to enumerate methods.

filter.description: Optional substring filter applied to method names/paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of methods to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: stream-logs
tools.description: Opens a live log stream for the specified linked site, either site-wide or scoped to a specific function, optionally starting from since and optionally including buffered logs when include_existing is true; the stream stays open until max_duration_seconds is reached or the client closes it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if source is 'function' but function_name is missing, if since is not RFC3339/ISO-8601 date-time, or if max_duration_seconds is less than 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the site_id is unknown (or deploy_id is provided but not found), and raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access to logs is not permitted or streaming quotas are exceeded.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to stream logs for.

source.description: Log source to stream (site-wide or a specific function).

function_name.description: Function name to stream logs for when source is 'function'.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to scope logs to a deploy/build where supported.

since.description: Start streaming logs from this timestamp (ISO 8601).

include_existing.description: Whether to include recent buffered logs before switching to live stream.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum time to keep the log stream open, in seconds.

tools.name: switch-account
tools.description: Sets the specified local Netlify account as the active account for subsequent operations and returns the updated active-account selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist locally, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account exists but does not have usable authentication configured.

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to mark as active.

tools.name: watch-deploy
tools.description: Watches a deploy’s status in near real time by polling Netlify for the referenced deploy (resolved by local deploy_id, or by netlify_deploy_id optionally scoped via site_id) and returns a stream of status update events until the deploy reaches any until_status terminal state or timeout_seconds elapses; when include_logs is true, it also emits build/deploy log lines occurring at or after since. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither deploy_id nor netlify_deploy_id is provided, if IDs don’t match the required formats, or if poll_interval_seconds/timeout_seconds are out of range; raises NOT_FOUND if the local deploy/site link cannot be resolved or the Netlify deploy does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when the active account token cannot access the site/deploy, and RATE_LIMITED when Netlify rejects polling/log fetches due to API limits.

deploy_id.description: Local deploy ULID to watch (tracks a Netlify deploy).

netlify_deploy_id.description: Netlify deploy id/uuid to watch (alternative to deploy_id).

site_id.description: Local site ULID used to resolve a deploy when netlify_deploy_id is provided.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for refreshes while watching.

until_status.description: Stop watching once the deploy reaches any of these terminal statuses.

include_logs.description: Whether to stream build/deploy logs while watching.

since.description: Only emit log lines/events occurring at or after this timestamp.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to watch before stopping.

tools.name: manage-form
tools.description: Performs the requested action (enable, disable, delete, or export) against a specific Netlify form for the given locally linked site_id; for export it returns the submissions export in the requested export_format, optionally filtered inclusively by from/to. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields for the chosen action are missing (form_id, and export_format for export) or if from/to are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the site link or targeted Netlify form id does not exist. site_id.description: Local site ULID whose Netlify forms will be managed.

action.description: Form management action to perform.

form_id.description: Netlify form id to target for enable/disable/delete/export.

export_format.description: Export format when action is export.

from.description: Start timestamp filter for exported submissions (inclusive).

to.description: End timestamp filter for exported submissions (inclusive).

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.description: Fetches analytics for the given locally linked site_id and metric over the inclusive from–to window and returns a time-series dataset bucketed by interval in the specified timezone. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to/interval/timezone are invalid (including from after to) or required fields are missing, and raises NOT_FOUND if the site is not linked locally or is not found in Netlify. site_id.description: Local site ULID to fetch analytics for.

from.description: Start timestamp for the analytics query (inclusive).

to.description: End timestamp for the analytics query (inclusive).

interval.description: Time bucketing interval for returned series data.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for bucketing (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/Los_Angeles').

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.description: Lists locally tracked Netlify account connections, optionally filtering by status and active flag, and returns results with cursor-based pagination. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no caller context is available; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid cursor/limit/sort/order values.

is_active.description: If provided, filters to only active (true) or inactive (false) accounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: Lists synchronized Gmail email metadata for the given Workspace account, filtered by label/state/date/fields, and returns a page of emails ordered by sort_by/sort_order with up to limit results and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or any filters/sort/paging inputs are malformed (including invalid date ranges or limit out of bounds). Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Gmail access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID to list emails for.

label_ids.description: Only return emails that currently have all of these Gmail label IDs.

status.description: Filter by internal email row status.

from_email.description: Filter by sender email address (exact match).

to_email.description: Filter by recipient email address (matches any recipient in to_emails).

internal_date_gte.description: Only include emails with internal_date on/after this timestamp.

internal_date_lte.description: Only include emails with internal_date on/before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Searches synchronized Gmail email metadata within the given Workspace account using a Gmail-style query string and returns a page of matching emails ordered by relevance or internal_date, with up to limit results and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/query is missing or malformed, or if limit/sort inputs are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Gmail access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID to search within.

query.description: Advanced search query string (Gmail-style search syntax).

limit.description: Maximum number of matching emails to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort_order.description: Sort direction (only meaningful for internal_date sort).

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email from the given Workspace account to the provided recipients (to/cc/bcc) with the supplied subject and body (plaintext and/or HTML), optionally setting reply-to and threading via in_reply_to_rfc822_message_id, and returns the created send operation and message metadata when accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid, to_emails is empty, or message fields are otherwise invalid (for example, missing both body_text and body_html when required). Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected or lacks permission to send mail.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID to send from.

in_reply_to_rfc822_message_id.description: RFC822 Message-ID being replied to (for threading).

tools.name: modify_email
tools.description: Modifies a synchronized email’s label state for the given account by adding/removing Gmail label IDs and/or toggling read, archived, and trashed state, returning the updated email metadata after the change is applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are malformed or if the requested label/state changes are inconsistent (for example, invalid label ID inputs). Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id or email_id does not exist or the email does not belong to the account, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Gmail access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID that owns the email.

add_label_ids.description: Gmail label IDs to add to the message.

remove_label_ids.description: Gmail label IDs to remove from the message.

is_read.description: Set read/unread state (maps to adding/removing UNREAD label).

is_archived.description: Set archived/unarchived state (typically removes/adds INBOX label).

is_trashed.description: Move to trash or restore from trash.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Lists calendar events for the given Workspace account (optionally scoped to calendar_id and a time_min/time_max window) and returns a page of events filtered by status and sorted by start_at according to sort_order, with up to limit results and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if time bounds are malformed or inconsistent, or if paging/sort inputs are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist (or the specified calendar_id cannot be resolved for that account), and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Calendar access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID to list events for.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier to list events from (e.g., 'primary' or a calendar ID).

time_min.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for event start time.

time_max.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for event start time.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort_order.description: Sort by start_at ascending or descending.

tools.name: create_event

Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist or the calendar_id is not available for that account, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Calendar access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID to create the event under.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier to create the event in (e.g., 'primary' or a calendar ID).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for interpreting start/end times.

is_all_day.description: Whether the event is an all-day event.

attendees.description: Attendees payload to apply to the event (stored as provided).

conference_data.description: Conference data payload (e.g., Meet) to apply to the event (stored as provided).

visibility.description: Event visibility.

tools.name: update_event

Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id or event_id does not exist or the event does not belong to the account, and FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized/connected for Calendar access.

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID that owns the event.

event_id.description: Internal calendar event ULID to update.

timezone.description: Updated IANA timezone for interpreting start/end times.

is_all_day.description: Whether the event is an all-day event.

conference_data.description: Updated conference data payload (stored as provided).

visibility.description: Updated event visibility.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event

account_id.description: Workspace account ULID that owns the event.

event_id.description: Internal calendar event ULID to delete.

tools.name: stagehand_navigate
tools.description: Navigates the specified Stagehand browser session to an absolute URL and appends a `navigate` command (with its resulting navigation output) to the session timeline, returning the recorded command result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is not a valid Stagehand session ULID or if `url` is missing/invalid or not absolute, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to use the session, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed configured request or usage limits.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this navigate command to.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate the session to.

tools.name: stagehand_act
tools.description: Executes a single, atomic action instruction (e.g., click/type/select) against the current page in the specified session, appends an `act` command to the session timeline, and returns the recorded command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid or `action` is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT when the session cannot accept a new command (for example, if it is already executing or otherwise not in a runnable state).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this act command to.

action.description: Atomic, specific action instruction to perform on the current page (e.g., click/type/select).

tools.name: stagehand_extract
tools.description: Extracts the page text from the current page in the specified session, appends an `extract` command to the session timeline, and returns the extracted text artifact in the command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where extraction can run (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this extract command to.

tools.name: stagehand_observe
tools.description: Observes actionable elements on the current page in the specified session, appends an `observe` command to the session timeline, and returns the observed element metadata in the command output for later use in actions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session cannot run an observation (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this observe command to.

tools.name: screenshot

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where a screenshot can be taken (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this screenshot command to.

tools.name: stagehand_create_session
tools.description: Creates a new stateful Stagehand browser session in the caller's workspace and returns the session record. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if credentials are missing/invalid or the API key is revoked, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace has exceeded its sessions-per-day quota.

browser_provider.description: Browser backend/provider to use for this session.

expires_in_seconds.description: Requested session TTL in seconds; the service may clamp to workspace limits.

metadata.description: Optional opaque metadata to attach to the session for auditing/debugging.

tools.name: stagehand_get_session
tools.description: Fetches a single browser session by id and returns its current state (including status, current URL/title, and timestamps). Refuses NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to fetch.

tools.name: stagehand_list_sessions

created_after.description: Only return sessions created after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return sessions created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: stagehand_end_session
tools.description: Ends a running/created Stagehand browser session and transitions it to status=ended, preventing any new queued commands. Returns the updated session. session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to end.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded for audit/debugging.

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

tools.name: stagehand_navigate
tools.description: Navigates the specified Stagehand browser session to an absolute URL and appends a `navigate` command (with its resulting navigation output) to the session timeline, returning the recorded command result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is not a valid Stagehand session ULID or if `url` is missing/invalid or not absolute, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to use the session, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed configured request or usage limits.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this navigate command to.

url.description: Absolute URL to navigate the session to.

tools.name: stagehand_act
tools.description: Executes a single, atomic action instruction (e.g., click/type/select) against the current page in the specified session, appends an `act` command to the session timeline, and returns the recorded command output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `session_id` is invalid or `action` is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist or is not accessible to you. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT when the session cannot accept a new command (for example, if it is already executing or otherwise not in a runnable state).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this act command to.

action.description: Atomic, specific action instruction to perform on the current page (e.g., click/type/select).

tools.name: stagehand_extract
tools.description: Extracts the page text from the current page in the specified session, appends an `extract` command to the session timeline, and returns the extracted text artifact in the command output. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session is not in a state where extraction can run (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this extract command to.

tools.name: stagehand_observe
tools.description: Observes actionable elements on the current page in the specified session, appends an `observe` command to the session timeline, and returns the observed element metadata in the command output for later use in actions. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED for usage limits, and CONFLICT if the session cannot run an observation (for example, no active page or the session is busy).

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this observe command to.

session_id.description: Stagehand browser session ULID to append this screenshot command to.

tools.name: version_0.0.4-beta.11
tools.description: Initializes a MasterGo Magic deployment scoped to the provided workspace and returns the workspace-scoped tool surface for this version. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is missing or does not match the required format, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the workspace. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your workspace or account has exceeded allowed invocation limits.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id where this MasterGo Magic deployment/invocation is scoped.

tools.name: mcp__getDsl
tools.description: Extracts and returns the design DSL for the specified MasterGo file/layer, including the generation rules you must follow and any componentDocumentLinks discovered for follow-up documentation fetches. If session_id is provided, we reuse that session context and may resolve fileId/layerId from it; otherwise we create/use a session keyed by (workspace_id, fileId, layerId). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers, FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the workspace or file, NOT_FOUND if the referenced file/layer or session cannot be found in this workspace scope, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if extraction limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to scope the extraction session.

fileId.description: MasterGo external file id identifying the design file (stored as design_files.external_file_id).

layerId.description: MasterGo external layer id identifying the target layer/node within the file (stored as design_sessions.external_layer_id).

session_id.description: Existing session id to reuse; if provided, fileId/layerId may be resolved from the session.

tools.name: mcp__getComponentLink
tools.description: Fetches and returns component documentation for a single URL from the session’s componentDocumentLinks, and stores the retrieved documentation as an artifact associated with the given session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if url is not a valid URI or required fields are missing, and FORBIDDEN if you cannot access the workspace or session. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist in this workspace, and CONFLICT if the provided url does not belong to the session’s componentDocumentLinks (or sequence_index is provided but does not match the expected link position).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to scope the session and fetched component doc artifact.

session_id.description: Design session id whose DSL contained the componentDocumentLinks array.

url.description: A single URL from the DSL componentDocumentLinks array to fetch component documentation.

sequence_index.description: Zero-based index indicating which link in componentDocumentLinks this URL corresponds to.

tools.name: mcp__getMeta

tools.name: mcp__getComponentGenerator

tools.name: todoist_task_create
tools.description: Creates a new task in the Todoist workspace for the given connection and returns the created task record (including its assigned id and stored due fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, ids do not match their expected prefixes, or if section_id is provided but does not belong to the given project_id; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced project_id, section_id, parent_task_id, or any label_ids do not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the requested hierarchy/state is not allowed (for example, parenting under an incompatible task).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

project_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in.

section_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in (must belong to the project).

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to create this as a subtask.

due_string.description: Natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_date.description: Explicit due datetime (overrides due_string if both provided).

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the due date/time (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

label_ids.description: List of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID) to apply to the task.

tools.name: todoist_task_get
tools.description: Retrieves either a single task by task_id or a filtered list of tasks in the connection’s workspace, returning results sorted as requested and paged with limit and an opaque cursor (omit cursor for the first page; the response includes the next cursor when more results exist). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter combinations or formats (including invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed ids), and NOT_FOUND when task_id is provided but no matching task exists in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to read from.

task_id.description: Specific task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to fetch.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search string to filter tasks.

project_id.description: Filter by project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Filter by section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

parent_task_id.description: Filter by parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to list subtasks.

label_ids.description: Filter to tasks that have these label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: todoist_task_update
tools.description: Updates a single task identified by task_id or, when task_id is omitted, by resolving query to exactly one matching task, and returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither task_id nor query is provided, if query matches zero or multiple tasks, if any ids/enums/formats are invalid, or if section_id is provided without a compatible project_id/relationship; raises NOT_FOUND if the target task (or referenced project/section/labels) does not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT when the requested move or hierarchy/state change is not permitted (for example, moving into an incompatible section/project pairing).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

task_id.description: Task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to update.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search used to find a single task to update when task_id is not provided.

due_string.description: New natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_date.description: New explicit due datetime.

due_timezone.description: New IANA timezone for due date/time.

label_ids.description: Replace labels with this set of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

project_id.description: Move task to this project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Move task to this section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

iterations.description: Number of times to repeat each measured operation.

tools.name: list_laravel_docs
tools.description: Lists documentation entries available in the local cache, optionally filtered to a single Laravel version, and returns the matching filenames/paths for discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the version format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the requested version is not present in the cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the documentation index is not permitted.

tools.name: search_laravel_docs
tools.description: Runs a full-text search for the required query across cached Laravel docs and, when include_external is true, supported external Laravel service docs; returns matching documents with per-document hit counts. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query or invalid version, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching is not permitted.

tools.name: update_laravel_docs
tools.description: Syncs documentation from upstream sources into the local versioned cache for the requested version (or the default set when version is null) and returns a summary of what was updated; when force is true, it re-syncs even if the cache appears current. This operation is not paged and returns one update result per version/source processed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to run sync operations, CONFLICT if an update is already in progress for the same target, and NOT_FOUND if a specific requested version cannot be resolved or synced from supported sources.

tools.name: laravel_docs_info
tools.description: Returns metadata about the cached documentation set (or a specific version), including last sync/update timestamps and upstream commit identifiers when available. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, NOT_FOUND if the requested version has no cached metadata, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to documentation state is not permitted.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_recommendations
tools.description: Returns a curated set of package recommendations based on the provided use_case text, including suggested packages and rationale aligned to the catalog’s categories. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if use_case is missing/blank, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to recommendations is not permitted, and NOT_FOUND if no recommendations can be produced from the current catalog.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_info
tools.description: Returns the catalog record for the requested package_name, including a normalized name, description, installation/usage notes when available, and any assigned categories. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package_name is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the curated catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package details is not permitted.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_categories
tools.description: Lists all catalog packages that belong to the required category and returns their basic details for comparison/discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the category does not exist or contains no packages in the catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the package catalog is not permitted.

tools.name: get_features_for_laravel_package
tools.description: Returns common implementation features/patterns associated with the requested package from the curated catalog (for example, typical use cases, integration points, and recommended setup steps when available). The response is a single object or feature list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the catalog or has no feature entry, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package feature details is not permitted.

tools.name: read_laravel_doc_content
tools.description: Fetches and returns the full text content for a specific documentation file identified by filename, optionally within a specific version. The response is a single document (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is missing/blank or version is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the version or file does not exist in the local cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to read documentation content.

tools.name: search_laravel_docs_with_context
tools.description: Runs a full-text search for query across cached docs (and optionally external docs) and returns matches along with a context snippet around each hit, sized by context_length. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query, invalid version, or non-positive/invalid context_length, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching or reading snippets is not permitted.

tools.name: get_doc_structure
tools.description: Returns the parsed structure for a single documentation file (by filename) including its sections/headings for the requested version, falling back to the default synced version when version is null. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read documentation.

tools.name: browse_docs_by_category
tools.description: Lists documentation entries within a given category for the requested version (or the default synced version when version is null) and returns the category’s documents/sections in browse order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is empty/unknown or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the category has no documents for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to browse documentation.

tools.name: update_external_laravel_docs
tools.description: Syncs and updates the locally-cached documentation for supported external Laravel services (Forge/Vapor/Envoyer/Nova, etc.) and returns a per-service result (updated/skipped/error) along with sync metadata; when services is null it targets all services, and force=true re-fetches even if sources appear up to date. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any requested service key is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks sync privileges, CONFLICT if a sync job for the same service(s) is already in progress, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if sync quotas or upstream rate limits are exceeded.

tools.name: list_laravel_services
tools.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of external Laravel services known to the system, optionally filtered by status and/or key and sorted by the requested field; the response includes up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid status/sort/order, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service sources.

key.description: Filter by service key (e.g., forge, vapor, envoy, nova).

limit.description: Maximum number of services to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: search_external_laravel_docs
tools.description: Executes a full-text search over cached external Laravel service documentation for the given query, optionally restricted to the provided service keys, and returns matching documents/sections with relevance ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or any service key is unknown, NOT_FOUND if none of the requested services exist in the catalog, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to search, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when search rate limits are exceeded.

tools.name: get_laravel_service_info
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single external Laravel service (key, display name, source status, and sync/search availability details). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if service is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the service key is not recognized, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service details.

tools.name: memory_delete_relations

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.name: list-events
tools.description: Lists calendar events between timeMin and timeMax for the Google OAuth connection identified by accessToken and returns up to maxResults events (if provided), along with any paging token/marker the service uses to fetch the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when timeMin/timeMax are not valid ISO timestamps, timeMin is after timeMax, or maxResults is not a positive number; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is missing/invalid/expired or does not match a stored OAuth connection. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate limits are hit and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google Calendar cannot be reached or rejects the request.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: Fetches a single calendar event by eventId using the OAuth connection identified by accessToken and returns the event details from Google (and may read/update the local cache/log for that event). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when eventId is empty or accessToken is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection. Raises NOT_FOUND when no event with eventId exists or is not accessible to the connected account, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google Calendar fails the lookup for non-404 reasons.

tools.name: create-event
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with summary, startTime, endTime and optional description/location/attendees/timeZone using the OAuth connection identified by accessToken, and returns the created event (recording the request/response and normalizing attendee emails). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, startTime/endTime are not valid ISO timestamps, endTime is not after startTime, timeZone is invalid, or attendees contains non-email values; raises UNAUTHORIZED when accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate limits are exceeded, CONFLICT when Google rejects the create due to calendar state/constraints (for example, duplicate iCalUID or other write conflicts), and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Google Calendar API failures.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity resolved from accessToken, including the associated oauth_connection id, status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for that connection. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection; refuses with FORBIDDEN when the connection is revoked.

includeQuota.description: When true, include rolling-window request counts and remaining allowance for the current 60-second window.

tools.name: list-oauth-connections
tools.description: Lists stored OAuth connections visible to the caller (typically the connection resolved from accessToken) with optional filtering by status/provider and standard pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

provider.description: Filter by OAuth provider.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by.

tools.name: update-oauth-connection-status
tools.description: Transitions an OAuth connection to a new lifecycle status (active/revoked/error) as allowed by the service. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when the transition is not permitted; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

oauthConnectionId.description: ID of the stored OAuth connection to update.

status.description: New status to set; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

errorMessage.description: Optional human-readable error description when setting status='error'.

tools.name: update-event-status
tools.description: Updates the local cached event status via allowed lifecycle transitions (tentative/confirmed/cancelled/deleted_local) without calling Google, and returns the updated local event record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the local event id is unknown; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when the requested status transition is not permitted; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

status.description: New local status to set; must be a valid lifecycle transition.

note.description: Optional audit note describing why the status was changed.

tools.name: list-api-requests
tools.description: Lists API request logs for the OAuth connection identified by accessToken, optionally filtered by toolName/status/time window, and returns paginated results. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

startedAfter.description: Filter to requests with started_at >= this ISO timestamp.

startedBefore.description: Filter to requests with started_at <= this ISO timestamp.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: get-oauth-connection
tools.description: Fetches a single stored OAuth connection by id and returns its metadata (never returns raw tokens). Refuses with NOT_FOUND when no such connection exists; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the accessToken is invalid/expired or not associated with a stored OAuth connection.

oauthConnectionId.description: ID of the stored OAuth connection.

tools.name: getVideoDetails
tools.description: Returns cached details for a single YouTube video (and refreshes from YouTube and upserts the cache when missing or stale), including core metadata and latest available statistics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the video identifier is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks access to the backend, NOT_FOUND when the video does not exist or is not retrievable from YouTube, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but the YouTube API quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube is temporarily unavailable or returns an unexpected response during refresh.

tools.name: searchVideos
tools.description: Searches YouTube for videos matching the provided query and returns a paged list of result items with basic metadata; results are returned in relevance order and use page tokens (next/prev) for pagination when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the query or pagination inputs are missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to use search, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream YouTube search call is required but quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube search fails or times out.

tools.name: getTranscripts
tools.description: Returns transcripts/captions for the requested videos as text assets from cache, fetching and upserting missing/stale transcripts when possible, and returns results per video (including when a transcript is unavailable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any video identifier is malformed or the batch is empty/too large, UNAUTHORIZED when transcript access is not permitted, and NOT_FOUND when a referenced video cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable upstream. Raises CONFLICT when transcripts are not available for a video (e.g., captions disabled/none) and the request requires a transcript, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when an upstream fetch is needed but cannot be completed.

tools.name: getRelatedVideos
tools.description: Returns a paged list of videos related to the specified seed video, using cached related lists when fresh and refreshing from YouTube recommendations when missing or stale; pagination is provided via page tokens when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the seed video identifier is missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access related-video lookups, and NOT_FOUND when the seed video does not exist or cannot be retrieved. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream failures.

tools.name: getChannelStatistics
tools.description: Returns cached statistics for multiple channels (e.g., subscriber_count, view_count, video_count) and refreshes missing/stale channel rows from YouTube before returning per-channel results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when channel identifiers are malformed or the request exceeds allowed batch limits, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to access channel stats, and NOT_FOUND when a channel cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable from YouTube. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when refresh is required but YouTube quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for upstream fetch failures.

tools.name: getChannelTopVideos
tools.description: Returns a list of the channel’s top videos ordered by popularity (typically by view_count), served from cache when fresh and refreshed from YouTube when missing or stale; lists are paged using page tokens/limits when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the channel identifier or paging inputs are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access channel video listings, and NOT_FOUND when the channel does not exist or cannot be retrieved. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is needed but quota is exhausted, and UPSTREAM_ERROR on upstream failures.

tools.name: getVideoEngagementRatio
tools.description: Returns per-video engagement metrics derived from cached statistics (e.g., view_count, like_count, comment_count) plus the computed engagement_ratio, refreshing missing/stale stats from YouTube when configured to do so. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any video identifier is malformed or batch limits are exceeded, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to read analytics, and NOT_FOUND when a video cannot be resolved in cache and is not retrievable upstream. Raises CONFLICT when an engagement ratio cannot be computed due to missing required stats (e.g., disabled likes/comments) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when a refresh is required but cannot be completed.

tools.name: getTrendingVideos
tools.description: Returns a paged list of currently trending videos for the requested region and optional category, using cached trending snapshots when fresh and refreshing from YouTube when missing or stale; pagination is provided via page tokens/limits when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when region/category/paging inputs are invalid (including unsupported category IDs), UNAUTHORIZED when trending access is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when an upstream refresh is required but YouTube quota is exhausted. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when YouTube trending retrieval fails.

tools.name: compareVideos
tools.description: Compares 2–50 videos by the requested metrics and returns a sorted side-by-side comparison table, accepting either YouTube video IDs or cached video row IDs and optionally including basic channel info; when listing-like output is produced it is fully returned for the requested set (no pagination) and respects sort_by/sort_order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when neither (or both) of youtube_video_ids/video_ids are provided, IDs fail validation, the list size is outside 2–50, metrics/sort inputs are invalid, or max_stale_seconds is negative; raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot access video analytics. Raises NOT_FOUND when any referenced video cannot be resolved (in cache or upstream when refresh=auto/force), CONFLICT when refresh=none is used but required cached stats are missing for the requested metrics, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/UPSTREAM_ERROR when refresh triggers upstream calls that cannot be completed.

youtube_video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to compare (11-char YouTube IDs).

video_ids.description: List of cached video row IDs to compare (videos.id ULIDs).

include_channel.description: Whether to include basic channel information for each video in the comparison.

refresh.description: Controls cache refresh behavior: auto refreshes stale/missing, force always refetches, none uses cache only.

max_stale_seconds.description: If provided, treat cached stats older than this as stale and eligible for refresh (when refresh=auto).

metrics.description: Which metrics to return in the comparison; defaults to core statistics if omitted.

sort_by.description: Metric to sort the compared videos by.

tools.name: listVideos
tools.description: Lists cached video rows with optional filters and cursor pagination. Returns only cached data and does not fetch from YouTube; use getVideoDetails/getChannelTopVideos/getTrendingVideos to materialize/refresh. Refuses invalid filters or page sizes (VALIDATION_ERROR) and requests without access (UNAUTHORIZED).

channel_id.description: Filter by cached channel row ID (channels.id ULID).

youtube_channel_id.description: Filter by YouTube channel ID; matches videos whose parent channel has this youtube_channel_id.

published_after.description: Return videos published at or after this timestamp.

published_before.description: Return videos published at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: listChannels
tools.description: Lists cached channel rows with optional filters and cursor pagination. Returns only cached data and does not fetch from YouTube; use getChannelStatistics to refresh statistics when needed. Refuses invalid filters/page sizes (VALIDATION_ERROR) and requests without access (UNAUTHORIZED).

country.description: Filter by 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) when present on the channel.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title/custom_url when supported.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getVideoById
tools.description: Fetches a single cached video row by its internal row ID (videos.id). Returns the video record as stored (no refresh). Raises NOT_FOUND when the row does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the ID is malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED when access is not permitted.

tools.name: updateVideoStatus
tools.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a cached video row (videos.status) using an allowed transition (active↔unavailable, active/unavailable→deleted). Returns the updated row. Refuses illegal transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), missing rows (NOT_FOUND), and unauthorized updates (UNAUTHORIZED).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason to record alongside audit/logging (if enabled).

tools.name: updateChannelStatus
tools.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a cached channel row (channels.status) using an allowed transition (active↔disabled, active/disabled→deleted). Returns the updated row. Refuses illegal transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR), missing rows (NOT_FOUND), and unauthorized updates (UNAUTHORIZED).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason to record alongside audit/logging (if enabled).

tools.name: getSpreadsheet
tools.description: Resolves the Google Spreadsheet identified by the provided URL and returns its discovered metadata (spreadsheet identity and title) along with the full list of sheets in the spreadsheet; this endpoint does not paginate results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or not a valid spreadsheet URL, NOT_FOUND if the spreadsheet cannot be resolved or accessed with the current credentials, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream spreadsheet API quota is exceeded.

url.description: スプレッドシートのURL

tools.name: getSheetData
tools.description: Returns the cell data snapshot for the specified `sheetName` within the spreadsheet identified by `url`, serving from cache when available and otherwise refreshing the snapshot from the source. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` or `sheetName` is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the spreadsheet cannot be resolved or the named sheet does not exist in that spreadsheet, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream spreadsheet API quota is exceeded.

url.description: スプレッドシートのURL

tools.name: listSpreadsheets
tools.description: Lists tracked spreadsheets, optionally filtered by provider, status, or URL match. Returns a paginated result set ordered by most recently updated first. Refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT for malformed filters and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

provider.description: Filter by spreadsheet provider.

urlContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the original URL.

normalizedUrl.description: Exact match against the normalized URL.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: getSpreadsheetById
tools.description: Fetches a single tracked spreadsheet by its internal `id`. Returns the spreadsheet record including its current status and sync/error fields. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such spreadsheet exists and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: updateSpreadsheet
tools.description: Updates mutable fields of a tracked spreadsheet, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions via `status`. Returns the updated spreadsheet. Refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid transitions or fields, and NOT_FOUND if the spreadsheet id does not exist.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

title.description: Override the stored spreadsheet title (typically managed by discovery).

tools.name: listSheetDataSnapshots
tools.description: Lists cached sheet data snapshots for a resolved spreadsheet + sheet, newest first. Use this to inspect cache history and freshness decisions. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the spreadsheet or sheet cannot be resolved, INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid inputs, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

url.description: スプレッドシートのURL

rangeA1.description: Optional exact match filter for A1 range (e.g. Sheet1!A1:Z100).

pageSize.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return per page.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tools.name: updateSheet
tools.description: Updates mutable fields of a sheet record, including driving allowed lifecycle transitions via `status` (e.g. active↔hidden). Returns the updated sheet. Refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid transitions, name conflicts (unique within spreadsheet), or invalid fields; and NOT_FOUND if the sheet id does not exist.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

name.description: Rename the sheet. Must remain unique within the parent spreadsheet.

index.description: Zero-based sheet index within the spreadsheet.

query.description: Search query for finding MCP servers. You can either write keywords if you want something broad or are referencing a specific server by name, or you can write a detailed description (1-2 sentences) specifying exactly what you are looking for. We perform hybrid search.

tools.name: use_tool
tools.description: Executes a named tool on the specified MCP server (qualifiedName) with the provided arguments and returns the tool’s response while recording the invocation with request/response payloads and status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if qualifiedName or tool name is missing/invalid or arguments are not an object, NOT_FOUND if the server or tool does not exist in the registry, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to invoke tools on that server. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if invocation limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if an invocation is refused due to server/tool state that prevents execution.

qualifiedName.description: The qualified name of the server to use

name.description: The name of the tool to call

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: Lists MCP servers in the registry with optional filtering and pagination. Returns only servers the caller is permitted to view; by default returns published servers. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the registry and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

status.description: Filter servers by lifecycle status. If omitted, defaults to 'published'.

category.description: Filter to servers that include this category.

tag.description: Filter to servers that include this tag.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (default: 20, max: 100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Fetches a single MCP server by id. Returns the full server record including metadata and status. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if no such server exists or the caller cannot access it, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access the registry.

tools.name: upsert_mcp_server
tools.description: Creates a new MCP server record (when id is omitted) or updates an existing server (when id is provided). Enforces qualified_name uniqueness and immutability once status is 'published'; attempts to rename a published server are refused with VALIDATION_ERROR. qualified_name.description: Globally unique qualified server name (immutable once published). Required on create.

tags.description: Tags for filtering and structured boosts in search.

endpoint_url.description: Base endpoint URL where the MCP server is reachable.

auth_type.description: Authentication type expected by the server.

popularity_score.description: Optional popularity signal used for ranking/boosting.

search_document.description: Searchable document text used for hybrid search indexing.

status.description: Desired lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions.

tools.name: transition_mcp_server_status

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

benefits: Eliminates thundering herd by deferring cache-miss fetches until queues clear backpressure
Back-pressure kernel prevents DB connection pool saturation during spikes
Tiered caching reduces scope and complexity of changes for cutover
Distributed read pattern avoids single-point cache contention
tradeoffs: Slightly higher latency for cold cache reads (acceptable given degraded read semantics)
Job queue requires monitoring and alerting maintenance
Requires careful capacity planning for queue throughput and tail latencies

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Searches YouTube (using cache when fresh, or refetching when refresh=true) for videos matching the required query, optionally constrained by region_code, channel (channel_id or youtube_channel_id), and published_after/published_before, and returns up to limit results plus a next page_token when more results are available. Results are paged with the opaque page_token from a prior response; omit page_token to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including date range), NOT_FOUND if channel_id does not exist in our cache, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller’s search/fetch budget is exhausted (especially when refresh=true triggers a YouTube fetch).

query.description: Free-text search query to send to YouTube and/or match cached results.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code used to localize search results (e.g., US, GB).

channel_id.description: Internal channel ULID to restrict results to a cached channel.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...) to restrict results to a channel.

published_after.description: Only return videos published after this timestamp.

published_before.description: Only return videos published before this timestamp.

safe_search.description: SafeSearch level to apply to search results.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of results.

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache/staleness heuristics and refetch from YouTube.

tools.name: get_video_details
tools.description: Returns the cached materialized view of a single video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id), and when refresh=true it refetches and updates our cached entity before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or an identifier fails validation, NOT_FOUND if the referenced internal video_id is unknown (or the YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access this operation, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refetch is required but the caller has no remaining fetch quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch details for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch details for.

refresh.description: If true, refetch video details from YouTube even if cached.

tools.name: get_channel_details
tools.description: Returns detailed channel information resolved by youtube_channel_id, internal channel_id, or handle, using cached data when available and refetching when refresh=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if none of the identifiers are provided or handle/IDs are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the internal channel_id does not exist in our cache or the handle/YouTube channel cannot be resolved, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to access channel lookups, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when a YouTube refetch is needed but the caller has no remaining quota.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...) to fetch details for.

channel_id.description: Internal channel ULID to fetch details for.

handle.description: Channel handle (e.g., @somecreator) to resolve and fetch details for.

refresh.description: If true, refetch channel details from YouTube even if cached.

tools.name: get_video_comments
tools.description: Returns top-level comments for a video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id) ordered by order, optionally including replies, with up to limit items and an opaque page_token for pagination when more comments are available; refresh=true forces a refetch before returning. Pagination is driven exclusively by page_token values returned by this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or invalid paging/limit values, NOT_FOUND if the internal video_id is unknown (or the YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access comments, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if fetching/updating comments from YouTube is required but the caller is over quota (more likely with include_replies=true or refresh=true).

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch comments for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch comments for.

order.description: Ordering of comments as returned by YouTube.

limit.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of comments.

include_replies.description: If true, include replies where available (may increase fetch cost).

refresh.description: If true, refetch comments from YouTube even if cached.

tools.name: get_video_transcript
tools.description: Returns a video transcript/captions (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id) in the requested format (text or segments), optionally selecting language and allowing auto-generated captions; refresh=true forces re-extraction/refetch before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or unsupported format values, NOT_FOUND when the internal video_id is unknown, the video cannot be resolved, or no transcript is available under the requested language/auto-generated constraints, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access transcripts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a refetch is required but the caller has exhausted transcript/fetch quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to fetch transcript/captions for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to fetch transcript/captions for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US).

include_auto_generated.description: If true, allow auto-generated captions when human captions are unavailable.

format.description: Return transcript as plain text or as timed segments.

refresh.description: If true, refetch transcript from source even if cached.

tools.name: get_related_videos
tools.description: Returns a list of videos related to the specified video (by youtube_video_id or internal video_id), localized by optional region_code and language, with up to limit results and a next page_token when additional related items exist; refresh=true bypasses cache and refetches. Pagination uses the opaque page_token provided by a previous response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers or invalid paging/limit values, NOT_FOUND if the internal video_id is unknown (or the seed YouTube video cannot be resolved), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access related-video discovery, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a YouTube refetch is needed but the caller is out of quota.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to find related videos for.

video_id.description: Internal video ULID to find related videos for.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to localize related video results.

language.description: Preferred relevance language for related videos (e.g., en).

limit.description: Maximum number of related videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of related videos.

refresh.description: If true, refetch related videos from YouTube even if cached.

region_code.description: Two-letter region code to fetch trending videos for (e.g., US).

category_id.description: Optional YouTube category ID to restrict trending results.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending videos to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token for the next page of trending results.

refresh.description: If true, refetch trending list from YouTube even if cached.

tools.name: get_video_enhanced_transcript
tools.description: Extracts transcripts for multiple videos (provide either youtube_video_ids or video_ids), optionally filtering by start_time_seconds/end_time_seconds, search_query, and segment_size_seconds, and returns results in the requested format (text, segments, or detailed) with optional cached video metadata; refresh=true forces refetch/re-extraction before returning. youtube_video_ids.description: List of YouTube video IDs to extract transcripts for.

video_ids.description: List of internal video ULIDs to extract transcripts for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US).

include_auto_generated.description: If true, allow auto-generated captions when human captions are unavailable.

start_time_seconds.description: If set, only include transcript content at or after this time offset.

end_time_seconds.description: If set, only include transcript content at or before this time offset.

search_query.description: If set, only include transcript segments matching this text query.

segment_size_seconds.description: If set, group transcript into segments of approximately this duration.

format.description: Output format for enhanced transcript results.

include_video_metadata.description: If true, include cached video metadata alongside transcript output.

refresh.description: If true, refetch transcripts from source even if cached.
