tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: Fetches a single tweet record for the given connected X account, returning the stored tweet when tweet_id is provided or fetching/ingesting by x_tweet_id when needed and then returning the ingested record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither tweet_id nor x_tweet_id is provided or if ids fail their expected formats, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the referenced tweet does not exist (or the provider tweet cannot be retrieved), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded configured limits for provider fetch/ingest.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authentication and rate/quota enforcement.

tweet_id.description: Internal tweet record id to fetch from storage.

x_tweet_id.description: Provider (X) tweet id to fetch and ingest if not already stored.

tools.name: generate_reply
tools.description: Generates and returns an AI reply draft for the connected X account in the requested mode, either replying to a stored target tweet (mode=to_tweet) or to a free-form input message (mode=to_message). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required mode-specific inputs are missing (target_tweet_id for to_tweet, input_message for to_message) or if temperature is < 0, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if target_tweet_id does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded reply-generation quotas.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for quota enforcement and defaults (e.g., language).

mode.description: Generation mode determining whether the input is a tweet target or a free-form message.

target_tweet_id.description: Target internal tweet id to generate a reply for (required when mode is to_tweet).

input_message.description: Free-form message to reply to (required when mode is to_message).

model.description: Model identifier to use for reply generation.

tools.name: generate_reply_to_tweet
tools.description: Generates and returns an AI reply draft to a tweet for the connected X account, using tweet_id when provided or fetching/ingesting by x_tweet_id if the tweet is not already stored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither tweet_id nor x_tweet_id is provided or if temperature is < 0, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if the tweet cannot be found (internally or from the provider), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded reply-generation or provider fetch/ingest quotas.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for quota enforcement and defaults (e.g., language).

tweet_id.description: Internal tweet id to generate a reply suggestion to.

x_tweet_id.description: Provider (X) tweet id to generate a reply suggestion to (will be fetched/ingested if needed).

model.description: Model identifier to use for reply generation.

tools.name: post_tweet
tools.description: Posts a new tweet from the specified connected X account with the provided body_text and optional media, returning the created outbound post record (including its provider identifiers when available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body_text is empty/invalid or media payload is not acceptable, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible or is not permitted to post, CONFLICT if posting is refused due to account state (e.g., disconnected/disabled), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded posting limits.

account_id.description: Connected X account id to post from.

body_text.description: Text content of the tweet to post.

media.description: Optional media payload to attach to the post.

tools.name: post_reply_to_tweet
tools.description: Posts a reply from the specified connected X account to a target tweet identified by in_reply_to_tweet_id (stored) or in_reply_to_x_tweet_id (provider), with body_text and optional media, and returns the created outbound reply record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither reply target identifier is provided, if body_text is empty/invalid, or if media payload is not acceptable, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible or is not permitted to post, NOT_FOUND if the reply target tweet cannot be resolved (internally or from the provider), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded posting or provider fetch/ingest limits.

account_id.description: Connected X account id to post the reply from.

in_reply_to_tweet_id.description: Internal tweet id being replied to.

in_reply_to_x_tweet_id.description: Provider (X) tweet id being replied to (used if internal tweet id is not available).

body_text.description: Text content of the reply to post.

media.description: Optional media payload (e.g., image) to attach to the reply.

tools.name: search_tweets
tools.description: Searches X for tweets matching query_text for the given connected account, ingesting results into storage and returning a page of tweet records up to limit along with an opaque cursor for pagination when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query_text is empty/invalid, limit is < 1, or cursor is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the account has exceeded search or ingest limits.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authentication and rate/quota enforcement.

query_text.description: X search query string used to find tweets.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to request/ingest for this search.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue a previous search.

tools.name: list_tweets
tools.description: Lists stored tweet records visible to the specified connected X account, with optional filtering by source_type and conversation/reply relationships. Returns a paginated list ordered by observed_at (desc). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authorization and rate/quota enforcement.

source_type.description: Filter by how the tweet was ingested/stored.

author_handle.description: Filter by tweet author handle (case-insensitive exact match).

conversation_x_tweet_id.description: Filter by provider conversation id (thread root) when known.

in_reply_to_x_tweet_id.description: Filter to tweets that reply to the specified provider tweet id.

posted_by_account_id.description: Filter to tweets posted by the specified connected account (stored posts only).

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous list response.

tools.name: list_outbound_posts
tools.description: Lists outbound post records (tweets and replies) for the specified connected X account with optional status filtering. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at (desc). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authorization and quota enforcement.

status.description: Filter by outbound post lifecycle status.

in_reply_to_tweet_id.description: Filter to replies targeting the given internal tweet id.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous list response.

tools.name: update_outbound_post
tools.description: Updates an outbound post record for the specified connected X account, supporting lifecycle transitions (draft→queued/cancelled, queued→cancelled, failed→queued/cancelled) and editable draft fields where allowed. Returns the updated outbound post. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields or invalid status transitions, UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible, NOT_FOUND if outbound_post_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if attempting to modify a post in a terminal/immutable state (sending/published/cancelled).

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authorization.

outbound_post_id.description: Internal outbound post id to update.

status.description: Requested new status. Only lifecycle-valid transitions are accepted; 'sending'/'published'/'failed' are provider-driven and cannot be set by callers.

body_text.description: Updated text body (allowed only while status is draft; must be <= 280 characters for X).

media.description: Updated media payload (allowed only while status is draft; must be an image payload accepted by the provider adapter).

tools.name: list_reply_generations
tools.description: Lists AI reply generation records for the specified connected X account with optional status/mode filtering. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at (desc). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account_id is not accessible.

account_id.description: Connected X account id used for authorization and quota enforcement.

target_tweet_id.description: Filter to generations targeting the given internal tweet id.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous list response.

tools.name: get_auth_context
tools.description: Returns the calling identity for this request, including accessible connected X accounts, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the presented credentials are invalid or expired.

account_id.description: Optional connected X account id to scope quota/rate-limit reporting to a single account.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to fetch fields for (defaults to the account's default workspace when omitted).

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameters (including out-of-range limit or unsupported sort values), NOT_FOUND if the account or specified workspace does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account/workspace; may raise RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty conversation_body, invalid ids, or attempts to set unsupported fields, NOT_FOUND if the account or conversation does not exist under that account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the conversation. Raises CONFLICT when the conversation or its parent ticket is in a non-editable state (for example deleted/locked) and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

conversation_id.description: Local conversation record id to update.

private.description: Whether the conversation/note should be private.

tools.name: list_all_ticket_conversation
tools.description: Lists conversations for a ticket, optionally filtered by conversation_type and/or private, sorted per sort, and returns a page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist (use limit and cursor for pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if the account or ticket does not exist under that account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view the ticket’s conversations. Raises RATE_LIMITED when tenant read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

ticket_id.description: Local ticket id to list conversations for.

private.description: Filter by whether conversation is private.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_all_products
tools.description: Lists product replicas for the account, optionally filtered by workspace_id and status, sorted per sort, and returns a page of products with an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist (use limit and cursor for pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read catalog/KB data for the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when tenant read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

workspace_id.description: Only return products for the given workspace id.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_products_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves a single product replica by product_id and returns the product record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist or the product_id is not present under that account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read the product. Raises RATE_LIMITED when tenant read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Creates a new product under the account (and associates it to workspace_id when provided) and returns the created product record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, ids are invalid, or workspace_id is not valid for the account, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create products. Raises CONFLICT when a product with the same identity/name is not allowed by server uniqueness rules and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id that owns the product.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the product under.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Updates fields on an existing product replica (workspace_id, name, description, status) and returns the updated product record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, invalid status, or empty/invalid field values, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist or the product_id is not found under that account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update products. Raises CONFLICT if the requested status change is not allowed (for example transitioning from deleted) or if the update would violate uniqueness rules, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id that owns the product.

product_id.description: Local replicated product id to update (catalog_and_kb.id).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to associate the product to.

status.description: Local status to set for the product replica.

tools.name: create_requester
tools.description: Creates a requester (end user) record for the account and returns the created requester replica, including any provided profile fields and custom_fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name is missing/empty, ids are invalid, or field shapes are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create requesters. Raises CONFLICT when the email (when provided) is already in use by an existing requester within the account per server uniqueness rules and RATE_LIMITED when tenant write limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id that owns the requester.

custom_fields.description: Requester custom fields payload.

tools.name: get_all_requesters
tools.description: Lists requester replicas for the account, optionally filtered by status and sorted by sort_by/sort_order, returning a page of results with an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist (use limit and cursor for pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read requester data. Raises RATE_LIMITED when tenant read limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to fetch requesters for.

limit.description: Maximum number of requesters to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

status.description: Filter by local requester replica status.

tools.name: get_requester_id
tools.description: Returns the requester (people_and_groups) record for the given requester_id within the specified account_id, including its core fields and any stored custom_fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/requester_id do not match the required formats, UNAUTHORIZED if the requester does not belong to the account, and NOT_FOUND if no requester with that id exists in the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id that owns the requester.

tools.name: list_all_requester_fields
tools.description: Lists the requester field definitions configured for the given account_id and returns the full collection in a single response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that tenant.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to list requester field definitions for.

tools.name: update_requester
tools.description: Updates the specified requester replica under account_id and returns the updated requester record. Validates supplied fields (including status ∈ active|inactive|deleted) and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values or an empty update payload, UNAUTHORIZED if the requester is not owned by the account, NOT_FOUND if requester_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update attempts an invalid state transition (for example modifying a requester already marked deleted).

account_id.description: Freshservice account id that owns the requester.

custom_fields.description: Updated requester custom fields payload.

status.description: Local status to set for the requester replica.

tools.name: filter_requesters
tools.description: Searches requesters within account_id using the provided filters (query matches name/email, email is exact match, and active/status filter by flags) and returns a page of results ordered by sort_by/sort_order. Pagination is cursor-based: limit controls page size (1–200) and cursor returns the next page when provided; the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/sort values or malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that tenant.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to filter requesters for.

query.description: Free-text query to match against requester name/email.

status.description: Filter by local requester replica status.

limit.description: Maximum number of requesters to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Creates a new agent (people_and_groups) under account_id from the provided agent fields and returns the created agent record with its assigned local id and timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields (name, email) are missing/invalid or extra fields are provided, UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot create agents in the tenant, and CONFLICT if an agent with the same email already exists in that account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to create the agent under.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields payload for the agent.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Returns the agent record for agent_id within account_id, including core attributes and custom_fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/agent_id formats are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the agent is not owned by the account, and NOT_FOUND if no such agent exists.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

agent_id.description: Local person/group record id for the agent.

tools.name: get_all_agents
tools.description: Lists agents for account_id and returns a single page of results sorted by sort_by/sort_order. Pagination is cursor-based: limit controls the number of agents returned (1–200) and cursor fetches the next page; the response includes a next_cursor when additional results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/sort values or malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that tenant.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tools.name: filter_agents
tools.description: Filters agents within account_id using the provided query string and returns a page of matching agents sorted by sort_by/sort_order. Pagination is cursor-based with limit (1–200) and cursor, and the response includes next_cursor when more matches are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query, invalid paging/sort parameters, or a malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that tenant.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

query.description: Filter query string to match Freshservice agent search semantics.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Updates the specified agent under account_id with the provided agent fields and returns the updated agent record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty update payload or invalid field values, UNAUTHORIZED if the agent is not owned by the account, NOT_FOUND if agent_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update would violate uniqueness constraints (for example email already used by another agent in the same account).

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

agent_id.description: Local person/group record id for the agent to update.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields payload for the agent.

tools.name: get_agent_fields
tools.description: Lists the agent field definitions configured for the given account_id and returns the full collection in a single response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid and UNAUTHORIZED if you do not have access to that tenant.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

tools.name: get_all_agent_groups
tools.description: Lists agent groups for the specified Freshservice tenant and returns a cursor-paged result set ordered by the requested sort field and direction (use limit and cursor to page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id, limit, cursor, sort_by, or sort_order are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant-level throttles are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

limit.description: Maximum number of agent groups to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

sort_by.description: Field to sort agent groups by.

tools.name: getAgentGroupById
tools.description: Fetches a single agent group by local group_id within the given tenant and returns the group record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or group_id is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant; raises NOT_FOUND if no group with that id exists in the tenant or the id refers to a non-group entity.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant).

group_id.description: Local person/group record id for the agent group.

tools.name: add_requester_to_group
tools.description: Adds the specified requester to a manual requester group and returns the updated group membership state (including the requester as a member). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or if the group is not a requester group or the requester_id is not a requester; raises NOT_FOUND if either record does not exist in the tenant; raises CONFLICT if the group is dynamic, inactive/deleted, or the requester is already a member; raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota rules are violated.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to operate under.

group_id.description: Local id of the requester group to add the requester to (people_and_groups.id where entity_type=group).

requester_id.description: Local id of the requester to add (people_and_groups.id where entity_type=requester).

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Creates a new group (agent_group or requester_group) in the tenant and returns the created group record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, if group_kind/group_visibility are unsupported, or if parent_group_id is not a group; raises NOT_FOUND if parent_group_id does not exist in the tenant; raises CONFLICT if a group with the same name and kind already exists in the tenant or if a dynamic group is requested where visibility rules are not met; raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota rules are violated.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to create the group under.

group_kind.description: Kind of group to create (agent group or requester group).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields payload for the group.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Updates an existing group by group_id and returns the updated group record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid (including illegal status values) or if group_kind/group_visibility changes are not supported for the current record; raises NOT_FOUND if the group does not exist in the tenant or the id refers to a non-group entity; raises CONFLICT when attempting forbidden state transitions (for example updating a deleted group, switching a dynamic group to manual or vice versa when not allowed, or introducing a parent cycle); raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota rules are violated.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to operate under.

group_id.description: Local id of the group to update (people_and_groups.id where entity_type=group).

group_visibility.description: Updated visibility type of the group.

parent_group_id.description: Updated parent group local id (people_and_groups.id), if any.

custom_fields.description: Updated custom fields payload for the group.

status.description: Local replica status for the group.

tools.name: get_all_requester_groups
tools.description: Lists requester groups for the tenant, optionally filtered by workspace_id, status, and visibility, and returns a cursor-paged result set ordered by the requested sort field and direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters, paging, or sorting parameters are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant; raises RATE_LIMITED when tenant-level throttles are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to list requester groups for.

workspace_id.description: Filter requester groups by workspace id.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination.

tools.name: get_requester_groups_by_id
tools.description: Bulk-fetches requester groups by local ids within the tenant and returns the matching group records (ids that do not resolve are not returned). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if group_ids is empty or contains malformed ids; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant; raises NOT_FOUND if none of the supplied ids exist in the tenant or if all supplied ids refer to non-group entities.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to fetch requester groups for.

group_ids.description: List of local requester group ids to fetch (people_and_groups.id).

tools.name: create_requester_group
tools.description: Creates a requester group in the tenant and returns the created group record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if name or other fields are invalid or if group_visibility is unsupported; raises NOT_FOUND if parent_group_id is provided but does not exist or is not a group; raises CONFLICT if a requester group with the same name already exists in the tenant or if requested visibility conflicts with group rules; raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota rules are violated.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to create the requester group under.

group_visibility.description: Visibility type of the requester group.

active.description: Whether the requester group is active.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields payload for the requester group.

tools.name: update_requester_group
tools.description: Updates a requester group by group_id and returns the updated group record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid (including illegal status values) or if group_visibility changes are not supported for the current record; raises NOT_FOUND if the group does not exist in the tenant or the id refers to a non-group entity; raises CONFLICT when attempting forbidden state transitions (for example updating a deleted group, changing membership rules for a dynamic group, or introducing a parent cycle); raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota rules are violated.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to operate under.

group_id.description: Local id of the requester group to update (people_and_groups.id).

name.description: Updated name of the requester group.

group_visibility.description: Updated visibility type of the requester group.

parent_group_id.description: Updated parent group local id (people_and_groups.id), if any.

active.description: Whether the requester group is active.

custom_fields.description: Updated custom fields payload for the requester group.

status.description: Local replica status for the requester group.

tools.name: list_requester_group_members
tools.description: Lists members (requesters) of the specified requester group and returns a cursor-paged result set ordered by the requested sort field and direction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id, group_id, paging, or sorting parameters are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the group does not exist in the tenant or is not a requester group; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the tenant, and RATE_LIMITED when tenant-level throttles are exceeded.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to list group members for.

group_id.description: Local id of the requester group whose members to list (people_and_groups.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination.

sort_by.description: Field to sort member results by.

tools.name: get_all_canned_response
tools.description: Lists canned responses for the given Freshservice account, optionally scoped by workspace and/or folder, filtered by status and search, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated page of records (use limit and the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter formats/enums (including non-existent cursors), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account/workspace, and NOT_FOUND if a provided folder_id does not exist in the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to scope canned responses.

folder_id.description: Optional canned response folder id to filter by (entity_type=canned_response_folder).

search.description: Free-text search over canned response name/description/body.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_canned_response
tools.description: Retrieves a single canned response by local canned_response_id or by vendor freshservice_id and returns the mirrored record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or if formats are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account, and NOT_FOUND if no canned response matches the supplied identifier within the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

freshservice_id.description: Vendor Freshservice canned response id (alternative to canned_response_id).

tools.name: list_all_canned_response_folder
tools.description: Lists canned response folders for the given Freshservice account, optionally scoped by workspace and/or parent_folder_id, filtered by status and search, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated page of folders. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter formats/enums (including non-existent cursors), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account/workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the provided parent_folder_id does not exist in the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to scope folders.

parent_folder_id.description: Optional parent folder id to filter by (entity_type=canned_response_folder).

search.description: Free-text search over folder name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

freshservice_id.description: Vendor Freshservice folder id (alternative to folder_id).

tools.description: Lists workspaces for the given Freshservice account, filtered by status and search, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated page of workspace records (limit controls page size; cursor continues the listing). account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

search.description: Free-text search over workspace name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Retrieves a single workspace by local workspace_id or by vendor freshservice_id and returns the mirrored workspace record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or if formats are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account, and NOT_FOUND if no workspace matches the supplied identifier within the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace record id (entity_type=workspace).

freshservice_id.description: Vendor Freshservice workspace id (alternative to workspace_id).

tools.name: get_all_solution_category
tools.description: Lists solution categories for the given Freshservice account, optionally scoped by workspace, filtered by status and search, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated page of categories. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter formats/enums (including non-existent cursors), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account/workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the provided workspace_id does not exist in the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to scope solution categories.

search.description: Free-text search over category name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_solution_category
tools.description: Retrieves a single solution category by local solution_category_id or by vendor freshservice_id and returns the mirrored category record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or if formats are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the account, and NOT_FOUND if no solution category matches the supplied identifier within the account.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id to scope the request.

freshservice_id.description: Vendor Freshservice solution category id (alternative to solution_category_id).

tools.name: create_solution_category
tools.description: Creates a solution category under the specified Freshservice account (and optional workspace) and returns the newly created mirrored category record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/invalid (including invalid visibility/status enums), UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create categories for the account/workspace, NOT_FOUND if a provided workspace_id does not exist in the account, and CONFLICT if a category with the same name already exists in the same account/workspace scope.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to create the solution category under.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id in Freshservice where the solution category should live.

tools.description: Updates an existing solution category identified by solution_category_id and returns the updated mirrored category record. account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) that owns the solution category.

solution_category_id.description: Local id of the solution category record to update.

solution_category_id.description: Local id of the parent solution category to list folders under.

tools.name: get_solution_folder
tools.description: Retrieves a single solution folder by id for the given account and returns the folder record. solution_folder_id.description: Local id of the solution folder to retrieve.

tools.description: Lists solution articles under the given solution folder for the specified account, returning a page of article records sorted by sort_by/sort_order and optionally filtered by status, draft, visibility, and tag; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises RATE_LIMITED when the tenant exceeds request limits.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to list solution articles for.

solution_folder_id.description: Local id of the parent solution folder to list articles under.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

visibility.description: Filter by visibility scope.

tag.description: Filter to articles containing this tag.

tools.name: get_solution_article
tools.description: Retrieves a single solution article by id for the given account and returns the article record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist for that account, and FORBIDDEN if the article exists but is not visible to the caller under the article’s visibility/workspace rules. Raises RATE_LIMITED when the tenant exceeds request limits.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) that owns the solution article.

solution_article_id.description: Local id of the solution article to retrieve.

tools.name: create_solution_article
tools.description: Creates a new solution article under the specified solution folder and returns the created article record, persisting any provided metadata (workspace_id, description, tags, visibility, draft, published_at, status, raw_payload). Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create in the folder due to visibility/workspace restrictions, CONFLICT if the requested lifecycle fields are inconsistent (for example, marking as published without a publishable state), and RATE_LIMITED if the tenant exceeds request limits.

account_id.description: Freshservice account id (tenant) to create the solution article under.

solution_folder_id.description: Local id of the parent solution folder to create the article under.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id in Freshservice where the solution article should live.

description.description: Short description/summary for the solution article.

body.description: Main content/body of the solution article.

tags.description: Tags to associate with the solution article.

visibility.description: Visibility scope for the solution article.

draft.description: Whether the article should be created as a draft.

published_at.description: Publish timestamp for the article, if publishing now or scheduling.

status.description: Local lifecycle status to store for the solution article.

raw_payload.description: Optional vendor payload to persist alongside the mirrored record.

tools.name: figma_get_me
tools.description: Returns the current Figma user profile for the given local account and, when `hydrate` is true, upserts the user into the local `figma_accounts` catalog; when `use_cache` is true, it may return a recently cached snapshot instead of calling Figma. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `account_id` is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the stored token for `account_id` is missing/expired/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks access, and NOT_FOUND when the local `account_id` does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when the upstream or local quota is exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

hydrate.description: If true, upsert the fetched user into the local figma_accounts catalog.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a recently cached snapshot when available.

tools.name: figma_get_file
tools.description: Fetches a Figma file by `file_key` (optionally for a specific `version`) and can limit the returned document via `ids`/`depth` and include `plugin_data`/`branch_data`; when `hydrate` is true it upserts/refreshes related local `figma_resources`, and when `snapshot` is true it persists the response in `figma_snapshots` (with `use_cache` allowing a fresh cached snapshot to be returned). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid parameters (including negative `depth`), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the `account_id` credentials are missing/invalid or lack access to the file, and NOT_FOUND when the file key (or specified version) does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

version.description: Specific file version id to fetch.

ids.description: Optional list of node ids to include (limits returned document tree).

depth.description: Optional traversal depth when returning document children.

plugin_data.description: Optional plugin id to include plugin data for.

branch_data.description: If true, include branch metadata in the response when supported.

hydrate.description: If true, upsert/refresh local figma_resources for the file and its related entities.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tools.name: figma_get_file_nodes
tools.description: Returns the specified node(s) from a Figma file for the given `ids` (optionally at a specific `version`) and may include children up to `depth`, optional `plugin_data`, and `geometry`; when `snapshot` is true it stores the payload in `figma_snapshots` and `use_cache` may return a fresh cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `ids` is empty, `depth` is invalid, or `geometry` is not supported, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks file access, and NOT_FOUND when the file, version, or requested node ids cannot be found/are not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upstream or local quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

ids.description: Node ids to fetch from the file.

version.description: Specific file version id to fetch nodes from.

depth.description: Optional traversal depth when returning node children.

plugin_data.description: Optional plugin id to include plugin data for.

geometry.description: Controls inclusion of vector geometry data where supported.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tools.name: figma_get_images
tools.description: Requests rendered image URLs for the given node `ids` in a file, in the requested `format` (optionally with `scale`, bounds and SVG options, and a specific `version`); when `snapshot` is true it stores the result in `figma_snapshots` and `use_cache` may return a fresh cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid parameters (including empty `ids`, invalid `format`, or `scale` < 0.01), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks file access, and NOT_FOUND when the file/version/node ids do not exist or are not accessible. tools.name: initialize_asr_got_graph
tools.description: Initializes a new ASR-GoT analysis session by creating the root node n₀ labeled "Task Understanding" and populating the full P1.12 metadata schema from the provided task description, confidence vector, and optional configuration. Returns the created graph/session identifiers plus the root node and stored metadata defaults as applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when task_description is missing/empty or initial_confidence is not a 4-item vector of numbers in [0,1], UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when session creation limits are reached.

task_description.description: Detailed description of the research task or question - stored verbatim in metadata per P1.6

initial_confidence.description: P1.5 multi-dimensional confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment]

config.description: Configuration for P1.23 multi-layer networks and other parameters

tools.name: decompose_research_task
tools.description: Creates (or updates) the task decomposition by adding dimension nodes for the requested dimensions, ensuring the mandatory "Potential Biases" and "Knowledge Gaps" dimensions are present, and returns the resulting set of dimension node IDs. This endpoint is not paged; it returns the full dimension list for the session after the operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if no ASR-GoT graph/session exists to decompose, VALIDATION_ERROR if dimensions is not a list of non-empty strings, CONFLICT if decomposition is refused because the graph is in a state that disallows modifying the dimension layer, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the session.

dimensions.description: P1.2 task dimensions (default: Scope, Objectives, Constraints, Data Needs, Use Cases, Potential Biases, Knowledge Gaps)

tools.name: generate_hypotheses
tools.description: Adds 3–5 hypotheses to a specific dimension node (e.g., 2.X), storing each hypothesis with P1.5 confidence, required falsification criteria and plan, and optional disciplinary tags/attribution, and returns the created hypothesis node IDs linked to the dimension. This endpoint is not paged; it returns all hypotheses created by the request. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target dimension_node_id does not exist in the session, VALIDATION_ERROR if hypotheses has fewer than 3 or more than 5 items, if required fields (content, plan, falsification_criteria) are missing, or if confidence/impact values are out of range, CONFLICT if hypotheses cannot be added due to an incompatible graph state, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks write access.

dimension_node_id.description: ID of dimension node (format: 2.X) to generate hypotheses for

confidence.description: P1.5 confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment]

falsification_criteria.description: P1.16 explicit falsifiability criteria - REQUIRED for hypotheses

tools.name: get_graph_summary
tools.description: Returns a comprehensive summary of the current ASR-GoT graph including P1.11 formalism state and, optionally, P1.22 topology metrics, P1.23 layer analysis, and overall P1.0–P1.29 parameter status as requested. This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single summary document for the session’s current consistent graph state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session/graph does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access, and CONFLICT if a summary cannot be produced because the graph is in a transient/inconsistent state.

tools.name: export_graph_data
tools.description: Exports the current ASR-GoT graph in the requested format (json or yaml), optionally including the P1.6 reasoning trace appendix, P1.22 topology insights, and full P1.0–P1.29 parameter status, and returns the serialized export payload. This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single complete export for the session snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported format values or invalid option types, NOT_FOUND if the session/graph does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks export access, and CONFLICT if export is refused because the graph snapshot cannot be materialized in the current state.

format.description: Export format with complete P1.11 formalism and P1.6 requirements

tools.name: execute_resilient_query

query.description: The research question or task to analyze

disciplinary_tag.description: Filter sessions containing the given disciplinary tag.

created_after.description: Only return sessions created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only return sessions created before this timestamp (inclusive).

page_size.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; obtain from a previous response.

tools.name: get_research_session

id.description: Primary key of the research_sessions row to fetch.

tools.name: update_research_session

task_description.description: Updated task description; stored verbatim when provided.

initial_confidence.description: Updated P1.5 confidence vector [empirical_support, theoretical_basis, methodological_rigor, consensus_alignment].

enable_fallbacks.description: Enable/disable resilient fallbacks for executions linked to this session.

disciplinary_tags.description: P1.8 disciplinary provenance tags for the session.

status.description: Lifecycle status transition target; must follow allowed transitions for the current status.

url.description: URL of the documentation

tags.description: Tags for additional categorization

tools.name: update_documentation
tools.description: Starts an update job for the named documentation source to fetch and re-index its content, returning the job status/acknowledgement for that run; when `force` is false, the service may refuse to re-run a recently completed update. Raises NOT_FOUND if no source exists with that `name` and VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty or `force` is not a boolean. Raises CONFLICT if an update is already in progress for that source (or if a non-forced update is not allowed due to recency), UNAUTHORIZED if you cannot run updates, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

name.description: Name of the documentation to update

force.description: Force update even if recently updated

query.description: Search query

tag.description: Filter by tag

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch in the specified Codeup repository from the provided source ref (branch/tag/commit) and returns the created branch metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/branch_name/ref are missing or malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your access token cannot write to the repository. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or ref does not exist, and CONFLICT if a branch with the same name already exists.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to create the branch in (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Name of the new branch to create.

ref.description: Source ref to create the branch from (e.g., commit SHA or existing branch name).

tools.name: get_branch
tools.description: Returns metadata for a single branch (for example name and last update information) in the given Codeup repository. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or branch_name is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have read access to the repository. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist or the branch name cannot be resolved.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID that contains the branch (yunx_code_01J...).

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Deletes the specified branch from a Codeup repository and returns a success result for the deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or branch_name is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to delete branches. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or branch does not exist, and CONFLICT if the branch cannot be deleted due to repository rules or branch state (for example protected/default branch).

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID that contains the branch (yunx_code_01J...).

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: Lists branches in a Codeup repository and returns a page of branch items ordered by the requested sort field and order; when cursor is provided, it returns the next page after that cursor. The response is paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor for subsequent requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid repository_id, limit, sort, order, or cursor, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access, and NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to list branches for (yunx_code_01J...).

search.description: Optional substring to filter branches by name.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to fetch the next page.

tools.name: get_file_blobs
tools.description: Returns the content and metadata for a file at the given path resolved at the specified ref (branch/tag/commit) in a Codeup repository. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/path/ref is missing or invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack read access. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, ref, or path does not exist (or does not resolve to a file blob).

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to read the file from (yunx_code_01J...).

path.description: File path within the repository.

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA).

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Creates a new file at the given path on the specified branch, committing the provided content (utf-8 or base64) with the supplied commit message, and returns the created file/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if content_encoding is not one of the supported values, or if identifiers are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or branch does not exist, and CONFLICT if the file already exists at that path or the write cannot be applied due to branch protection or commit constraints.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to create the file in (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to create the file on.

path.description: File path to create within the repository.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the file creation commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Updates an existing file at the given path on the specified branch by committing the new content (utf-8 or base64) with the supplied commit message, and returns the update/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if content_encoding is invalid, or if identifiers are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, branch, or file path does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update cannot be applied due to repository rules or branch protection.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID containing the file (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to update the file on.

path.description: File path within the repository to update.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the update commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Deletes the file at the given path on the specified branch by creating a delete commit with the provided commit message, and returns the delete/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, branch, or path does not exist, and CONFLICT if the delete cannot be applied due to branch protection or repository rules.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID containing the file (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to delete the file from.

path.description: File path within the repository to delete.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the delete commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compares sourceRef and targetRef within a Codeup repository and returns the comparison result (such as differences/changes), optionally restricted to a single file or directory via path. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or either ref cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT if the comparison cannot be computed for the given refs (for example incompatible or unsupported compare inputs).

repositoryId.description: Codeup repository ID to compare within.

tools.name: get_repository

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: Lists Codeup repositories in the specified organization and returns a paged result set ordered by the requested sort, where each response includes up to `limit` items and a `cursor` to request the next page when more results are available. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when the token cannot access the organization or repositories, and `NOT_FOUND` when `organizationId` (or the specified `projectId`) does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

organizationId.description: Organization ID whose repositories to list.

tools.name: get_change_request
tools.description: Returns the full details for a single Codeup change request identified by `changeRequestId`. tools.name: list_change_requests
tools.description: Lists change requests for a repository within an organization and returns a paged result set (up to `limit` per page) with a `cursor` for fetching the next page, optionally filtered by status, source/target branch, author, and reviewer, and sorted by the requested field. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `NOT_FOUND` if the `organizationId` or `repositoryId` does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token lacks permission to view change requests for the repository.

organizationId.description: Organization ID to scope change requests.

repositoryId.description: Repository ID to list change requests for.

reviewerUserId.description: Filter change requests where this user is a reviewer.

sortBy.description: Field to sort change requests by.

limit.description: Maximum number of change requests to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: create_change_request
tools.description: Creates a new change request in the specified repository from `sourceBranch` to `targetBranch`, optionally setting `title`/`description`, assigning `reviewerUserIds`, linking `workItemIds`, recording cross-project context via `sourceProjectId`/`targetProjectId`, and creating an initial comment from `commentBody`, and returns the created change request. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if required fields are missing, IDs/enums are invalid, branches are empty/invalid, or reviewer/work item lists contain invalid IDs; raises `NOT_FOUND` if the organization, repository, referenced projects, reviewers, or work items do not exist or are not visible; raises `CONFLICT` if the requested change request cannot be created due to repository state or an invalid source/target relationship (for example, source and target branches are the same). organizationId.description: Organization ID that owns the repository.

repositoryId.description: Repository ID to create the change request in.

tools.name: create_change_request_comment
tools.description: Creates a new comment on the specified change request and returns the created comment. changeRequestId.description: Change request ID to comment on.

tools.name: list_change_request_comments
tools.description: Lists comments for a change request in creation-time order and returns a paged result set with up to `limit` comments and a `cursor` to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `NOT_FOUND` if the change request does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token lacks permission to read comments on the change request.

changeRequestId.description: Change request ID whose comments to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: list_change_request_patch_sets
tools.description: Lists patch sets (revisions) for a Codeup change request and returns a paged result set with up to `limit` patch sets and a `cursor` for the next page, sorted by the requested field and order. change_request_id.description: ID of the Codeup change request to list patch sets for.

limit.description: Maximum number of patch sets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort_by.description: Field to sort patch sets by.

1. **Root Cause**: Most 502s correlated with upstream connection pool exhaustion, not application errors

- Add peak-load canaries and high-concurrency synthetic monitors

### Open Question: Separate Pools per Critical Upstream?
**Short Answer**: Need data-driven decision. While separate pools could prevent "noisy-neighbor" effects where one upstream starves others, it adds operational complexity and potential synchronization issues. Recommended approach: run the proposed experiment with an A/B (bucket-based) rollout—allocate top 3 upstreams to separate connection policy profiles, measure performance vs. single-pooled baseline, then decide on standardization.

### 3 Key Insights
1. **Root Cause**: Most 502s correlated with upstream connection pool exhaustion, not application errors

3. **Detection Gap**: Synthetic checks missed the issue due to low-traffic test profiles that don't replicate peak concurrency

- Increase gateway upstream keepalive and tune max_conns per upstream
- Add peak-load canaries and high-concurrency synthetic monitors
- Adopt standard client retry policy with jitter

### Proposed Experiment: Validate Upstream Pool Exhaustion Hypothesis
**Run a simulation test where we deliberately throttle upstream slots to 40% capacity during peak traffic patterns for 30 minutes.** Measure: (1) connection failure rates, (2) time-to-exhaustion under controlled load, and (3) whether observed failure spikes match historical 502 incidence. ### Open Question: Separate Pools per Critical Upstream?
**Short Answer**: Need data-driven decision. While separate pools could prevent "noisy-neighbor" effects where one upstream starves others, it adds operational complexity and potential synchronization issues. Recommended approach: run the proposed experiment with an A/B (bucket-based) rollout—allocate top 3 upstreams to separate connection policy profiles, measure performance vs. single-pooled baseline, then decide on standardization.

tools.name: message_login

tools.name: search_messages

tools.name: send_message

tools.name: search_google
tools.description: Runs a Google search for the provided query and returns a persisted Search record containing the query and its ranked result set (URLs and associated metadata as captured). Results are returned as a single saved result set for that search request (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to run searches, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the search budget/rate limit is exceeded.

query.description: Search query

tools.name: visit_page
tools.description: Creates a page-visit record for the given URL, fetches the page, and returns the stored visit including extracted text and basic metadata; if takeScreenshot is true, also creates and links a screenshot artifact for the same visit. This endpoint does not paginate because it returns a single visit record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid/unsupported URL, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create visits or capture screenshots, NOT_FOUND if the target page cannot be retrieved, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if visit/screenshot limits are exceeded.

url.description: URL to visit

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a screenshot and returns a screenshot artifact record stored in the requested imageFormat and storageBackend, attaching it to the specified pageVisitId or (if omitted) to the latest active browser session’s current page visit. This endpoint returns a single artifact (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid pageVisitId format or unsupported imageFormat/storageBackend, NOT_FOUND if the referenced page visit (or an active session/current visit when omitted) does not exist, CONFLICT if there is no active session/current page to capture when pageVisitId is omitted, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if screenshot capture is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when screenshot limits are exceeded.

pageVisitId.description: Page visit id to attach the screenshot to; if omitted, uses the latest active browser session's current page visit

storageBackend.description: Storage backend where the screenshot will be stored

status.description: Filter by search query lifecycle status.

provider.description: Filter by search provider.

requestFingerprint.description: Filter by the request_fingerprint associated with the originating client/request.

createdAfter.description: Return only search queries created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

createdBefore.description: Return only search queries created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tools.name: get_search_query
tools.description: Fetches a single persisted search query by id, including its stored ranked results (0..100). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted.

tools.name: update_search_query

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions (queued→running|cancelled; running→succeeded|failed|cancelled).

errorMessage.description: Optional error detail when transitioning to failed; ignored unless status='failed'.

tools.name: list_page_visits

status.description: Filter by page visit lifecycle status.

sourceSearchResultId.description: Filter to visits initiated from a specific search result.

url.description: Filter by exact requested URL (absolute http/https).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tools.name: search_gifs
tools.description: Searches Giphy for GIFs matching q for the given workspace, using the workspace’s default credential unless credential_id is provided, and returns up to limit results starting at offset (offset-based pagination), optionally serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true and persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid, q is empty, limit is not 1–50, offset is negative, or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

q.description: Search query term(s).

limit.description: Maximum number of GIFs to return.

lang.description: Language for regional content; defaults from workspace configuration when omitted.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to results.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tools.name: get_random_gif
tools.description: Fetches a single random GIF from Giphy for the given workspace, optionally filtered by tag and further constrained by rating/lang (defaulting lang from workspace configuration when omitted), optionally serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true and persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

tag.description: Optional tag to filter the random GIF selection.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to the random GIF selection.

lang.description: Language for regional content; defaults from workspace configuration when omitted.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tools.name: get_trending_gifs
tools.description: Retrieves currently trending GIFs from Giphy for the given workspace and returns up to limit results starting at offset (offset-based pagination), optionally applying rating/bundle and serving a fresh cached response when use_cache is true while persisting the request/response for audit and analytics. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/credential_id formats are invalid, limit is not 1–50, offset is negative, or cache_ttl_seconds is provided but < 1; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or the specified credential_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the credential does not belong to the workspace, UNAUTHORIZED if no usable credential is available for the workspace, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/credential usage quotas are exceeded (including when forwarding a request to Giphy).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id used to resolve configuration, caching, and usage tracking.

credential_id.description: API credential id to use for the Giphy request (must belong to the workspace).

limit.description: Maximum number of trending GIFs to return.

rating.description: Content rating filter to apply to trending results.

use_cache.description: Whether to serve a cached response when available.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a newly stored response should be considered fresh for caching.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Creates a new workspace used to scope credentials, caching, and usage tracking, and returns the created workspace record. Refuses invalid fields and does not allow creating a workspace in status "deleted".

default_language.description: Default language code (used when lang is omitted on GIF tools).

default_region.description: Default region code (used for regional content defaults).

tools.name: update_workspace
tools.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or transitions its status. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses transitions not allowed by the lifecycle (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted) and refuses updates once status is "deleted".

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to update.

status.description: New workspace status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

tools.name: create_api_credential
tools.description: Stores a Giphy API key for a workspace and returns the created credential metadata (never returns the raw key). Refuses creation when the workspace is deleted and refuses unsupported providers.

workspace_id.description: Workspace that will own this credential.

provider.description: Credential provider (only "giphy" is supported).

api_key.description: Giphy API key to encrypt and store (not returned once stored).

status.description: Initial credential status; defaults to active when omitted.

tools.name: update_api_credential
tools.description: Updates an API credential’s status and/or rotates its key. Returns the updated credential metadata. Refuses lifecycle-invalid transitions (active↔disabled, active/disabled→revoked), refuses updates once revoked, and refuses operations when the credential does not belong to the given workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that must own the credential.

status.description: New credential status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

api_key.description: New Giphy API key to rotate to (stored encrypted; not returned).

tools.description: Lists persisted GIF request records for a workspace for auditing/analytics with filtering and offset-based pagination. Returns request rows and does not include raw upstream response bodies.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to list requests for.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool that produced the request.

created_from.description: Only include requests created at or after this timestamp.

created_to.description: Only include requests created before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
