tools.name: get_latest_feed
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user’s latest activity feed items, up to `count`, and includes a `cursor` you can pass back to fetch the next page (omit `cursor` to start from the newest). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `count` is not an integer or is out of range, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if your access token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to read the user feed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

count.description: Maximum number of feed items to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of feed items.

tools.name: add_bookmark
tools.description: Creates a new raindrop (bookmark) from `url`, optionally setting `title`, `description`, `tags`, and a destination `collection_id` (use "0" for Unsorted), and returns the created bookmark record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing/invalid, `collection_id` does not match the allowed format, or `tags` is not an array of strings; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not allowed to create bookmarks in the target collection. Raises NOT_FOUND if the specified collection does not exist, CONFLICT if the bookmark cannot be created due to a duplicate/constraint violation, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

url.description: The URL to bookmark.

title.description: Title for the bookmark (if omitted, may be extracted from the URL).

description.description: Description or excerpt for the bookmark.

tags.description: List of tag names to apply to the bookmark.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to add the bookmark to (use "0" for Unsorted).

tools.name: search_by_tag
tools.description: Lists bookmarks that have the given `tag`, optionally scoped to `collection_id` ("0" for all collections) and filtered by inclusive `from_date`/`to_date`; results are paged with `count` and a `cursor` returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `tag` is missing/empty, any date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, `from_date` is after `to_date`, or `collection_id` does not match the allowed format. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot search the requested collection(s), NOT_FOUND if a non-zero `collection_id` does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

tag.description: Tag name to filter bookmarks by.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to search in (use "0" for all collections).

count.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: search_bookmarks
tools.description: Performs full-text search over bookmarks for `query`, optionally scoped to `collection_id` ("0" for all collections) and filtered by inclusive `from_date`/`to_date`; returns up to `count` results per page and a `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty, any date is not in YYYY-MM-DD format, `from_date` is after `to_date`, or `collection_id` does not match the allowed format. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot search the requested collection(s), NOT_FOUND if a non-zero `collection_id` does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed API quotas.

query.description: Search term to look for in bookmarks.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to search in (use "0" for all collections).

count.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user profile plus the effective OAuth scopes and current rate-limit/quota state for the presented access token. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid; may return RATE_LIMITED when you exceed the service limits.

include_scopes.description: When true, include the list of effective scopes granted to the access token.

include_limits.description: When true, include current rate-limit/quota consumption and reset timestamps, if available.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Lists the authenticated user’s collections, excluding deleted collections by default, ordered by updated_at desc unless otherwise specified. Supports pagination and optional filtering by status. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to read collections; may return RATE_LIMITED.

status.description: Filter collections by lifecycle status (deleted is never returned).

count.description: Maximum number of collections to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of collections.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Creates a new collection for the authenticated user and returns the created collection record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or if the title conflicts with an existing collection slug; refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to create collections.

slug.description: Optional URL-friendly slug; if omitted the service generates one from title.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Updates a collection owned by the authenticated user and returns the updated collection record. You may change mutable fields and drive lifecycle transitions via `status` (active↔archived, and active/archived→deleted). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist, does not belong to you, or is deleted; VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields/transition; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not permitted.

id.description: ID of the collection to update.

status.description: Set the collection lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→archived/deleted, archived→active/deleted.

tools.name: get_bookmark
tools.description: Fetches a single bookmark (raindrop) by id for the authenticated user and returns the bookmark record. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist, does not belong to you, or is trashed/deleted; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the token is missing/invalid or lacks permission.

id.description: ID of the bookmark to fetch.

tools.name: update_bookmark
tools.description: Updates an existing bookmark owned by the authenticated user and returns the updated bookmark record. Allows edits to metadata, moving between collections, replacing tags, and driving lifecycle transitions via `status` (active↔trashed, and active/trashed→deleted). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist, does not belong to you, or is deleted; VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields/transition; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not permitted.

id.description: ID of the bookmark to update.

url.description: New URL for the bookmark (must be a valid URL).

collection_id.description: Move the bookmark to this collection (use "0" for Unsorted).

tags.description: Replace the bookmark’s tag set with these tag names (case-folded normalization; duplicates ignored).

status.description: Set the bookmark lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→trashed/deleted, trashed→active/deleted.

tools.name: plan_task
tools.description: Create a new planning “thought” session for a project and either attach it to an existing task (when task_id is provided) or create a new task from name/description when create_task is true, returning the created thought session and the task it is associated with. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs do not match the expected patterns, or task_id is omitted without create_task plus name/description; raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or the referenced task does not exist in the project. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the project’s thought/task operation limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id to create/attach the planning thought session to.

task_id.description: Existing task id to plan (if omitted, a new task may be created from name/description).

name.description: Task name to create when task_id is not provided.

description.description: Task description to create when task_id is not provided.

notes.description: Optional notes/context to include in planning.

priority.description: Optional priority to set on the task (higher means more important).

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs for planning context.

create_task.description: Whether to create a new task when task_id is not provided.

tools.name: analyze_task
tools.description: Append an “analyze” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry plus any task fields updated by the analysis. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, required fields are missing, or session_id (when provided) is not a thought-session ID; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or session (when provided) does not exist or the session does not belong to the project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized project access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when analysis/thought operations exceed allowed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to analyze.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append analysis to (optional).

include_codebase_check.description: Whether to explicitly include systematic codebase inspection in the analysis.

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs to focus the analysis.

tools.name: reflect_task
tools.description: Append a “reflect” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if reflection/thought operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to reflect on.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append reflection to (optional).

focus.description: Optional reflection focus (e.g., risks, completeness, optimizations, best practices).

tools.name: split_tasks
tools.description: Generate a subtask plan from root_task_id and apply it to the project according to updateMode (append adds new tasks, selective matches by name to update or add, overwrite removes unfinished tasks before applying, and clearAllTasks clears tasks), returning the resulting set of created/updated tasks and any dependency links created when create_dependencies is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing required fields, invalid backup_reason for a mode that performs clearing, or max_tasks outside supported bounds; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or root task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if updateMode requests clearing/overwriting but a backup cannot be created or the root task is not eligible for splitting under the requested mode, FORBIDDEN if not authorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if task creation/update limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id whose task plan will be decomposed/updated.

root_task_id.description: Root task id to split into subtasks.

updateMode.description: How to apply generated subtasks to existing tasks.

max_tasks.description: Optional cap on the number of subtasks to generate.

create_dependencies.description: Whether to create dependency links between generated tasks.

backup_reason.description: Backup reason to use when updateMode triggers backup/clearing.

Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the project.

tools.name: plan_task
tools.description: Create a new planning “thought” session for a project and either attach it to an existing task (when task_id is provided) or create a new task from name/description when create_task is true, returning the created thought session and the task it is associated with. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs do not match the expected patterns, or task_id is omitted without create_task plus name/description; raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or the referenced task does not exist in the project. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the project’s thought/task operation limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id to create/attach the planning thought session to.

task_id.description: Existing task id to plan (if omitted, a new task may be created from name/description).

name.description: Task name to create when task_id is not provided.

description.description: Task description to create when task_id is not provided.

notes.description: Optional notes/context to include in planning.

priority.description: Optional priority to set on the task (higher means more important).

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs for planning context.

create_task.description: Whether to create a new task when task_id is not provided.

tools.name: analyze_task
tools.description: Append an “analyze” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry plus any task fields updated by the analysis. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, required fields are missing, or session_id (when provided) is not a thought-session ID; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or session (when provided) does not exist or the session does not belong to the project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized project access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when analysis/thought operations exceed allowed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to analyze.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append analysis to (optional).

include_codebase_check.description: Whether to explicitly include systematic codebase inspection in the analysis.

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs to focus the analysis.

tools.name: reflect_task
tools.description: Append a “reflect” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if reflection/thought operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to reflect on.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append reflection to (optional).

focus.description: Optional reflection focus (e.g., risks, completeness, optimizations, best practices).

tools.name: split_tasks
tools.description: Generate a subtask plan from root_task_id and apply it to the project according to updateMode (append adds new tasks, selective matches by name to update or add, overwrite removes unfinished tasks before applying, and clearAllTasks clears tasks), returning the resulting set of created/updated tasks and any dependency links created when create_dependencies is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing required fields, invalid backup_reason for a mode that performs clearing, or max_tasks outside supported bounds; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or root task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if updateMode requests clearing/overwriting but a backup cannot be created or the root task is not eligible for splitting under the requested mode, FORBIDDEN if not authorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if task creation/update limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id whose task plan will be decomposed/updated.

root_task_id.description: Root task id to split into subtasks.

updateMode.description: How to apply generated subtasks to existing tasks.

max_tasks.description: Optional cap on the number of subtasks to generate.

create_dependencies.description: Whether to create dependency links between generated tasks.

backup_reason.description: Backup reason to use when updateMode triggers backup/clearing.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks for a project with optional filtering by status and inclusion of deleted records and dependency data, returning a paged result set ordered by sort/order with up to limit items and an opaque next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are invalid (e.g., limit out of range or unsupported enum values). Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the project.

project_id.description: Project id whose tasks to list.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted tasks (deleted_at not null).

include_dependencies.description: Whether to include dependency data for each task.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: execute_task
tools.description: Append an “execute” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and, when update_status is true, transition the task to in_progress as part of execution, returning the updated/created session entry and any task status changes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises CONFLICT if update_status is requested but the task is in a terminal state (completed/cancelled) or otherwise cannot transition to in_progress, plus FORBIDDEN and QUOTA_EXCEEDED under the same conditions as other thought operations.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to execute.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append execution to (optional).

update_status.description: Whether to update the task status to in_progress during execution.

tools.name: verify_task
tools.description: Append a “verify” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted), applying verification_criteria when provided, and return the updated/created session entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or required fields are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when verification/thought operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to verify.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append verification to (optional).

verification_criteria.description: Optional explicit verification criteria to apply (overrides/augments task field).

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs to check during verification.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as completed, store the provided structured completion_report (and optional summary/notes/completed_at), and optionally update dependent tasks’ dependency status when update_dependents is true, returning the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if completion_report is missing/invalid, IDs are malformed, or completed_at is not a valid date-time; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task is already completed/cancelled or cannot transition to completed from its current state, FORBIDDEN if unauthorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if completion/update operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to mark as completed.

completion_report.description: Structured completion report to store on the task.

summary.description: Optional short completion summary to store on the task.

notes.description: Optional completion notes to store on the task.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp (defaults to now if omitted).

update_dependents.description: Whether to update dependency status of related tasks after completion.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Soft-delete a task by setting its deleted marker and return the updated task record, but only for tasks that are not completed to preserve the audit trail. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or required fields are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task is completed (or otherwise non-deletable under current state/dependency constraints), FORBIDDEN if unauthorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if deletion operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to delete (must not be completed).

tools.name: clear_all_tasks
tools.description: Clear unfinished tasks and reset the task list

project_id.description: ID of the project whose unfinished tasks will be cleared.

reason.description: Backup reason recorded for the snapshot created before clearing.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates an existing task in the given project, including core fields (name/description/notes/priority/status), dependency links (set/add/remove), and planning fields (implementation_guide/verification_criteria), and returns the updated task record. If the task is already completed, this endpoint rejects attempts to modify any fields other than summary and related_files, and it rejects invalid or disallowed status transitions (including attempting to “un-complete” a completed task). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, out-of-range values, or invalid dependency_updates payloads; NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist (or the task is deleted and updates are not permitted); CONFLICT if dependency changes reference non-existent tasks, cross-project tasks, self-dependencies, or would create an invalid dependency state; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized for the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to update.

tools.name: listTasks
tools.description: Lists tasks in the workspace and returns a cursor-paged result set honoring the provided filters (project/section/parent, status, due/created ranges) and sort options; the response contains up to `limit` items and a `cursor` you can pass to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id does not match its required pattern, if date-time filters are not valid ISO-8601 timestamps, or if `limit` is outside 1–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id`, `section_id`, or `parent_task_id` is provided but does not exist (or does not belong to this workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the referenced container.

project_id.description: Filter tasks by project id.

section_id.description: Filter tasks by section id.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task id (subtasks of this task).

due_before.description: Return tasks with due_at strictly before this timestamp.

due_after.description: Return tasks with due_at strictly after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Return tasks created strictly before this timestamp.

created_after.description: Return tasks created strictly after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getTask
tools.description: Returns the task identified by `task_id` including its current fields and status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is missing or does not match the required id pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or is not accessible in this workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view it.

task_id.description: The task id to fetch.

tools.name: createTask
tools.description: Creates a new task in the given `project_id` (optionally in `section_id` or under `parent_task_id`) and returns the created task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, ids do not match their patterns, `priority` is not 1–4, or due fields are invalid (including providing an invalid timestamp/date format). Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced project/section/parent task does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if you attempt to place the task into a section or parent task that is not within the specified project.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

section_id.description: Section id the task belongs to.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id to create this task as a subtask.

due_date.description: Due date (date-only string, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for interpreting due_at/due_date.

order_index.description: Ordering hint within the container (project/section).

tools.name: updateTask
tools.description: Updates fields on the specified task (including moves between project/section/parent, due/priority/order changes, and status changes) and returns the updated task. task_id.description: The task id to update.

project_id.description: Move task to a different project id.

section_id.description: Move task to a different section id.

parent_task_id.description: Re-parent task under a different parent task id.

due_date.description: Updated due date (date-only string, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD).

timezone.description: Updated IANA timezone name for interpreting due_at/due_date.

order_index.description: Updated ordering hint within the container (project/section).

is_recurring.description: Update whether the task is recurring.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Lists commit records from the repository history and returns up to the requested limit, optionally filtered by author name and a since/until date-time window. It also refuses a date range where since is later than until because the filter window is contradictory.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

author.description: Filter commits by the author's name.

since.description: Include commits after this date.

until.description: Include commits before this date.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Returns the commit record matching the provided commit hash. It refuses requests that omit commit_hash or provide an empty value, because a commit cannot be identified without it. It also refuses commit_hash values that don’t match any known commit in the repository history.

commit_hash.description: The SHA hash of the commit to retrieve.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: Lists branch records and returns them all, or only the current branch when current_only is true, and can further filter results by a name substring. current_only.description: If true, only return the currently checked-out branch.

name_filter.description: Return only branches whose name contains this substring.

tools.name: get_branch
tools.description: Returns the branch record for the exact branch_name provided. It refuses requests that omit branch_name or provide an empty value, because an exact name is required. It also refuses branch_name values that don’t match an existing branch.

branch_name.description: The exact name of the branch to retrieve.

tools.name: list_tags

term_years.description: Registration term length in years used to estimate/register pricing.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of DNS host records.

sort.description: Sort order for returned DNS host records.

tools.name: check_cookie
tools.description: 检查指定 cookie_session_id 的可用性并在需要时刷新会话；未传 cookie_session_id 时会按 label（如提供）从可用会话中自动挑选并返回所选会话与当前状态信息。若 force_refresh=false，服务可能复用最近一次检查结果以避免频繁校验。参数格式不符合正则时返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；找不到对应会话返回 NOT_FOUND；当会话不可用/已失效且无法刷新时返回 UNAUTHORIZED。

cookie_session_id.description: 要检查/刷新可用性的 Cookie 会话ID；不传则由服务自动选择一个可用会话。

label.description: 可选：仅在未指定 cookie_session_id 时，用于按标签筛选/选择会话。

force_refresh.description: 是否强制发起一次校验/刷新（忽略最近一次检查时间缓存）。

tools.name: home_feed
tools.description: 使用可用的 Cookie 会话拉取小红书首页 feed，并将结果写入缓存后返回；支持通过 limit 控制单页数量（1–50），并使用 cursor 进行游标分页（不传 cursor 表示从首页起始页）。当 refresh=false 时可能直接返回缓存的同一游标页结果，refresh=true 会强制重新抓取并更新缓存。cookie_session_id 格式非法或 limit 越界返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；指定会话不存在返回 NOT_FOUND；会话无效/被风控导致无法拉取返回 UNAUTHORIZED。

cookie_session_id.description: 用于拉取首页 feed 的 Cookie 会话ID；不传则自动选择可用会话。

limit.description: 返回/缓存的笔记条数上限。

cursor.description: 分页游标（来自上一页响应）；不传表示从首页开始。

refresh.description: 是否强制刷新抓取并更新缓存（否则可能直接返回缓存结果）。

tools.name: search_notes

cookie_session_id.description: 用于搜索的 Cookie 会话ID；不传则自动选择可用会话。

limit.description: 返回/缓存的笔记条数上限。

cursor.description: 分页游标（来自上一页响应）；不传表示从第一页开始。

sort.description: 搜索排序方式：相关度/最新/最热。

refresh.description: 是否强制刷新抓取并更新缓存（否则可能直接返回缓存结果）。

cookie_session_id.description: 用于抓取的 Cookie 会话ID；不传则自动选择可用会话。

refresh.description: 是否强制重新抓取并覆盖缓存内容。

tools.name: list_work_items
tools.description: Lists locally mirrored work items for the given project, optionally filtered by status, type, assignee, tag, and source, and returns a sorted page of results with an opaque cursor for pagination (pass cursor to fetch the next page; limit controls page size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, if limit is out of range, or if any enum parameter is not one of the allowed values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read work items for that project.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) to list work items for.

status.description: Filter by work item lifecycle status.

work_item_type.description: Filter by Azure DevOps work item type (e.g., Bug, Task, User Story).

assigned_to.description: Filter by assignee display name or identifier as stored locally.

tag.description: Filter to items containing a specific tag.

source.description: Filter by origin of the record.

limit.description: Maximum number of work items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: Retrieves a single locally mirrored work item by its local azdo_wi_ ULID and returns its stored fields and lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if work_item_id is not a valid azdo_wi_ ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the work item does not exist or is not accessible, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view it.

work_item_id.description: Local work item id (ULID) to retrieve.

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.description: Creates a new work item in the specified local project and returns the created work item record with its local id, requested fields (type/title/description/etc.), and initial lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, project_id is not a valid azdo_prj_ ULID, status is not one of the allowed values, or tags is not an array of strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create work items in the project, and CONFLICT if the request attempts an unsupported or invalid initial lifecycle status for creation.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) to create the work item in.

work_item_type.description: Azure DevOps work item type to create (e.g., Bug, Task, User Story).

assigned_to.description: Assignee display name or identifier to set on the work item.

status.description: Initial status to set for the work item.

area_path.description: Area path to set on the work item.

iteration_path.description: Iteration/sprint path to set on the work item.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the work item.

project_id.description: Local project id (ULID) containing the repository.

repository_id.description: Azure DevOps repository id to list pull requests for.

limit.description: Maximum number of pull requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_pull_request

Raises NOT_FOUND if the pull request does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view it.

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request id (ULID) to retrieve.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Creates a new pull request in the specified project and Azure DevOps repository using the provided title, sourceBranch, and targetBranch, optionally marking it as a draft and linking Azure DevOps work item numeric IDs, and returns the created pull request record. pull_request_id.description: Local pull request id (ULID) to fetch the diff for.

tools.name: update_pull_request

pull_request_id.description: Local pull request ULID (pull_requests.id) to update.

tools.name: fetch_record
tools.description: Fetches a single record by id from the specified collection and returns the record payload, optionally applying PocketBase-style `expand` and `fields` selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `collection`/`id` are missing or malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks read access for the collection or record, and NOT_FOUND if the collection or record does not exist (or is not visible under the current auth rules).

collection.description: Target PocketBase collection name or id (pbc_... ULID).

id.description: Record id (rec_... ULID or PocketBase 15-char id).

expand.description: Comma-separated relation fields to expand (PocketBase expand syntax).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (PocketBase fields param syntax).

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: Lists records from the specified collection and returns a paged result set using `page` (1-based) and `per_page`, optionally applying `filter`, `sort`, `expand`, `fields`, and `skip_total` (when true, total-count fields are omitted/not computed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid paging bounds or malformed filter/sort/expand/fields syntax, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks list access for the collection, and NOT_FOUND if the target collection does not exist (or is not visible under the current auth rules).

collection.description: Target PocketBase collection name or id (pbc_... ULID).

filter.description: PocketBase filter expression (e.g. "status='active' && created_at>='2024-01-01'").

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields with optional +/- prefix (e.g. "-created_at,name").

expand.description: Comma-separated relation fields to expand (PocketBase expand syntax).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return (PocketBase fields param syntax).

skip_total.description: If true, skips total count calculation for faster responses.

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Creates a new record in the specified collection from the provided dynamic `data` payload and returns the created record. collection.description: Target PocketBase collection name or id (pbc_... ULID).

data.description: Record fields payload (dynamic per collection schema).

tools.name: update_record

collection.description: Target PocketBase collection name or id (pbc_... ULID).

id.description: Record id (rec_... ULID or PocketBase 15-char id).

data.description: Record fields to update (dynamic per collection schema).

collection.description: PocketBase collection name or id (pbc_... ULID) to fetch schema for.

filename.description: Migration filename to revert (alternative to migration_id).

tools.name: scrape_recent_category_papers
tools.description: Scrapes arXiv’s “recent” listing for the given category and returns up to max_results normalized paper records, creating a scrape job and storing per-paper/category observations for reproducible snapshots. This endpoint returns a bounded list (not cursor-paged); if more than max_results papers are present, only the newest max_results are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when category is missing/empty or max_results is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to run scrapes, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR/NOT_FOUND when the category page cannot be retrieved (e.g., invalid category or arXiv is unavailable).

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Runs an arXiv keyword search and returns up to max_results matching papers as normalized metadata, recording the search as a job for later audit and analysis. Results are returned as a bounded list (not cursor-paged); if more than max_results matches exist, only the top max_results are returned according to arXiv’s search ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when keyword is missing/blank or max_results is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot execute searches, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the arXiv search endpoint fails or times out.

tools.name: get_paper_info
tools.description: Fetches canonical metadata for a single paper by arXiv paper_id and returns the normalized paper record (and may refresh stored metadata if already known). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when paper_id is missing or not a valid arXiv identifier format, NOT_FOUND when no paper exists for that id, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access paper metadata, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate/quota limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when arXiv metadata retrieval fails.

tools.name: analyze_trends
tools.description: Computes trend analytics for the given category over the last days using stored per-paper/category observations (captured via prior scrapes/searches) and returns aggregated signals such as trending terms/topics and counts for the time window. This endpoint returns a single analysis result (not paged) for the requested window and will only reflect data actually captured in the underlying snapshots. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when days is not a positive integer or category is invalid/blank, NOT_FOUND when there is insufficient captured data for that category/window to compute trends, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot run analytics, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when analytics rate/quota limits are exceeded.

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: Lists stored papers with optional filtering and cursor pagination. Returns normalized paper records that have been captured or fetched by this service. Refuses invalid filter combinations and returns TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

arxiv_id.description: Filter by exact arXiv identifier (e.g., 2401.01234 or cs/9901001).

category.description: Filter to papers that have this category (primary or secondary).

published_from.description: Include papers published at or after this timestamp.

published_to.description: Include papers published at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tools.name: get_crawl_run
tools.description: Fetches a single crawl run job by id and returns its stored job record including status and error fields. Refuses access when the caller is not authorized to view the run.

include_items.description: When true, includes the crawl_run_items for this run (paged).

items_limit.description: Maximum crawl_run_items to return when include_items=true.

items_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for crawl_run_items when include_items=true.

tools.name: cancel_crawl_run
tools.description: Cancels a crawl run job. If the run is queued it transitions to cancelled; if running it requests cancellation and transitions to cancelled when acknowledged. Refuses cancellation for runs already in a terminal state (succeeded/failed/cancelled).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for audit/debugging.

tools.name: get_search_query

include_results.description: When true, includes the search_query_results for this query (paged).

results_limit.description: Maximum search_query_results to return when include_results=true.

results_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for search_query_results when include_results=true.

tools.name: cancel_search_query

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for audit/debugging.

tools.name: update_paper_status

tools.description: Registers a new ntfy-me server instance and its topic subscriptions, returning the created server record and the created subscription records. Validates that `server.display_name` and `server.base_url` are provided, that any provided `server.status` is one of `provisioning|active|paused|degraded|deleted`, and that each subscription includes a `topic` and any provided subscription `status` is one of `active|paused|deleted`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed or missing required fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create deployments, and CONFLICT if the server or a subscription for the same topic already exists for this deployment.

server.description: Server instance to create/register for this ntfy-me-mcp deployment.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for the server instance.

base_url.description: Base URL of the upstream ntfy server (e.g., https://ntfy.sh).

default_fetch_limit.description: Default maximum number of messages to fetch per retrieval/ingest cycle.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the server instance.

subscriptions.description: List of topic subscriptions to create for the server instance.

topic.description: ntfy topic name to subscribe to.

since_event_id.description: Upstream event id to resume ingestion from (if known).

tools.name: ntfy_me_fetch
tools.description: Returns cached notifications for the specified server instance as a paged list, honoring `limit` (or the server’s configured default) and `cursor` to continue from a prior page; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `server_id` does not match `^ntfy_srv_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$`, if `limit` is not a positive integer, or if `cursor` is invalid for the requested server. Raises NOT_FOUND if `server_id` does not exist (or has been deleted), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read that server’s cache, and CONFLICT if the server is not in a readable state (for example, still provisioning).

server_id.description: ID of the ntfy-me server instance whose cached messages should be fetched.

limit.description: Maximum number of cached messages to return.

tools.description: Creates a new interactive feedback request for the given project_directory and one-line summary, snapshots basic project metadata, and returns the created request record (including its generated identifier and initial state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_directory or summary is missing/empty or otherwise fails input validation, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to create feedback requests for that project. Raises CONFLICT if there is already an open feedback request for the same project_directory and summary (or other uniqueness constraint is violated), and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has reached a service limit for active requests.

project_directory.description: Full path to the project directory
project_directory.title: Project Directory

summary.description: Short, one-line summary of the changes
summary.title: Summary

tools.name: interactive_feedback_me
tools.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are provided.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

tools.name: interactive_feedback_requests_list
tools.description: Lists feedback requests visible to the caller, optionally filtered by project_id, project_directory, status, or client_request_id, ordered by created_at descending. Returns a paginated page of feedback request records; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list requests.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

project_id.description: Filter to feedback requests for the given project id.

project_directory.description: Filter by the verbatim project_directory stored on the request.

client_request_id.description: Filter by a client-supplied id for idempotency/correlation.

created_after.description: Only return requests created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only return requests created before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: interactive_feedback_request_get
tools.description: Fetches a single feedback request by id. Returns the request record if found; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

tools.name: interactive_feedback_request_update
tools.description: Updates a feedback request and/or drives its lifecycle status transitions (queued→active/cancelled/errored, active→awaiting_user/completed/cancelled/errored, awaiting_user→active/completed/cancelled/errored). Returns the updated request record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions or invalid fields (including completing with unanswered required prompts), and sets closed_at when transitioning to completed/cancelled/errored.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

status.description: New status for the request; must be a valid lifecycle transition from the current status.

error_message.description: Error message to store when transitioning to errored. Ignored unless status=errored.

opened_at.description: Timestamp when the request was opened/activated (server may overwrite on activation).

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the request was closed (server sets on completed/cancelled/errored).

tools.name: interactive_feedback_request_prompts_upsert
tools.description: Creates or updates the set of prompts for a feedback request. Prompts are keyed by sequence_no (starting at 1, unique per request). Returns the upserted prompt records. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if sequence numbers are invalid/duplicated, prompt fields are invalid, or if the request is completed/cancelled/errored.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

prompts.description: Prompts to create or update for the request (upsert by sequence_no).

sequence_no.description: 1-based sequence number for ordering within the request.

title.description: Short title shown to the user.

body.description: Prompt body shown to the user.

choices.description: Choices for single_choice/multi_choice prompts; must be omitted or empty for other prompt types.

is_required.description: Whether the prompt must be answered before completing the request.

status.description: Optional prompt status transition (pending→presented/skipped, presented→answered/skipped). If provided, must be valid from the current status.

tools.name: interactive_feedback_response_record
tools.description: Records a user's response for a prompt (one response per prompt). Creates a feedback_responses row and updates the prompt status to answered. Returns the created response record. limit.description: 페이지 크기입니다(1~50).

cursor.description: 다음 페이지 커서입니다. 첫 호출에는 생략합니다.

tools.name: create_sync_run
tools.description: 백엔드 수집(동기화) 작업을 큐에 등록하고 sync_runs 레코드를 생성합니다. job_type/feed_type 조합이 유효하지 않으면 VALIDATION_ERROR(4xx)를 반환하며, 인증/권한이 없으면 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN을 반환합니다.

api_key.description: 동기화 실행을 위한 API 키입니다(서버 정책에 따라 필수).

target_weekly_id.description: job_type=weekly_news인 경우 수집할 weekly_id입니다. 비우면 최신 주간 뉴스 기준으로 동기화할 수 있습니다.

dedupe_key.description: 동일 작업 중복 등록 방지를 위한 클라이언트 제공 키입니다(선택).

enqueue_immediately.description: true이면 즉시 queued로 등록합니다. false면 검증만 수행하고 생성하지 않습니다(서버가 지원하는 경우).

tools.name: update_sync_run
tools.description: sync_runs의 상태 전이 및 실행 메타데이터를 갱신합니다. queued→running→(succeeded|failed|cancelled) 외 전이는 거부하며, running에서만 started_at 설정이 가능하고 종료 상태로 전이할 때는 finished_at이 필요합니다. 조건을 만족하지 않으면 CONFLICT/VALIDATION_ERROR(4xx)를 반환합니다.

api_key.description: 동기화 상태 갱신을 위한 API 키입니다.

started_at.description: 작업 시작 시각(ISO 8601). status를 running으로 전이할 때만 허용됩니다.

finished_at.description: 작업 종료 시각(ISO 8601). status를 succeeded/failed/cancelled로 전이할 때 필요합니다.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Searches PubMed using the provided title/abstract keywords and/or author names and returns up to num_results matching PubMed IDs along with a formatted result payload; results are returned as a single page limited by num_results (no cursor/offset pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if num_results is not a positive integer or if keywords/authors are not arrays of strings, and NOT_FOUND if the query yields zero PubMed matches. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to run searches or access cached search history.

tools.name: format_paper_details
tools.description: Fetches normalized metadata for the provided list of PubMed IDs and returns a list of formatted article-detail objects in the same order as requested (this endpoint is not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pubmed_ids is missing, empty, or contains non-string/duplicate IDs. Raises NOT_FOUND when one or more PubMed IDs cannot be resolved to stored/available article metadata, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller lacks access or exceeds allowed detail-lookups.

Raises CONFLICT when the requested user/workspace relationship is not valid for creation (e.g., user is not a member of the workspace) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the integration’s write limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID where the time entry will be created.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entry.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to associate to the time entry.

start_time.description: Start time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

end_time.description: End time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

tools.name: get-projects
tools.description: Lists projects in a workspace (id and name) so they can be selected for time entries, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is not a valid Clockify workspace ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to view that workspace’s projects and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-current-user
tools.description: Returns the currently authenticated Clockify-linked user (at minimum id and name) for use in subsequent workspace and time-entry operations. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid authentication is available and FORBIDDEN when the authenticated identity is not permitted to access Clockify-linked resources. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tools.name: get-workspaces
tools.description: Lists workspaces accessible to the specified Clockify-linked user (id and name), returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when user_id is not a valid Clockify user ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the user does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to list workspaces for that user and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID to list accessible workspaces for.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-time-entries
tools.description: Lists time entries for a workspace owned by the specified Clockify-linked user, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Supports filtering by status, time range, and optional project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when date-time filters are invalid, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN when the user does not have an active membership in the workspace; raises NOT_FOUND when referenced resources do not exist.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list time entries for.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entries.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to filter time entries by.

from_time.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

to_time.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-time-entry
tools.description: Fetches a single time entry by ULID and returns the full time entry record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is not a valid time entry ULID; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the workspace/user that owns the time entry.

tools.name: update-time-entry
tools.description: Updates writable fields on a time entry and returns the updated record. Supports valid lifecycle transitions for time_entries.status: pending -> created/failed/cancelled; failed -> pending/cancelled. A transition to pending re-queues the integration to attempt upstream creation again; cancelled prevents further attempts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when start_time/end_time are not RFC3339 timestamps, when end_time is before start_time, when project_id does not belong to workspace_id, or when an invalid status transition is requested; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to mutate the time entry; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry (or referenced project) does not exist.

start_time.description: Updated start time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Required if end_time is provided.

end_time.description: Updated end time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Use null to represent a running entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

project_id.description: Project ULID to associate, or null to clear the project.

status.description: New status for the time entry; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tools.name: sync-clockify
tools.description: Synchronizes the active Clockify-linked user, their accessible workspaces, memberships, and projects from Clockify into the local store and returns a summary of what was updated. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid authentication is available, FORBIDDEN when the identity is not permitted to access Clockify-linked resources, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when sync/read limits are exceeded.

include_projects.description: Whether to sync projects for accessible workspaces (defaults to true).

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace ULID to limit the sync scope to a single workspace.

tools.name: create-time-entry
tools.description: Creates a time entry owned by the given Clockify-linked user in the specified workspace, optionally associated to a project, and returns the created time entry record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when start_time/end_time are not RFC3339 timestamps, or when end_time is not after start_time; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace_id, user_id, or (if provided) project_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the user is not allowed to create entries in the workspace or the project is not in that workspace. Raises CONFLICT when the requested user/workspace relationship is not valid for creation (e.g., user is not a member of the workspace) and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the integration’s write limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID where the time entry will be created.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entry.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to associate to the time entry.

start_time.description: Start time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

end_time.description: End time of the time entry (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

tools.name: get-projects
tools.description: Lists projects in a workspace (id and name) so they can be selected for time entries, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when workspace_id is not a valid Clockify workspace ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to view that workspace’s projects and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-current-user
tools.description: Returns the currently authenticated Clockify-linked user (at minimum id and name) for use in subsequent workspace and time-entry operations. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid authentication is available and FORBIDDEN when the authenticated identity is not permitted to access Clockify-linked resources. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tools.name: get-workspaces
tools.description: Lists workspaces accessible to the specified Clockify-linked user (id and name), returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when user_id is not a valid Clockify user ULID, when status is not one of the allowed values, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when the user does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to list workspaces for that user and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID to list accessible workspaces for.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-time-entries
tools.description: Lists time entries for a workspace owned by the specified Clockify-linked user, returning up to limit results and a next_cursor when more pages are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Supports filtering by status, time range, and optional project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when date-time filters are invalid, or when limit/cursor are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN when the user does not have an active membership in the workspace; raises NOT_FOUND when referenced resources do not exist.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list time entries for.

user_id.description: Clockify-linked user ULID that owns the time entries.

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to filter time entries by.

from_time.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

to_time.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for start_time (RFC3339/ISO-8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get-time-entry
tools.description: Fetches a single time entry by ULID and returns the full time entry record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when id is not a valid time entry ULID; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the workspace/user that owns the time entry.

tools.name: update-time-entry
tools.description: Updates writable fields on a time entry and returns the updated record. Supports valid lifecycle transitions for time_entries.status: pending -> created/failed/cancelled; failed -> pending/cancelled. A transition to pending re-queues the integration to attempt upstream creation again; cancelled prevents further attempts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when ULIDs do not match required prefixes/patterns, when start_time/end_time are not RFC3339 timestamps, when end_time is before start_time, when project_id does not belong to workspace_id, or when an invalid status transition is requested; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to mutate the time entry; raises NOT_FOUND when the time entry (or referenced project) does not exist.

start_time.description: Updated start time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Required if end_time is provided.

end_time.description: Updated end time (RFC3339/ISO-8601). Use null to represent a running entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach to the time entry.

project_id.description: Project ULID to associate, or null to clear the project.

status.description: New status for the time entry; must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tools.name: fetch_f1_season
tools.description: Fetches a single season record by year, including its ingestion status and source metadata. Returns NOT_FOUND if the season does not exist. year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

tools.name: upsert_f1_season
tools.description: Creates a new season record or updates an existing one for the specified year. Supports setting source metadata and moving the season through valid lifecycle states (for example pending->active, active->refreshing, refreshing->active, failed->refreshing, active->archived). Refuses invalid transitions and refuses writes when the caller is not permitted. Returns the stored season record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid year or malformed body, CONFLICT on invalid lifecycle transition, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN on insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

year.description: Season year; must be parseable to an integer in [1950, 2100].

source.description: Upstream provider identifier (for example, a feed name).

source_revision.description: Opaque upstream revision or checksum used to track refreshes.

status.description: Target season status. Transition must be valid per lifecycle.

last_synced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for when the upstream sync completed.

events.description: List of events to upsert for the season (matched by round within the season).

round.description: Championship round number within the season.

Supports kinds: race_result, driver_standing, constructor_standing and setting data_status to drive lifecycle transitions (provisional<->official/amended). position.description: Numeric position/rank; may be omitted for non-classified entries.

points.description: Points awarded or total points for standings snapshot.

wins.description: Wins count for standings snapshot, if available.

standing_round.description: Round number the standings snapshot corresponds to. If omitted/null, treated as 'latest' snapshot when serving.

set_event_status.description: Optional event status updates to apply in the same call.

status.description: Target event status; transition must be valid.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Checks availability for the requested fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) and, when available for the TLD, returns pricing estimates for the requested term and currency, optionally including premium-domain pricing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the account_id or fqdn is malformed, the currency is not supported, or term_years is outside 1–10. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id to use for availability/pricing checks.

term_years.description: Registration term length in years used to estimate/register pricing.

include_premium.description: Whether to include premium-domain availability/pricing when supported.

tools.name: get_dns_hosts
tools.description: Lists DNS host records for the specified domain, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by status, record type, and host plus the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, any filter value is not one of the allowed enums, or limit is outside 1–200. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to retrieve DNS host records for.

status.description: Filter DNS host records by status.

record_type.description: Filter DNS host records by record type.

host.description: Filter DNS host records by host/name (e.g., "@", "www").

limit.description: Maximum number of DNS host records to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of DNS host records.

sort.description: Sort order for returned DNS host records.

tools.name: get_domain_contacts
tools.description: Lists contact sets (registrant/admin/tech/billing) for the specified domain, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by contact status and the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, status/sort is not one of the allowed values, or limit is outside 1–50. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to retrieve contact information for.

limit.description: Maximum number of contact sets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of contact sets.

sort.description: Sort order for returned contact sets.

tools.name: get_domain_info
tools.description: Returns detailed information for a single domain in your account by domain_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id to fetch detailed information for.

tools.name: get_domain_list
tools.description: Lists domains for the specified account, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by status, TLD, exact fqdn, substring search, auto-renew, WhoisGuard state, and expiry date range with the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, any enum filter/sort is invalid, limit is outside 1–200, or expires_before/expires_after are not valid date-time values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id whose domains should be listed.

fqdn.description: Filter by exact fully-qualified domain name.

search.description: Substring search against domain fqdn.

expires_before.description: Return only domains with expires_at before this timestamp.

expires_after.description: Return only domains with expires_at after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of domains.

tools.name: get_tld_pricing
tools.description: Lists TLD pricing rows for the specified account, returning a paged result set using limit and cursor and supporting filtering by TLD, currency, operation type, duration, and effective timestamp, with an option to include rows that have expired and the requested sort order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is malformed, any enum filter/sort is invalid, duration_years is outside 1–10, limit is outside 1–200, or effective_at is not a valid date-time value. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id whose pricing feed should be used.

duration_years.description: Filter pricing by duration in years.

effective_at.description: Return pricing effective at or before this timestamp.

include_expired.description: Whether to include pricing rows whose expires_at has passed.

limit.description: Maximum number of pricing rows to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of pricing rows.

sort.description: Sort order for returned pricing rows.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Creates a domain registration request for the specified FQDN under the given account using the provided contact_set, term_years (1–10), and optional WhoisGuard add-on, and returns the resulting registration record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or fqdn is malformed, term_years is outside 1–10, required contact_set sections are missing, or contact_set is not an object containing registrant/admin/tech/billing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist, and CONFLICT if the domain is not available to register.

account_id.description: Namecheap account id to place the registration under.

term_years.description: Number of years to register the domain for.

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard privacy to the registration.

contact_set.description: Contact data to use for registration (registrant/admin/tech/billing).

registrant.description: Registrant contact fields for the domain registration.

admin.description: Administrative contact fields for the domain registration.

tech.description: Technical contact fields for the domain registration.

billing.description: Billing contact fields for the domain registration.

tools.name: create_domain_registration_order
tools.description: Creates a new domain registration order in status 'draft' for the authenticated account and FQDN, capturing desired term, currency context, optional WhoisGuard, and an optional existing contact_set_id. If a non-terminal order already exists for the same account and fqdn, the service may return that order instead of creating a duplicate. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fqdn is invalid, term_years is outside 1–10, or required fields are missing.

currency.description: Currency context for pricing snapshot and subsequent registration.

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard (when supported for the TLD).

contact_set_id.description: Existing contact set id to use for registration; must belong to the same domain once created/linked.

tools.name: get_domain_registration_order
tools.description: Returns a single domain registration order by order_id for the authenticated account, including its current status, availability result (if checked), and any stored Namecheap order/transaction identifiers. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if order_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the order does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated account.

order_id.description: Domain registration order id to fetch.

tools.name: update_domain_registration_order
tools.description: Updates a draft/failed domain registration order fields (term_years, add_whois_guard, contact_set_id) or transitions its status where allowed by the lifecycle. Rejects invalid status transitions and refuses updates for terminal orders. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if order_id is malformed, term_years is outside 1–10, or the requested transition is not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the order does not exist or is not owned by the authenticated account.

order_id.description: Domain registration order id to update.

term_years.description: New registration term length in years (1–10).

add_whois_guard.description: Whether to add WhoisGuard (when supported for the TLD).

contact_set_id.description: Contact set id to associate with this order.

status.description: Requested new order status. Transition must be allowed by the order lifecycle.

tools.name: set_dns_hosts
tools.description: Replaces the active DNS host records for a domain with the provided set (authoritative sync). Records not present in the requested set are soft-deleted by transitioning them to status 'deleted'; new/changed records are upserted as 'active' while enforcing uniqueness across active records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if domain_id is malformed, any record_type is invalid, ttl is outside 60–86400 when provided, mx_pref is outside 0–65535 when provided, or the payload contains duplicates. Raises NOT_FOUND if the domain_id does not exist.

domain_id.description: Domain id whose DNS host records will be replaced.

hosts.description: Complete desired set of active DNS host records for the domain.

value.description: Record value/content (e.g., IP address, target hostname, text).

mx_pref.description: MX preference/priority (0–65535), required for MX records.

is_frozen.description: When true, record is treated as locked from modification by background sync.

Refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid filters and UNAUTHORIZED/RATE_LIMITED when the caller lacks access or quota.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

headword_prefix.description: Prefix match on display headword (case-insensitive, implementation-defined).

page_size.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

page_token.description: Opaque token to continue a previous listing.

tools.name: create_lexicon_entry
tools.description: Creates a new lexicon entry (lemma/headword) in the lexical inventory. Enforces uniqueness for (normalized_headword, language, source) among non-deleted entries and returns the created entry. Refuses INVALID_ARGUMENT on validation failures and CONFLICT when uniqueness constraints are violated.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

headword.description: Display headword/lemma as stored (may include capitalization).

normalized_headword.description: Normalized form used for exact-match lookup (must match service normalization rules).

source.description: Dictionary source identifier (e.g., vendor name or corpus tag).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; cannot be created as deleted.

tools.name: update_lexicon_entry
tools.description: Updates fields on an existing lexicon entry and/or transitions its lifecycle status according to the allowed state machine (active↔deprecated, active/deprecated→deleted). Returns the updated entry. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, INVALID_ARGUMENT for illegal updates, and CONFLICT for uniqueness violations.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

id.description: Primary key of the lexicon entry to update.

normalized_headword.description: New normalized headword; must still be unique per (normalized_headword, language, source) among non-deleted entries.

tools.name: create_entry_sense
tools.description: Creates a sense/definition under an existing lexicon entry. Enforces foreign key validity and uniqueness for (entry_id, sense_order) among non-deleted senses. Returns the created sense. Refuses NOT_FOUND if entry_id does not exist, INVALID_ARGUMENT for malformed input, and CONFLICT on order collisions.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

entry_id.description: Parent lexicon entry id; must exist.

part_of_speech.description: Part of speech label (e.g., noun, verb, adj).

definition.description: Rich definition text (may include markup depending on source).

definition_plain.description: Plain-text definition suitable for display without markup.

sense_order.description: Sort key for senses under the same entry (ascending).

labels.description: Optional usage labels (e.g., slang, archaic).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; cannot be created as deleted.

tools.name: create_sense_example
tools.description: Creates an example usage under an existing sense. Enforces foreign key validity and uniqueness for (sense_id, example_order) among non-deleted examples. Returns the created example. Refuses NOT_FOUND if sense_id does not exist, INVALID_ARGUMENT for malformed input, and CONFLICT on order collisions.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

example_order.description: Sort key for examples under the same sense (ascending).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; deleted is terminal.

tools.name: get_caller_profile
tools.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit status for the Dictionary MCP Server. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing or invalid.

api_key.description: Caller credential used to authenticate to the Dictionary MCP Server.

tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: Searches our indexed Wikipedia titles/keywords in the requested language and returns a page of matching articles sorted by the selected mode, with up to `limit` results and an opaque `cursor` you can pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query`/`language_code` are missing, `limit` is outside 1–50, `sort`/`status` is not one of the allowed values, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded. Returns NOT_FOUND only when the requested `language_code` is unsupported by the index; otherwise an empty result set is returned when there are no matches.

query.description: Search query string to match against Wikipedia titles/keywords.

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code to search within (e.g., 'en').

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort mode for results (relevance based on match vs popularity score).

status.description: Filter search index entries by status.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetches the full content for a Wikipedia article as a cached snapshot, resolved by `article_id` (preferred) or by (`title`/`page_id` + `language_code`), and returns content in `html`, `text`, or `both`; when `force_refresh=true` we bypass cache and refetch the latest snapshot before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are missing/ambiguous, `article_id` does not match the expected pattern, `format` is invalid, or `language_code` is missing when using `title`/`page_id`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access article content and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when no article exists for the resolved key (or the snapshot id is unknown) and CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but the article is currently locked for cache invalidation/rebuild.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID) to fetch.

title.description: Wikipedia article title to fetch (used if article_id is not provided).

page_id.description: Wikipedia page id to fetch (used if article_id/title is not provided).

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the article (required when using title or page_id).

format.description: Which full-content format to return.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and refetch the latest article snapshot.

tools.name: get_summary

format.description: Output format for the generated report.
