tools.name: manage_cis_compliance
tools.description: Performs CIS compliance operations for a tenant: list_benchmarks returns available CIS benchmarks (optionally filtered) in pages using limit and cursor, run_assessment starts an assessment for the provided target and returns the created assessment/assessment_run record, and get_assessment/list_findings/create_evidence/generate_report/update_record_status read or mutate a specific compliance record_id and return the resulting record or paged list where applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required parameters for the selected action are missing (e.g., record_id for get_assessment/update_record_status/create_evidence/generate_report), when filters/sort/limit are invalid, or when body contains unsupported fields or status/severity values outside the allowed enums; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks tenant access. Raises NOT_FOUND when record_id (or parent_record_id/related_operation_id when supplied) does not exist in the tenant scope, CONFLICT when update_record_status requests a disallowed status transition (e.g., archived back to active/running) or when actions are attempted on records in a state that cannot accept them (e.g., generating a report from a still-running assessment), and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when assessment or report actions exceed per-tenant execution limits.

score.description: Numeric score for an assessment or report.

details.description: Arbitrary structured details for the compliance record (e.g., CIS control results, evidence metadata).

parent_record_id.description: Parent compliance record id to relate the created record under.

related_operation_id.description: Operation id that produced or is associated with this compliance record.

record_type.description: Filter returned compliance records by record type.

status.description: Filter returned compliance records by status.

severity.description: Filter returned compliance records by severity.

deviceType.description: Optional filter to only return devices of the specified type.

status.description: Optional filter to only return devices with the specified status.

limit.description: Maximum number of devices to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sortBy.description: Field to sort returned devices by.

includeSystemApps.description: Whether to include system apps in the returned list.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sortBy.description: Field to sort returned apps by.

tools.name: crm_create_company
tools.description: Creates a new company CRM object using the provided property values and optionally creates the specified associations, returning the created company record (including its id and stored properties). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, property values don’t match the expected types/allowed values (for example invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), or association payloads are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create companies or associations; and raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when the request attempts an unsupported association type for companies or otherwise violates association constraints enforced by the CRM model.

tools.name: crm_update_company
tools.description: Updates an existing company identified by companyId with the provided property changes and returns the updated company record. Raises NOT_FOUND when companyId does not exist (or is archived and cannot be updated), VALIDATION_ERROR when property values are invalid (including invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot update companies, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when the update is refused due to an invalid state transition supported by the model (for example attempting to update a record that is not eligible for modification).

tools.name: crm_get_company
tools.description: Retrieves a single company by companyId and returns the company record with the requested properties and, when requested, associated object ids for supported association names (contacts, deals, tickets). Raises NOT_FOUND when the company does not exist (or is archived and not retrievable in the current context), VALIDATION_ERROR when requested property or association names are invalid/unsupported, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. If properties is omitted, the endpoint returns the default property set stored for the object.

tools.name: crm_search_companies
tools.description: Searches companies using one or more filterGroups and returns a paged result set of matching companies including the requested properties, ordered by the optional sorts; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the opaque after cursor returned by the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are malformed, operators are incompatible with the property type, BETWEEN/IN operators are missing values, limit is out of range, or sorts reference invalid properties; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks company search/read permission; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Returns an empty page when no companies match, and raises NOT_FOUND only when a referenced property definition required to evaluate the query does not exist in the synced schema.

tools.name: crm_batch_create_companies
tools.description: Creates multiple companies in a single request and returns a batch result containing the created company records for successful inputs along with per-input failures when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty or any input has invalid properties/associations (including invalid website URI or lifecyclestage), raises NOT_FOUND when any association target id referenced by an input does not exist, raises FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot create companies, and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when any input requests an unsupported association type for companies or violates association constraints enforced by the CRM model.

tools.name: crm_batch_update_companies
tools.description: Updates multiple companies in one request and returns a batch result with per-company success records and per-input errors. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty or any item is missing id/properties or contains invalid property values, raises NOT_FOUND when an id does not exist (or is archived and cannot be updated), raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks update permission, and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when an update is refused due to a state transition or modification constraint enforced by the CRM model.

tools.name: crm_get_company_properties
tools.description: Lists company property definitions from the synced schema and returns the set of properties, optionally including archived definitions when archived=true; if properties is provided, only those named definitions are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when requested property names are invalid, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to read CRM schemas, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when a requested property name does not exist in the company property schema.

tools.name: crm_create_company_property
tools.description: Creates a new company property definition (name/label/type/fieldType/groupName plus optional options and flags) and returns the created property metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, type/fieldType are unsupported, options are invalid for the chosen type, or the name format is invalid; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot modify CRM schemas; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT when a property with the same name already exists or when the requested definition conflicts with existing schema constraints.

tools.name: crm_list_objects
tools.description: Lists CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns a paged collection of records with the requested properties; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the opaque after cursor returned by the previous page, and archived controls whether archived records are included. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when objectType is unsupported, limit is out of range, or requested property names are invalid for the given type; raises FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read permission for that object type; and raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Returns an empty page when no records match the requested criteria.

tools.name: crm_get_object
tools.description: Gets a single CRM object of the given objectType by id and returns the object record with stored properties for that type. Raises NOT_FOUND when the object id does not exist for the specified type (or is archived and not retrievable in the current context), VALIDATION_ERROR when objectType is unsupported or requested property names are invalid for that type, FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. If no property selection is provided, the endpoint returns the default property set for the object type.

tools.name: crm_create_object
tools.description: Creates a new CRM object of the specified objectType with the provided properties and optional initial associations, and returns the created object including its assigned id (and any created association links). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectType is unsupported, properties is missing/invalid, association entries are malformed, or associationTypeId/associationCategory are not valid for the from/to pair; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create that object type or to create the requested association links; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_update_object
tools.description: Updates the properties of an existing CRM object identified by objectId and returns the updated object. Raises NOT_FOUND if the objectId does not exist (or is not available in the synced dataset), VALIDATION_ERROR if properties is missing/invalid or contains values that fail type/format constraints, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to update that object type, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_archive_object
tools.description: Archives (deletes) the CRM object identified by objectId and returns a success confirmation for the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the object does not exist, CONFLICT if the object is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state/constraints, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to archive that object type, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_search_objects
tools.description: Searches objects of the given objectType using filterGroups and returns a page of matching results; paging is cursor-based using limit (max 100) and the returned paging.after value, which you pass back as after to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are malformed, an operator is not supported for the property, required filter values are missing (e.g., BETWEEN/IN), sorts are invalid, or limit/after are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_create_objects
tools.description: Creates multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-input results (created records and/or per-item errors) for the batch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/invalid, any item is missing properties, or any association specification is malformed/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create that object type or requested association links; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_read_objects
tools.description: Reads multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType by objectIds (optionally using idProperty) and returns the requested properties and optional propertiesWithHistory for each requested id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectIds is missing/invalid, idProperty is invalid, or requested properties/propertiesWithHistory are not valid for the object type; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist (rather than failing the entire batch); raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_update_objects
tools.description: Updates multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-input results (updated records and/or per-item errors). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/invalid, any item is missing id/properties, or any property value fails validation; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to update that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_archive_objects
tools.description: Archives (deletes) multiple CRM objects of the specified objectType and returns per-id results for the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if objectIds is missing/invalid; returns NOT_FOUND per object when an id does not exist; returns CONFLICT per object when it is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state/constraints; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to archive that object type; raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_list_association_types
tools.description: Lists the available association types that can be used between fromObjectType and toObjectType, returning the supported associationCategory and associationTypeId values for that pair. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either object type is unsupported, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read association metadata, NOT_FOUND if the object-type pair is not recognized by the backend, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_get_associations
tools.description: Returns a paged list of associated toObjectType records (or association links) for the given fromObjectType/fromObjectId pair; paging is cursor-based using limit (max 500) and the returned paging.after value, which you pass back as after to fetch the next page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the from object does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if limit/after are invalid or the object-type pair is unsupported, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to read either the from object or its associations, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_create_association
tools.description: Creates one or more association links from a source CRM object to a target CRM object using the provided association category and type IDs, and returns the created association(s). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any object type is unsupported, IDs are missing/invalid, or associationTypes is empty or contains malformed entries; raises NOT_FOUND if either object ID does not exist in the synced CRM subset. Raises CONFLICT if the requested association type cannot be applied between the given object types or the association already exists, and raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access or RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_archive_association
tools.description: Archives (removes) the association link between the specified source and target CRM objects and returns a confirmation of the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if object types or IDs are missing/invalid or the from/to types are unsupported, and raises NOT_FOUND if either object does not exist or no association exists between them to archive. Raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_create_associations
tools.description: Creates associations in bulk for the given from/to object types and returns per-input results indicating which associations were created (and which failed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fromObjectType/toObjectType are unsupported, inputs is empty/malformed, or any input is missing from.id, to.id, or types entries. Raises NOT_FOUND for inputs referencing objects that don’t exist in the synced CRM subset, CONFLICT for inputs whose association types are incompatible or already present, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota constraints are violated.

tools.name: crm_batch_archive_associations
tools.description: Archives (removes) multiple associations in one request for the given from/to object types and returns per-input results for each attempted archive. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fromObjectType/toObjectType are unsupported, inputs is empty/malformed, or any input is missing from.id or to.id. Raises NOT_FOUND for inputs where either object does not exist or no association exists to archive, and raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access or quota constraints are violated.

tools.name: crm_create_contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact using the provided properties and optional initial associations, and returns the created contact record (including its HubSpot ID and stored properties). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if properties are missing, if email/website formats are invalid, if enumerated fields (lifecyclestage/leadstatus) are outside the allowed values, or if associations payload entries are malformed. Raises CONFLICT when a unique constraint is violated (for example, an email already exists when uniqueness is enforced) and NOT_FOUND when an associated target object ID does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED for insufficient CRM write access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_update_contact
tools.description: Updates an existing contact identified by contactId with the provided properties and returns the updated contact record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if contactId is missing/invalid, if provided property values fail validation (email/website formats, enum values), or if the properties object is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist in the synced CRM subset, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT if the update violates constraints (for example, setting email to a value that conflicts with another contact), and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves a single contact by ID and returns the contact record including the requested property fields and any requested association collections (companies, deals, tickets, calls, emails, meetings, notes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if contactId is missing/invalid or if requested associations contain unsupported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist in the synced CRM subset, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM read access, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_search_contacts
tools.description: Searches contacts using filterGroups and optional sorts, returning a paged result set of matching contacts with the requested properties; paging uses limit (1–100) and the response provides an after cursor to pass back for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are missing or malformed, if operators are unsupported for the given filter shape (for example, missing value where required), if limit is out of range, or if sort directives are malformed. Raises FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: crm_batch_create_contacts
tools.description: Create multiple contacts in a single request

tools.name: crm_batch_update_contacts
tools.description: Update multiple contacts in a single request

tools.name: crm_get_contact_properties
tools.description: Returns the list of contact property definitions, optionally filtered to a specific set of property names and/or including archived properties when `archived` is true; the response is the full list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `properties` contains non-strings or invalid values, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema read access or the request exceeds applicable rate limits.

tools.name: crm_create_contact_property
tools.description: Creates a new contact property definition in the specified `groupName` and returns the created property, including any configured options and display settings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, `type`/`fieldType` values are not supported, options are malformed (e.g., missing `label`/`value`), or option values are inconsistent with the chosen type; raises CONFLICT if a contact property with the same `name` already exists, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema write access or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_create_lead
tools.description: Creates a lead CRM object using the supplied `properties` (validating formats like `email` and `website`) and optional `associations`, and returns the newly created lead record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if property values fail schema/format validation, enum values (e.g., `leadstatus`, `rating`) are invalid, association payloads are malformed, or association type identifiers are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced associated object id does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_update_lead
tools.description: Updates an existing lead identified by `leadId` with the provided `properties` and returns the updated lead record. Raises NOT_FOUND if `leadId` does not resolve to an existing lead, VALIDATION_ERROR if any provided property value is invalid (including enum/format constraints), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_get_lead
tools.description: Fetches a single lead by `leadId` and returns it with the requested `properties` and any requested `associations` (e.g., companies, contacts, deals, notes, tasks). Raises NOT_FOUND if the lead does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if an unsupported association name is requested, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_search_leads
tools.description: Searches leads matching the provided `filterGroups` and returns a paged result set of leads containing the requested `properties`, sorted by `sorts`; pagination uses `limit` (1–100) and the returned `after` cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are malformed, use unsupported operators, reference invalid property names, or `limit` is out of range, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to search/read leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_batch_create_leads
tools.description: Creates multiple leads in one request from `inputs` and returns a batch result for each input (created record or error). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any input is missing required fields, contains invalid property formats/enums, or has malformed associations; raises NOT_FOUND when an input references a non-existent associated object id, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_batch_update_leads
tools.description: Updates multiple existing leads in one request from `inputs` and returns a batch result for each input (updated record or error). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any input is malformed or contains invalid property formats/enums, NOT_FOUND for any input whose `id` does not match an existing lead, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update leads or is rate-limited.

tools.name: crm_get_lead_properties
tools.description: Returns the list of lead property definitions, optionally including archived properties when `archived` is true and optionally filtered to a provided set of property names; the response is the full list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `properties` is present but not an array of strings, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks CRM schema read access or the request exceeds applicable rate limits.

tools.name: crm_create_lead_property
tools.description: Create a new lead property

tools.name: meetings_list
tools.description: Returns a paged list of meeting CRM objects, optionally filtered by createdAfter/createdBefore, and optionally projecting only the requested properties; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor returned from the previous page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, if after/createdAfter/createdBefore are not valid datetime strings, or if unknown parameters are supplied. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks read access to meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_get
tools.description: Returns a single meeting by meetingId, including the requested properties and (when requested) associations to contacts, companies, and/or deals. Raises NOT_FOUND when no meeting exists for meetingId, VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingId is missing/invalid or an associations value is not one of the supported types, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks read access to meetings. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_create
tools.description: Creates a meeting CRM object with the provided required properties (hs_timestamp, hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time) and optional properties, and optionally creates the specified associations; returns the created meeting record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, when hs_meeting_outcome is not one of SCHEDULED/COMPLETED/CANCELED, when additional unsupported properties are provided, or when association specs are malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for meetings, NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, CONFLICT when an association type/category is not valid for the target object, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_update
tools.description: Updates an existing meeting identified by meetingId with the provided mutable properties and returns the updated meeting record. Raises NOT_FOUND when meetingId does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when the update payload contains unsupported fields or an invalid hs_meeting_outcome value, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks update permissions for meetings. Raises CONFLICT when the requested update is not allowed due to the meeting’s current state and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) the meeting identified by meetingId and returns an acknowledgment of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND when meetingId does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingId is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks archive permissions for meetings. Raises CONFLICT when the meeting cannot be archived due to its current state and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_search
tools.description: Searches for meetings using filterGroups (AND within a group, OR across groups), returning a paged result set with optional property projection and optional sorting; pagination uses limit (1–100) and the after cursor from the prior page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filters are malformed, operators are not supported, required filter fields are missing, sorts are malformed, or limit/after are invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks read access to meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_batch_create
tools.description: Creates multiple meetings in a single request and returns per-input results for successfully created records (and errors for failed inputs), applying the same validation rules as meetings_create to each input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, when any input is malformed, or when an input contains unsupported properties/invalid enum values; individual inputs may also fail with NOT_FOUND for missing association targets or CONFLICT for invalid association types. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_batch_update
tools.description: Updates multiple existing meetings in a single request and returns per-input results, applying the same validation rules as meetings_update to each input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs is missing/empty, when any input is missing id/properties, or when an input contains unsupported fields/invalid enum values; individual inputs may fail with NOT_FOUND for unknown ids or CONFLICT for disallowed updates in the record’s current state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks update permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: meetings_batch_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) multiple meetings identified by meetingIds and returns per-id results indicating success or failure. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when meetingIds is missing/empty or contains invalid ids; individual ids may fail with NOT_FOUND when the meeting does not exist or CONFLICT when the meeting cannot be archived due to its current state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks archive permissions for meetings and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_create
tools.description: Creates a note CRM object with the provided properties (hs_note_body required; hs_timestamp and hubspot_owner_id optional) and optional associations, returning the created note record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when hs_note_body is missing, when the payload is malformed, or when association specs are malformed; note properties may include additional fields supported by the note object schema. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller lacks create permissions for notes, NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, CONFLICT when an association type/category is not valid for the target object, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_get
tools.description: Returns a single note by noteId, including its properties and (when requested) associated contacts/companies/deals/tickets, and can limit the response to the requested property names. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid, if requested associations include unsupported values, or if the properties list is not an array of strings; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist (or is not available in the synced subset); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_update
tools.description: Updates an existing note’s writable properties (hs_note_body required; optionally hs_timestamp and hubspot_owner_id) and returns the updated note. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid, hs_note_body is missing/empty, or any provided property value is of the wrong type; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist (or is not available in the synced subset); raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT if the note is archived and cannot be updated, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_archive
tools.description: Archives (soft-deletes) the note identified by noteId and returns a success response for the archive operation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteId is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks archive/delete permission, CONFLICT if the note is already archived, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_list
tools.description: Lists notes with cursor-based pagination using limit (1–100) and after, returning results plus paging information when more pages are available; you may request specific properties and include requested associations, and you can include archived records by setting archived=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, after is malformed, properties is not an array of strings, or associations contain unsupported values; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_search
tools.description: Searches notes using filterGroups and optional sorts, returning a paged result set using limit (1–100) and after along with paging metadata when additional results are available; you may also request specific properties in the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups/filters are missing or malformed, an operator is unsupported, required filter fields are absent, sorts are invalid, or limit/after are invalid; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_batch_create
tools.description: Creates multiple notes in a single request from the inputs array and returns per-input created records (and/or per-item errors) including any requested associations created via the supplied association types. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/malformed, any item is missing required properties.hs_note_body, or association payloads are invalid (missing to.id or types); raises NOT_FOUND when an association target id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write/associate permissions, CONFLICT when an item cannot be created due to state constraints, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_batch_read
tools.description: Reads multiple notes by id in a single request and returns the matching notes (and/or per-item errors), optionally including only the requested properties and specified associations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/malformed, an input id is missing/invalid, or associations/properties are invalid; returns NOT_FOUND for any note id that does not exist while still processing other items; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM read access and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_batch_update
tools.description: Updates multiple notes in a single request and returns the updated notes (and/or per-item errors), applying the same writable property rules as single-note updates (hs_note_body required per item). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is missing/malformed, any item is missing id or required properties, or values are of the wrong type; returns NOT_FOUND for any note id that does not exist while still processing other items; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write access, CONFLICT for items that are archived and cannot be updated, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: notes_batch_archive
tools.description: Archives (soft-deletes) multiple notes identified by noteIds and returns per-id results (and/or per-item errors). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if noteIds is missing, not an array, or contains invalid ids; returns NOT_FOUND for any id that does not exist while still processing other ids; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks archive/delete permission, CONFLICT for ids that are already archived, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: tasks_create
tools.description: Creates a new task CRM object with the provided properties (hs_task_body and hs_task_subject required; optional priority/status/type/timestamps/due date/owner) and optional associations, and returns the created task including its id and stored properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, enums (priority/status) are invalid, date/timestamp fields are malformed, or association payloads are invalid (missing to.id or types); raises NOT_FOUND if an association target id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks CRM write/associate permissions and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: tasks_get
tools.description: Returns a single task by taskId, optionally projecting only the requested properties and including associated records for the requested association types (contacts, companies, deals, tickets). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskId is missing/invalid, if requested properties are not valid task properties, or if associations contains unsupported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist (or is not accessible to the caller) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read tasks.

tools.name: tasks_update
tools.description: Updates an existing task’s properties for the given taskId and returns the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject) are missing, if any provided enum value is invalid (priority/status), or if taskId is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks. Raises CONFLICT if the task is archived and cannot be updated.

tools.name: tasks_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) the task identified by taskId and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to archive tasks. Raises CONFLICT if the task is already archived.

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: Lists tasks, optionally including only the requested properties, including requested associations, and filtering by archived state; results are paged with limit (1–100) and an after cursor returned in the paging block for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, after is malformed, requested properties are invalid, or associations contains unsupported values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to list tasks.

tools.name: tasks_search
tools.description: Searches for tasks matching the provided filterGroups and returns a paged result set ordered by the optional sorts; pagination uses limit (1–100) and an after cursor returned with the response for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filterGroups is empty/invalid, if a filter operator is unsupported for the property or missing required values (e.g., BETWEEN without bounds), if sorts are malformed, or if requested properties are invalid. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to search tasks.

tools.name: tasks_batch_create
tools.description: Creates multiple tasks from the inputs array and returns the created task records, applying any provided associations at creation time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, if any input is missing required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject), if enum values are invalid, or if association type payloads are malformed. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to create tasks and NOT_FOUND if an association target id does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: tasks_batch_read
tools.description: Reads multiple tasks by id and returns the task records, optionally projecting requested properties and including requested association types per input. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, any id is missing/invalid, requested properties are invalid, or associations contains unsupported values. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read tasks and NOT_FOUND for any task id that does not exist (or is not accessible).

tools.name: tasks_batch_update
tools.description: Updates multiple existing tasks and returns the updated task records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs is empty/invalid, if any input is missing id or required properties (hs_task_body, hs_task_subject), or if enum values are invalid; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to update tasks. Raises NOT_FOUND if any task id does not exist and CONFLICT if any referenced task is archived and cannot be updated.

tools.name: tasks_batch_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) all tasks listed in taskIds and returns an empty success response when the operation completes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if taskIds is empty/invalid or contains invalid ids, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to archive tasks. Raises NOT_FOUND for any task id that does not exist and CONFLICT for any task that is already archived.

tools.name: engagement_details_get
tools.description: Returns the engagement-like activity object identified by engagementId. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if engagementId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the engagement does not exist (or is not accessible to the caller), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller lacks permission to read engagements.

tools.name: engagement_details_create
tools.description: Creates a new engagement object (EMAIL, CALL, MEETING, TASK, or NOTE) with the provided engagement fields, optional metadata, and optional associations to contacts/companies/deals/tickets/owners, and returns the created engagement record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing (at minimum engagement.type and engagement.title), if enum values are invalid, or if association arrays are not arrays of IDs; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create engagements. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded and CONFLICT when the request attempts an unsupported association shape or duplicates that cannot be applied atomically.

tools.name: engagement_details_update
tools.description: Updates an existing engagement’s details and optional metadata by engagementId and returns the updated engagement record. Raises NOT_FOUND if engagementId does not exist (or is not accessible), VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including engagement.type and engagement.title) or values violate enum/format constraints, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the engagement. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded and CONFLICT if the engagement is in a state that cannot be modified or the update would apply an unsupported/invalid change set.

tools.name: engagement_details_list
tools.description: Lists engagements, optionally filtered by startTime/endTime and activityTypes, and returns a page of results. Pagination is offset-based: provide limit (1–100) and offset to fetch the next page; the response includes the current slice of engagements in that window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid limit/offset or malformed filters, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list engagements, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tools.name: engagement_details_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) an engagement by engagementId and returns confirmation of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the engagementId does not exist (or is not accessible) and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive engagements. Raises CONFLICT if the engagement is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

tools.name: engagement_details_get_associated
tools.description: Lists engagements associated with a specific CRM object (CONTACT, COMPANY, DEAL, or TICKET) and returns a paged result set, optionally filtered by time range and activityTypes. Pagination is offset-based: use limit (1–100) and offset to page through associated engagements for the given objectId. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid objectType/filters/paging parameters, NOT_FOUND if the referenced object does not exist (or is not accessible), FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read associations/engagements, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tools.name: calls_create
tools.description: Creates a Call CRM object with the provided call properties and optional associations, and returns the created call record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties are missing (hs_call_body and hs_call_title), if enums/URI formats are invalid, or if association inputs do not match the required {to, types} structure; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create call records. Raises NOT_FOUND if an association target id cannot be resolved, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the requested association types cannot be applied to a call.

tools.name: calls_get
tools.description: Retrieves a call by callId and returns the call record, optionally including only the requested properties and the requested association types (contacts/companies/deals/tickets). Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible) and VALIDATION_ERROR if requested properties/associations are malformed or unsupported. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read call records and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read limits are exceeded.

tools.name: calls_update
tools.description: Updates an existing call record’s properties by callId and returns the updated call record. Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible), VALIDATION_ERROR if required properties are missing or values violate enum/format constraints (including hs_call_body and hs_call_title), and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit calls. Raises CONFLICT if the call is archived or otherwise not editable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded.

tools.name: calls_archive
tools.description: Archives (deletes) a call record by callId and returns confirmation of the archive operation. Raises NOT_FOUND if callId does not exist (or is not accessible) and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot archive calls. published_before.description: Only return videos published before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

channel_id.description: Filter results to a specific YouTube channel ID.

category_id.description: Filter results to a specific YouTube video category ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

tools.name: memory_create_relations

Refuses requests where the relations list is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses relations that reference entities that do not exist, or that would duplicate an identical existing relation (same from, to, and relationType).

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.description: Appends one or more new observation strings to existing entities and returns the updated entities (or an equivalent acknowledgement of what was appended). entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tools.name: memory_delete_observations

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tools.name: memory_delete_relations
tools.description: Deletes the specified relations and returns what was removed (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where relations is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses deletion when the referenced relation does not exist (no exact match for from, to, and relationType), or when from/to refer to unknown entities.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.name: memory_read_graph

tools.name: memory_create_entities
tools.description: Creates multiple entities in Lattice Recall Graph Service with their entityType and initial observations, and returns the entities that were created (or an equivalent acknowledgement of what was stored). Refuses requests where the entities list is missing/empty, any entity is missing required fields (name, entityType, observations), or values are the wrong type. Refuses creation when an entity name conflicts with an existing entity (names must be unique) or when an entity’s observations are not provided as an array of strings.

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

tools.name: memory_create_relations
tools.description: Creates multiple directed relations (from → to) between existing entities and returns the relations that were added (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where the relations list is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses relations that reference entities that do not exist, or that would duplicate an identical existing relation (same from, to, and relationType).

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.name: memory_add_observations
tools.description: Appends one or more new observation strings to existing entities and returns the updated entities (or an equivalent acknowledgement of what was appended). Refuses requests where the observations list is missing/empty, any item is missing entityName or contents, or contents is not an array of strings. Refuses additions for entity names that do not exist, and refuses observation entries that are not valid strings.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

tools.name: memory_delete_entities
tools.description: Deletes the named entities and any relations connected to them, and returns what was deleted (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where entityNames is missing/empty or contains non-string values. Refuses deletion for entity names that do not exist.

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tools.name: memory_delete_observations
tools.description: Deletes specific observation strings from the specified entities and returns what was removed (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where deletions is missing/empty, any item is missing entityName or observations, or observations is not an array of strings. Refuses deletions for entity names that do not exist, and refuses observation removals when the specified observation text is not present on that entity.

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tools.name: memory_delete_relations
tools.description: Deletes the specified relations and returns what was removed (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where relations is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses deletion when the referenced relation does not exist (no exact match for from, to, and relationType), or when from/to refer to unknown entities.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.name: memory_read_graph
tools.description: Returns the complete knowledge graph, including all entities, their observations, and relations between them. Refuses requests with unexpected parameters that are not supported by this endpoint. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to read the graph.

tools.name: memory_search_nodes
tools.description: Searches the graph for entities matching the query against entity names, entity types, and observation text, and returns the matching nodes (and any directly relevant details the service includes). Refuses requests where query is missing, not a string, or is empty/whitespace-only. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to search the graph.

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

tools.name: memory_open_nodes
tools.description: Fetches the entities for the provided names and returns the matching nodes with their stored details. Refuses requests where names is missing/empty or contains non-string values. Refuses any names that do not correspond to an existing entity, and refuses access when the caller is not permitted to read those nodes.

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

tools.name: getNetworks
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of supported blockchain networks and their metadata, optionally filtered by operational status; results are returned for the requested page (0-based) with up to limit items. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if status is not one of active|maintenance|deprecated or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page.

tools.name: getNetworkDexes
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of DEXes available on the specified network, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

tools.name: getTopPools
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of the top liquidity pools across all networks ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

tools.name: getNetworkPools
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools within a given network ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

tools.name: getDexPools
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools for a specific DEX on a given network ordered by orderBy and sort, using page (0-based) and limit. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network does not exist or if the dex is not available on that network, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported or if page/limit are invalid. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

tools.name: getPoolDetails
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata and current metrics for the specified pool on the given network; if inversed=true, price-related fields are returned from the inverted pair perspective. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inversed is not a boolean or required identifiers are malformed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio

tools.name: getTokenDetails
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata and current metrics for the specified token on the given network. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or tokenAddress is unknown. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required identifiers are malformed, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: getTokenPools
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of top liquidity pools for a token on a given network ordered by orderBy and sort; if address is provided, results are filtered to pools that also contain that additional token address. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or tokenAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if orderBy/sort are not supported, if page/limit are invalid, or if address is malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

address.description: Filter pools that contain this additional token address

tools.name: getPoolOHLCV
tools.description: Returns OHLCV candles for the specified pool over the requested time range at the given interval, up to limit points (max 366); if inversed=true, open/high/low/close prices are returned inverted. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if start/end cannot be parsed, if end is more than 1 year after start, if limit is out of range, or if interval is not supported. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

start.description: Start time for historical data (ISO-8601, yyyy-mm-dd, or Unix timestamp)

end.description: End time for historical data (max 1 year from start)

limit.description: Number of data points to retrieve (max 366) - adjust for different analysis needs

interval.description: Interval granularity for data resolution (1m for short-term analysis, 1h for intraday patterns, 24h for long-term trends)

inversed.description: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (e.g., ETH/USDC vs USDC/ETH)

tools.name: getPoolTransactions
tools.description: Returns a paginated feed of transactions for the specified pool on the given network; pagination can be done by page/limit (0-based) or by providing cursor to continue from a prior position. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network or poolAddress is unknown, and VALIDATION_ERROR if page/limit are invalid or if cursor is malformed. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Number of items per page

cursor.description: Transaction ID used for cursor-based pagination

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches indexed entities (tokens, liquidity pools, and DEXes) by the provided keyword or identifier (including contract/pool addresses) and returns a mixed set of best-matching results; results are not paged for this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `query` is missing or empty, and RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or lacks permission to access search.

query.description: Search term (e.g., "uniswap", "bitcoin", or a token address)

tools.name: getStats
tools.description: Returns aggregated ecosystem statistics computed from indexed DEX data, either globally or scoped to a single network (`network`) and/or a single DEX (`dex`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `network`/`dex` are malformed or mutually inconsistent, NOT_FOUND if the specified network or DEX ID does not exist in the index, and RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED when request quotas are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or lacks permission to access stats.

network.description: Optional network ID to scope stats to a single network (e.g., dxn_ethereum).

dex.description: Optional DEX ID to scope stats to a single DEX (e.g., dxd_01J...).

tools.name: getDexDetails
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata for a specific DEX on the given network. Raises NOT_FOUND if the network does not exist or if the DEX is not available on that network. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

dex.description: DEX identifier (id or slug as returned by getNetworkDexes).

tools.name: getMe
tools.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this API key. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are provided, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

apiKey.description: DexPaprika API key presented by the caller (required when not provided via Authorization header).

tools.name: sequentialthinking_bulk

service_id.description: Service id (rwy_svc_... ULID) to list deployments for.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Searches the mirrored contact list for contacts whose display name or phone number matches the provided query and returns the matching contact records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or not a string, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request rate limit is exceeded.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description:
Get WhatsApp messages matching specified criteria with optional context.
    
    Args:
        after: Optional ISO-8601 formatted string to only return messages after this date
        before: Optional ISO-8601 formatted string to only return messages before this date
        sender_phone_number: Optional phone number to filter messages by sender
        chat_jid: Optional chat JID to filter messages by chat
        query: Optional search term to filter messages by content
        limit: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20)
        page: Page number for pagination (default 0)
        include_context: Whether to include messages before and after matches (default True)
        context_before: Number of messages to include before each match (default 1)
        context_after: Number of messages to include after each match (default 1)

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description:
Get WhatsApp chats matching specified criteria.
    
    Args:
        query: Optional search term to filter chats by name or JID
        limit: Maximum number of chats to return (default 20)
        page: Page number for pagination (default 0)
        include_last_message: Whether to include the last message in each chat (default True)
        sort_by: Field to sort results by, either "last_active" or "name" (default "last_active")

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Retrieves chat metadata for the given chat_jid and, when include_last_message is true, includes the most recent synced message for that chat if available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chat_jid is missing/invalid and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if no chat with that JID exists in the local mirror.

tools.name: get_direct_chat_by_contact
tools.description: Finds the 1:1 (direct) chat associated with the provided sender_phone_number and returns that chat’s metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the phone number is malformed/empty and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if no contact or direct chat matching that phone number exists in the local mirror.

tools.name: get_contact_chats
tools.description:
Get all WhatsApp chats involving the contact.
    
    Args:
        jid: The contact's JID to search for
        limit: Maximum number of chats to return (default 20)
        page: Page number for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: get_last_interaction
tools.description: Returns the most recent synced message where the given contact JID is involved (typically the latest message in the direct chat with that contact, if present). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jid is missing/invalid and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the contact is unknown in the mirror or no messages involving that JID are available.

tools.name: get_message_context
tools.description: Returns a window of messages around message_id, including up to before messages preceding it and up to after messages following it from the same chat, in chronological order with the target message included when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message_id is invalid or before/after are negative, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the message_id does not exist in the local mirror.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Creates an outbound send job to deliver a text message to recipient (phone number in international format without symbols, or a WhatsApp JID for users/groups) and returns the created job record and/or resulting message reference once accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if recipient/message are empty or recipient is not a valid phone/JID, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if sending is rate-limited and NOT_FOUND if the recipient cannot be resolved to a valid chat/contact on the connected account.

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Creates an outbound send job to deliver the media at media_path to recipient (phone number or JID) and returns the created job record and/or resulting message/media reference once accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if recipient is invalid or media_path is missing, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the recipient cannot be resolved to a valid chat/contact, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if sending is rate-limited.

tools.name: send_audio_message
tools.description:
Send any audio file as a WhatsApp audio message to the specified recipient. For group messages use the JID. If it errors due to ffmpeg not being installed, use send_file instead.
    
    Args:
        recipient: The recipient - either a phone number with country code but no + or other symbols,
                 or a JID (e.g., "123456789@s.whatsapp.net" or a group JID like "123456789@g.us")
        media_path: The absolute path to the audio file to send (will be converted to Opus .ogg if it's not a .ogg file)
    
    Returns:
        A dictionary containing success status and a status message

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Creates a download job for the media attached to message_id within chat_jid and returns the job result including a status, message, and the resolved local path when the media is available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message_id/chat_jid are missing/invalid and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the chat or message does not exist in the mirror or the message has no downloadable media, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if downloads are rate-limited.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves a single mirrored contact by identifier (id, jid, or phone_number_e164) and returns the contact record. Refuses ambiguous lookups (multiple matches) with VALIDATION_ERROR, raises NOT_FOUND if no contact exists, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available.

tools.name: update_contact_status
tools.description: Updates a contact lifecycle status in the local mirror (e.g., block/unblock/delete) and returns the updated contact. Only allows valid status transitions as defined by the wa_contacts lifecycle; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND if the contact does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available.

tools.name: update_chat_status
tools.description: Updates a chat lifecycle status in the local mirror (e.g., leave/delete) and returns the updated chat. Only allows valid status transitions as defined by the wa_chats lifecycle; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND if no chat with that JID exists, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available.

tools.name: update_chat_participant_status
tools.description: Updates a group participant lifecycle status in the local mirror (leave/remove) and returns the updated participant record. Only allows valid status transitions as defined by the wa_chat_participants lifecycle; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND if no participant record exists, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available.

tools.name: get_media_item
tools.description: Retrieves a single media item by id or by (external_message_id, chat_jid) and returns the media record including download_status and local_path when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on ambiguous/invalid selectors, NOT_FOUND if no media record exists, and UNAUTHORIZED if the WhatsApp session is not connected/available.

tools.name: get_n8n_info
tools.description: Retrieves the current n8n Assistant deployment metadata and computed status for the requested deployment, optionally filtering by environment, and can include related n8n instances and/or capabilities; when instances are included, set primary_instance_only to return only the instance marked is_primary. Returns a single deployment info object (not paged) with the included related records embedded when requested. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter values (including unsupported environment/include values), NOT_FOUND if no matching deployment exists for the given deployment_id/environment filter, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view deployment details.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to retrieve info for (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

environment.description: Filter to the deployment for a specific environment.

include.description: Which related records to include alongside deployment info.

primary_instance_only.description: If true, only include the primary n8n instance (is_primary=true) when including instances.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: Lists deployments visible to the caller, optionally filtered by environment and status, ordered by updated_at desc. Returns a paginated list; refuses invalid filters.

environment.description: Only return deployments for the given environment.

status.description: Only return deployments with the given lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of deployments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Fetches a single deployment by id. Returns the deployment record; refuses if the id is not found or not accessible.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to fetch (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

include.description: Optionally embed related n8n instances and/or service capabilities.

primary_instance_only.description: If true and instances are included, only return the instance marked is_primary=true (most recently updated if multiple exist).

tools.name: update_deployment
tools.description: Updates mutable deployment fields and/or advances its lifecycle status. Returns the updated deployment; refuses invalid lifecycle transitions or invalid field values.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to update (ULID like n8na_dep_01H...).

public_name.description: Public display name for the deployment.

repository_url.description: Repository URL for the deployment source.

service_base_url.description: Base URL where the assistant service is reachable for this deployment.

git_commit.description: Git commit hash or identifier for the build.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the deployment; must follow allowed transitions.

tools.name: list_n8n_instances
tools.description: Lists n8n instances, optionally filtered by deployment, status, and primary flag, ordered by updated_at desc. Returns a paginated list; refuses invalid filters.

deployment_id.description: Only return instances belonging to this deployment id.

status.description: Only return instances with the given lifecycle status.

is_primary.description: If set, filters instances by whether they are marked primary.

limit.description: Maximum number of instances to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tools.name: update_n8n_instance
tools.description: Updates mutable n8n instance fields and/or advances its lifecycle status. Returns the updated instance; refuses invalid lifecycle transitions, or attempts to violate the single-primary-per-deployment rule.

instance_id.description: n8n instance id to update (ULID like n8na_ins_01H...).

base_url.description: Base URL for the n8n instance.

n8n_version.description: Detected or configured n8n version string.

auth_type.description: How the assistant should authenticate when describing this instance.

is_primary.description: Whether this instance is the primary instance for its deployment.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the instance; must follow allowed transitions.

tools.name: todoist_task_create
tools.description: Creates a new task in the Todoist workspace for the given connection and returns the created task record (including its assigned id and stored due fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, ids do not match their expected prefixes, or if section_id is provided but does not belong to the given project_id; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced project_id, section_id, parent_task_id, or any label_ids do not exist in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the requested hierarchy/state is not allowed (for example, parenting under an incompatible task).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

project_id.description: Project container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in.

section_id.description: Section container id (tdcnb_... ULID) to place the task in (must belong to the project).

parent_task_id.description: Parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to create this as a subtask.

due_string.description: Natural-language due string (stored as raw due_string_raw).

due_date.description: Explicit due datetime (overrides due_string if both provided).

due_timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the due date/time (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles').

label_ids.description: List of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID) to apply to the task.

tools.name: todoist_task_get
tools.description: Retrieves either a single task by task_id or a filtered list of tasks in the connection’s workspace, returning results sorted as requested and paged with limit and an opaque cursor (omit cursor for the first page; the response includes the next cursor when more results exist). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter combinations or formats (including invalid enum values, limit out of range, or malformed ids), and NOT_FOUND when task_id is provided but no matching task exists in the workspace. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible.

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to read from.

task_id.description: Specific task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to fetch.

query.description: Case-insensitive partial content search string to filter tasks.

project_id.description: Filter by project container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

section_id.description: Filter by section container id (tdcnb_... ULID).

parent_task_id.description: Filter by parent task id (tdtsk_... ULID) to list subtasks.

label_ids.description: Filter to tasks that have these label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: todoist_task_update

Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection_id is not accessible, and CONFLICT when the requested move or hierarchy/state change is not permitted (for example, moving into an incompatible section/project pairing).

connection_id.description: Todoist connection id (tdc_... ULID) whose workspace to operate on.

due_date.description: New explicit due datetime.

due_timezone.description: New IANA timezone for due date/time.

label_ids.description: Replace labels with this set of label ids (tdlbl_... ULID).

tools.name: searchContacts
tools.description: Searches contacts using a free-text query plus structured filters and returns a paged list of matching contact records; results are ordered by the provided sort and paged with limit (max 200) and an opaque cursor to fetch the next page, optionally embedding each contact’s notes when include_notes is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter/sort shapes are invalid (including unknown filter keys, missing sort.field/sort.direction when sort is provided, out-of-range limit, invalid date-time ranges, or IDs that fail required patterns), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested workspace or group. Raises NOT_FOUND when a referenced workspace_id or group_id does not exist or is not visible to you, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Free-text query across contact name/title/company/location and identifiers.

filters.description: Structured filters to narrow contact results.

workspace_id.description: Restrict results to a specific workspace.

group_id.description: Only contacts who are active members of the given group.

company.description: Exact or partial match on company name.

company_domain.description: Exact match on company domain (e.g., example.com).

title.description: Exact or partial match on job title.

location.description: Exact or partial match on location.

email.description: Match contacts containing this email in emails array.

phone.description: Match contacts containing this phone in phones array.

social_link.description: Match contacts containing this URL/handle in social_links array.

created_at.description: Filter by contact creation time range.

gte.description: Created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Created at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

updated_at.description: Filter by contact last update time range.

gte.description: Updated at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Updated at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

last_interaction_at.description: Filter by last interaction timestamp range.

gte.description: Last interaction at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Last interaction at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

include_notes.description: Whether to include notes for each returned contact.

tools.name: searchInteractions
tools.description: Searches interactions with free-text plus structured filters and returns a paged list of matching interaction records; results are ordered by the provided sort and paged with limit (max 200) and cursor, optionally including the full primary contact record for each interaction when include_contacts is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort payloads (including unknown filter keys, missing sort.field/sort.direction when sort is provided, out-of-range limit, invalid date-time ranges, invalid numeric ranges for relevance_score, or IDs that fail required patterns), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the specified workspace or to the group used for filtering. filters.description: Structured filters to narrow interaction results.

primary_contact_id.description: Only interactions whose primary contact matches this contact id.

group_id.description: Only interactions whose primary contact is an active member of this group.

external_source.description: Filter by external source name (e.g., calendar provider).

external_id.description: Filter by external source id.

gte.description: Occurred at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

lte.description: Occurred at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

gte.description: Start at or after this timestamp (inclusive).
