tools.name: list_laravel_docs
tools.description: Lists documentation entries available in the local cache, optionally filtered to a single Laravel version, and returns the matching filenames/paths for discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the version format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the requested version is not present in the cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the documentation index is not permitted.

tools.name: search_laravel_docs
tools.description: Runs a full-text search for the required query across cached Laravel docs and, when include_external is true, supported external Laravel service docs; returns matching documents with per-document hit counts. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query or invalid version, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching is not permitted.

tools.name: update_laravel_docs
tools.description: Syncs documentation from upstream sources into the local versioned cache for the requested version (or the default set when version is null) and returns a summary of what was updated; when force is true, it re-syncs even if the cache appears current. This operation is not paged and returns one update result per version/source processed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to run sync operations, CONFLICT if an update is already in progress for the same target, and NOT_FOUND if a specific requested version cannot be resolved or synced from supported sources.

tools.name: laravel_docs_info
tools.description: Returns metadata about the cached documentation set (or a specific version), including last sync/update timestamps and upstream commit identifiers when available. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid version, NOT_FOUND if the requested version has no cached metadata, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to documentation state is not permitted.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_recommendations
tools.description: Returns a curated set of package recommendations based on the provided use_case text, including suggested packages and rationale aligned to the catalog’s categories. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if use_case is missing/blank, FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to recommendations is not permitted, and NOT_FOUND if no recommendations can be produced from the current catalog.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_info
tools.description: Returns the catalog record for the requested package_name, including a normalized name, description, installation/usage notes when available, and any assigned categories. The response is a single object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package_name is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the curated catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package details is not permitted.

tools.name: get_laravel_package_categories
tools.description: Lists all catalog packages that belong to the required category and returns their basic details for comparison/discovery. Results are returned as a single unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the category does not exist or contains no packages in the catalog, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to the package catalog is not permitted.

tools.name: get_features_for_laravel_package
tools.description: Returns common implementation features/patterns associated with the requested package from the curated catalog (for example, typical use cases, integration points, and recommended setup steps when available). The response is a single object or feature list (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if package is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND if the package is not in the catalog or has no feature entry, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if access to package feature details is not permitted.

tools.name: read_laravel_doc_content
tools.description: Fetches and returns the full text content for a specific documentation file identified by filename, optionally within a specific version. The response is a single document (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is missing/blank or version is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the version or file does not exist in the local cache, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if you are not allowed to read documentation content.

tools.name: search_laravel_docs_with_context
tools.description: Runs a full-text search for query across cached docs (and optionally external docs) and returns matches along with a context snippet around each hit, sized by context_length. Results are returned as a single unpaged list for the selected scope (optionally restricted by version). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid query, invalid version, or non-positive/invalid context_length, NOT_FOUND when a specific version is requested but not cached, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if searching or reading snippets is not permitted.

tools.name: get_doc_structure
tools.description: Returns the parsed structure for a single documentation file (by filename) including its sections/headings for the requested version, falling back to the default synced version when version is null. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filename is empty/invalid or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read documentation.

tools.name: browse_docs_by_category
tools.description: Lists documentation entries within a given category for the requested version (or the default synced version when version is null) and returns the category’s documents/sections in browse order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if category is empty/unknown or version is not supported, NOT_FOUND if the category has no documents for that version, and FORBIDDEN/UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to browse documentation.

tools.name: update_external_laravel_docs
tools.description: Syncs and updates the locally-cached documentation for supported external Laravel services (Forge/Vapor/Envoyer/Nova, etc.) and returns a per-service result (updated/skipped/error) along with sync metadata; when services is null it targets all services, and force=true re-fetches even if sources appear up to date. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any requested service key is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks sync privileges, CONFLICT if a sync job for the same service(s) is already in progress, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if sync quotas or upstream rate limits are exceeded.

tools.name: list_laravel_services
tools.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of external Laravel services known to the system, optionally filtered by status and/or key and sorted by the requested field; the response includes up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid status/sort/order, out-of-range limit, or malformed cursor, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service sources.

key.description: Filter by service key (e.g., forge, vapor, envoy, nova).

limit.description: Maximum number of services to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: search_external_laravel_docs
tools.description: Executes a full-text search over cached external Laravel service documentation for the given query, optionally restricted to the provided service keys, and returns matching documents/sections with relevance ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty or any service key is unknown, NOT_FOUND if none of the requested services exist in the catalog, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to search, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when search rate limits are exceeded.

tools.name: get_laravel_service_info
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata for a single external Laravel service (key, display name, source status, and sync/search availability details). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if service is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the service key is not recognized, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view service details.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Returns the server’s configuration metadata used to connect and authenticate with Dart, and does not create or modify any workspace data. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any unexpected parameters are provided, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read configuration for this deployment. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks visible to the caller, optionally filtered by workspace, dartboard, parent task, assignee, lifecycle fields (status/priority/size), tags, text query, and date ranges, and returns a page of results ordered by the requested sort field and direction. Results are paginated with limit (1–200) and cursor; the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, timestamps, enums, or contradictory ranges (e.g., due_after later than due_before), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the requested workspace or dartboard, NOT_FOUND when a specified workspace/dartboard/parent task does not exist or is not visible, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list tasks from.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task ID (subtasks of this task).

assignee_id.description: Filter tasks assigned to a specific user.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to enable branch deploys for.

netlify_site_id.description: Remote Netlify site id to enable branch deploys for (alternative to site_id).

site_id.description: Local site ULID to disable branch deploys for.

Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no account is selected or credentials are missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access Blobs for the site, NOT_FOUND if the site or blob key does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when Blobs/API quotas are exceeded.

tools.description: Creates or overwrites a blob in Netlify Blobs for the given local site_id and key, storing value with the provided encoding and optional content_type, and returns the stored blob’s details. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no account is selected or credentials are missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot write Blobs for the site, NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist, CONFLICT if the write is rejected due to the site/blob state, and RATE_LIMITED when Blobs/API quotas are exceeded.

value.description: Blob content as a UTF-8 string (or base64 if encoding=base64).

content_type.description: MIME content type to store with the blob.

tools.description: Deletes the blob at key from Netlify Blobs for the given local site_id and returns a confirmation of deletion. site_id.description: Local site ULID to delete the blob from.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to list blobs for.

prefix.description: Only return blobs whose keys start with this prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of blobs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list result.

Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no account is selected or credentials are missing/expired when the dev session requires authenticated Netlify features, NOT_FOUND if the local site link does not exist for site_id, CONFLICT if a dev server is already running for the site or the requested port is unavailable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a limit on concurrent sessions/processes is reached.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to start a dev server for.

Raises NOT_FOUND if the local site link does not exist for site_id, CONFLICT if a server is already running for the site or the requested port is unavailable, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if a limit on concurrent sessions/processes is reached.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to serve.

publish_dir.description: Local filesystem path to the built publish directory to serve.

port.description: Local port to serve the built site on.

tools.name: list-recipes

query.description: Optional search string to filter recipes by name/description.

tools.name: run-recipe
tools.description: Runs the specified recipe and returns a run result describing the actions performed and any outputs produced; if site_id is provided, the recipe is executed in the context of that linked site. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if recipe_id is empty or if inputs is not an object. Raises NOT_FOUND if recipe_id does not exist or if site_id is provided but does not refer to a known linked site, and raises CONFLICT if the recipe cannot run for the site’s current state (for example, required site linkage or prerequisites are missing).

recipe_id.description: Identifier of the recipe to run.

site_id.description: Local site ULID the recipe should operate on.

tools.name: build-function
tools.description: Builds the named function for the given linked site and returns a build result (and, when debug is true, includes verbose build output in the response). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id/function_name are missing or invalid, or if deploy_id is provided but is not a valid deploy ULID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the site_id (or provided deploy_id) does not exist, and raises CONFLICT if the function build cannot be associated to the referenced deploy or the requested build context is not compatible with the site’s current configuration.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to build the function for.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to associate this build with.

branch.description: Git branch context for the build (if applicable).

debug.description: Whether to include verbose build output in the event response.

tools.name: invoke-function-advanced
tools.description: Invokes the specified function on the given linked site using the provided HTTP method, path, query, headers, and optional request body, returning the function response (status, headers, and body) and optionally recording an observability event when record_event is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid method, timeout_ms, or when both body_text and body_base64 are provided, or when source fields (e.g., headers/query) are not objects of strings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the site is not linked or the function route cannot be resolved for that site, and raises TIMEOUT if the invocation exceeds timeout_ms; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks access to the site/function context.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID containing the function.

method.description: HTTP method to use for the invocation.

path.description: Additional path appended after the function route (for splat routes).

query.description: Query string parameters to send with the request.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include with the request.

body_base64.description: Request body as base64 (use for binary payloads).

content_type.description: Content-Type header value to set when sending a body.

record_event.description: Whether to record an observability audit event for this invocation.

tools.name: init-site

Raises NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist, and raises CONFLICT if a site with the same identity cannot be created/linked (for example, the name is already taken or the local link would duplicate an existing linked site).

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to create/link the site under.

repo_branch.description: Default branch to use for builds (optional).

local_repo_root.description: Local filesystem path for the repo root to store for this site link.

branch_deploys.description: Branch deploy configuration blob stored on the site record.

env.description: Environment variables to set on the site (key/value).

env_secrets.description: Environment variable keys that should be treated as secret.

Raises NOT_FOUND if site_id is unknown, or if target is 'deploy' and deploy_id does not exist or is not associated with the site.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to open.

target.description: Which URL to open (default site URL, admin URL, or a specific deploy).

deploy_id.description: Local deploy ULID to open when target is 'deploy'.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if path is missing/invalid, if both body and body_text are provided, or if an account_id/site_id/deploy_id is provided but fails format validation. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the selected (or active) account is not authenticated, NOT_FOUND if the referenced local account/site/deploy association does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED or TIMEOUT when the upstream enforces quotas or the request exceeds timeout_ms.

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to use for authentication (defaults to active account if omitted).

method.description: HTTP method for the Netlify API call.

path.description: Netlify API path beginning with '/api/' (or full path portion expected by the broker).

query.description: Query string parameters to include.

body.description: JSON request body to send (for non-GET calls).

body_text.description: Raw text body to send (alternative to 'body').

record_audit.description: Whether to record an auditable observability event for this API call.

site_id.description: Optional local site ULID to associate the audit event with.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to associate the audit event with.

tools.name: list-api-methods

filter.description: Optional substring filter applied to method names/paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of methods to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

Raises NOT_FOUND if the site_id is unknown (or deploy_id is provided but not found), and raises UNAUTHORIZED or RATE_LIMITED when access to logs is not permitted or streaming quotas are exceeded.

site_id.description: Local linked site ULID to stream logs for.

source.description: Log source to stream (site-wide or a specific function).

function_name.description: Function name to stream logs for when source is 'function'.

deploy_id.description: Optional local deploy ULID to scope logs to a deploy/build where supported.

since.description: Start streaming logs from this timestamp (ISO 8601).

include_existing.description: Whether to include recent buffered logs before switching to live stream.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum time to keep the log stream open, in seconds.

tools.name: switch-account
tools.description: Sets the specified local Netlify account as the active account for subsequent operations and returns the updated active-account selection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id does not match the required format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the account_id does not exist locally, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account exists but does not have usable authentication configured.

account_id.description: Local Netlify account ULID to mark as active.

tools.name: watch-deploy
tools.description: Watches a deploy’s status in near real time by polling Netlify for the referenced deploy (resolved by local deploy_id, or by netlify_deploy_id optionally scoped via site_id) and returns a stream of status update events until the deploy reaches any until_status terminal state or timeout_seconds elapses; when include_logs is true, it also emits build/deploy log lines occurring at or after since. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither deploy_id nor netlify_deploy_id is provided, if IDs don’t match the required formats, or if poll_interval_seconds/timeout_seconds are out of range; raises NOT_FOUND if the local deploy/site link cannot be resolved or the Netlify deploy does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/ FORBIDDEN when the active account token cannot access the site/deploy, and RATE_LIMITED when Netlify rejects polling/log fetches due to API limits.

deploy_id.description: Local deploy ULID to watch (tracks a Netlify deploy).

netlify_deploy_id.description: Netlify deploy id/uuid to watch (alternative to deploy_id).

site_id.description: Local site ULID used to resolve a deploy when netlify_deploy_id is provided.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Polling interval in seconds for refreshes while watching.

until_status.description: Stop watching once the deploy reaches any of these terminal statuses.

include_logs.description: Whether to stream build/deploy logs while watching.

since.description: Only emit log lines/events occurring at or after this timestamp.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to watch before stopping.

tools.name: manage-form
tools.description: Performs the requested action (enable, disable, delete, or export) against a specific Netlify form for the given locally linked site_id; for export it returns the submissions export in the requested export_format, optionally filtered inclusively by from/to. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields for the chosen action are missing (form_id, and export_format for export) or if from/to are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the site link or targeted Netlify form id does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when the requested state transition is not applicable (e.g., enabling an already-enabled form or disabling an already-disabled form), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when the active account lacks access or hits Netlify API limits.

site_id.description: Local site ULID whose Netlify forms will be managed.

action.description: Form management action to perform.

form_id.description: Netlify form id to target for enable/disable/delete/export.

export_format.description: Export format when action is export.

from.description: Start timestamp filter for exported submissions (inclusive).

to.description: End timestamp filter for exported submissions (inclusive).

tools.name: get-analytics
tools.description: Fetches analytics for the given locally linked site_id and metric over the inclusive from–to window and returns a time-series dataset bucketed by interval in the specified timezone. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to/interval/timezone are invalid (including from after to) or required fields are missing, and raises NOT_FOUND if the site is not linked locally or is not found in Netlify. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the active account cannot access the site analytics, and RATE_LIMITED when Netlify throttles the analytics query.

site_id.description: Local site ULID to fetch analytics for.

from.description: Start timestamp for the analytics query (inclusive).

to.description: End timestamp for the analytics query (inclusive).

interval.description: Time bucketing interval for returned series data.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for bucketing (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/Los_Angeles').

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.description: Lists locally tracked Netlify account connections, optionally filtering by status and active flag, and returns results with cursor-based pagination. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no caller context is available; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid cursor/limit/sort/order values.

is_active.description: If provided, filters to only active (true) or inactive (false) accounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: oauth_status
tools.description: Returns the user’s current Atlassian OAuth/Jira connection status, including whether an active Jira connection exists and any associated connection identifiers for the given user_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id is missing or does not match the required format, and NOT_FOUND if the user has no stored OAuth state/connection record. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view the specified user’s connection status.

user_id.description: User id to retrieve OAuth/Jira connection status for.

tools.name: start_oauth
tools.description: Starts the Atlassian OAuth authorization flow for the given user_id and returns the authorization URL (and any state needed to complete the redirect) using the provided redirect_uri and optional scopes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id or redirect_uri is missing/invalid (including invalid user_id format), and CONFLICT if there is already an in-progress or active OAuth session/connection for the user that must be completed or cleared before starting a new one. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot initiate OAuth for the specified user.

user_id.description: User id starting the OAuth flow.

redirect_uri.description: OAuth redirect/callback URI that Atlassian will send the user back to.

tools.name: test_jira_connection
tools.description: Validates that the stored Jira connection can authenticate and reach the user’s Jira Cloud site, returning a connectivity result (success/failure details). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither jira_connection_id nor user_id is provided or if provided identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the referenced connection (or the user’s active connection) does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not owned by/accessible to the caller. Raises CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or otherwise not in a testable state.

user_id.description: User id owning the Jira connection (used to resolve their active connection).

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Fetches and returns details for the specified Jira issue_key using the given jira_connection_id, using the cached copy when available unless refresh=true, and updates the local cache on successful fetch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jira_connection_id or issue_key is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the Jira connection does not exist or the issue cannot be found/seen by the connection’s credentials, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use that connection. Raises CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or cannot be used to fetch issues.

jira_connection_id.description: Jira connection id to use for fetching/caching the issue.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key (e.g., PROJ-123) to fetch.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Jira even if a cached issue exists.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Executes the provided JQL against Jira using jira_connection_id and returns a single page of issues starting at start_at with up to max_results, using a cached identical search execution unless refresh=true; the response includes Jira paging fields (startAt/maxResults/total) so clients can request subsequent pages by increasing start_at. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jira_connection_id, user_id, or jql is missing/invalid, if start_at is negative, or if max_results is outside 1–100, and NOT_FOUND if the Jira connection does not exist or the query references resources the connection cannot access. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot execute searches for the given user/connection, and CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or not in a runnable state.

jira_connection_id.description: Jira connection id to use for executing the search.

user_id.description: User id executing the search (used for audit/caching of search executions).

max_results.description: Maximum number of issues to return (Jira max typically 100).

refresh.description: If true, execute against Jira even if an identical cached search exists.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists projects accessible via the specified jira_connection_id from the service’s cached Jira metadata, optionally filtered by local cache status and Jira archived/deleted flags, and returns results paged with limit and an opaque cursor for fetching the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jira_connection_id is missing/invalid, if status is not one of the supported values, or if limit is outside 1–200, and NOT_FOUND if the Jira connection does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access that connection, and CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or project metadata is unavailable due to connection state.

jira_connection_id.description: Jira connection id whose accessible projects should be listed.

status.description: Filter cached projects by local cache status.

archived.description: If set, filter projects by whether they are archived in Jira.

deleted.description: If set, filter projects by whether they are deleted in Jira.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Returns general usage help for the Jira Sprint Dashboard service, or detailed help for a specific topic/command when topic is provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if topic is provided but not a string, and NOT_FOUND if the requested topic is not recognized. Raises UNAUTHORIZED only when help content is restricted by the caller’s access context.

topic.description: Optional help topic or command name to get detailed usage for.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the calling identity for the current access token, including user_id, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid or the caller is not recognized.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetches a single user by id. Returns the user record (excluding any credentials) or raises NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the user.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

user_id.description: User id to fetch.

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Creates a new user record in active status. Returns the created user. Refuses with CONFLICT if a user with the same email already exists, and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Updates mutable fields on a user, including lifecycle status transitions (active/disabled/deleted). Returns the updated user. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal status transitions and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot update the user.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

user_id.description: User id to update.

status.description: New user status. Must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

tools.name: list_jira_connections
tools.description: Lists Jira connections for the given user_id, optionally filtered by connection status. Returns results paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the user is not accessible to the caller.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

user_id.description: User id whose Jira connections to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: update_jira_connection
tools.description: Updates a Jira connection’s mutable fields and drives allowed lifecycle transitions (e.g., revoke, mark error, restart OAuth). Returns the updated connection with token material never included. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND if the connection does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to modify it.

access_token.description: Bearer access token presented to this service.

status.description: New connection status. Must follow allowed lifecycle transitions.

last_error.description: Error message to persist when setting status='error' (ignored otherwise).

tools.name: oauth_status
tools.description: Returns the user’s current Atlassian OAuth/Jira connection status, including whether an active Jira connection exists and any associated connection identifiers for the given user_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id is missing or does not match the required format, and NOT_FOUND if the user has no stored OAuth state/connection record. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to view the specified user’s connection status.

user_id.description: User id to retrieve OAuth/Jira connection status for.

tools.name: start_oauth
tools.description: Starts the Atlassian OAuth authorization flow for the given user_id and returns the authorization URL (and any state needed to complete the redirect) using the provided redirect_uri and optional scopes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id or redirect_uri is missing/invalid (including invalid user_id format), and CONFLICT if there is already an in-progress or active OAuth session/connection for the user that must be completed or cleared before starting a new one. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot initiate OAuth for the specified user.

user_id.description: User id starting the OAuth flow.

redirect_uri.description: OAuth redirect/callback URI that Atlassian will send the user back to.

tools.name: test_jira_connection
tools.description: Validates that the stored Jira connection can authenticate and reach the user’s Jira Cloud site, returning a connectivity result (success/failure details). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither jira_connection_id nor user_id is provided or if provided identifiers are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the referenced connection (or the user’s active connection) does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not owned by/accessible to the caller. Raises CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or otherwise not in a testable state.

user_id.description: User id owning the Jira connection (used to resolve their active connection).

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Fetches and returns details for the specified Jira issue_key using the given jira_connection_id, using the cached copy when available unless refresh=true, and updates the local cache on successful fetch. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if jira_connection_id or issue_key is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the Jira connection does not exist or the issue cannot be found/seen by the connection’s credentials, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use that connection. Raises CONFLICT if the connection is disabled or cannot be used to fetch issues.

jira_connection_id.description: Jira connection id to use for fetching/caching the issue.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key (e.g., PROJ-123) to fetch.

refresh.description: If true, fetch from Jira even if a cached issue exists.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Executes the provided JQL against Jira using jira_connection_id and returns a single page of issues starting at start_at with up to max_results, using a cached identical search execution unless refresh=true; the response includes Jira paging fields (startAt/maxResults/total) so clients can request subsequent pages by increasing start_at. tools.name: process_slash_command
tools.description: Parses and executes a slash-style command (e.g., "/name …" or ">>name …") by resolving the referenced prompt template, validating and binding any provided arguments, and rendering the resulting messages; returns the rendered output and records an execution log entry for usage tracking. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the command string is empty, malformed, or required arguments cannot be satisfied, and NOT_FOUND when the referenced command/prompt does not exist or is not available to run (e.g., not active). Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to execute the command, and CONFLICT when the target prompt is in a lifecycle state that refuses execution (archived/deleted).

command.description: The command to process, e.g., '>>content_analysis Hello world' or '/content_analysis Hello world'

tools.name: listprompts
tools.description: Lists registered slash-command prompt templates, optionally filtered by the provided text, and returns the full matching set (this endpoint does not page results). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the filter value is not a string, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the prompt library. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded.

command.description: Optional filter text to show only matching commands

tools.name: update_prompt
tools.description: Updates an existing prompt template (or prompt chain) by id, including its metadata, system message, user message template, declared arguments, and optional chain steps, and records an operational event; returns the updated prompt definition. Raises NOT_FOUND if the prompt id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or if isChain/chainSteps are inconsistent, and CONFLICT if the update is refused due to lifecycle rules (e.g., attempting to change a deleted prompt or an invalid state transition). Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to modify prompts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded; if restartServer is true, the request may also raise CONFLICT when a restart/reload cannot be performed at that time.

systemMessage.description: Optional system message for the prompt

userMessageTemplate.description: Template for generating the user message

arguments.description: Arguments accepted by this prompt

isChain.description: Whether this prompt is a chain of prompts

promptId.description: ID of the prompt to execute in this step

inputMapping.description: Maps chain inputs to this step's inputs

outputMapping.description: Maps this step's outputs to chain outputs

chainSteps.description: Steps in the chain if this is a chain prompt

restartServer.description: Whether to restart the server after updating the prompt

tools.name: delete_prompt
tools.description: Deletes a prompt template by id, records a delete event, and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, CONFLICT if the prompt cannot be deleted due to lifecycle rules (e.g., already deleted) or if deletion would violate allowed state transitions, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to delete prompts. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded; if restartServer is true, may raise CONFLICT when a restart/reload cannot be performed at that time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the prompt to delete

restartServer.description: Whether to restart the server after deleting the prompt

tools.name: modify_prompt_section
tools.description: Modifies a single named section of an existing prompt (including standard sections like title/description/system/user template, or a custom section), records an operational event, and returns the updated prompt. Raises NOT_FOUND if the prompt id does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if section_name/new_content is empty or invalid, and CONFLICT if the prompt’s lifecycle state refuses modification (e.g., archived/deleted) or the requested change is not allowed. Raises FORBIDDEN when the caller is not authorized to edit prompts, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are exceeded; if restartServer is true, may raise CONFLICT when a restart/reload cannot be performed at that time.

id.description: Unique identifier of the prompt to modify

section_name.description: Name of the section to modify (valid values: 'title', 'description', 'System Message', 'User Message Template', or any custom section)

new_content.description: New content for the specified section

tools.name: get_rss_categories
tools.description: Lists Cointelegraph RSS feed categories, optionally filtered by status/is_active and sorted, and returns a newline-separated list of category names for the current page; use cursor pagination by passing the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and limit to cap results (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or sort/order/status values are not allowed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read categories and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if request limits are exceeded.

is_active.description: Filter categories by whether they are marked active.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description:
Fetch the latest news articles from a specified category.

    Parameters:
    - category (str, optional): The category to fetch news from. Must be one of: 
      'all', 'editors_pick', 'latest_news', 'altcoin', 'bitcoin', 'blockchain', 
      'ethereum', 'litecoin', 'monero', 'regulation', 'features', 'analysis', 
      'follow_up', 'in_depth', 'quiz', 'price_analysis', 'market_analysis', 
      'top_10_cryptocurrencies', 'weekly_overview'. Defaults to 'all'.
    - max_results (int, optional): Maximum number of articles to return. If -1, return all articles. Defaults to -1.
    - max_summary_length (int, optional): Maximum length of each article summary in characters. 
      If -1, return full summary. Defaults to 150.
    - ctx (Context, optional): MCP context for logging or additional functionality.

    Returns:
    - str: A formatted list of the latest articles or an error message if none are found.

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Lists stored articles, optionally filtered by category, status, language, and time window; returns a page of articles with an opaque cursor for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or filter/sort/order values are not allowed.

category_slug.description: Filter to articles associated to this rss_categories.slug; use 'all' to target the designated 'all' category.

published_after.description: Only return articles published at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

published_before.description: Only return articles published at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1–200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

max_summary_length.description: Presentation-only summary truncation length in characters; does not modify stored articles.

tools.name: get_article_by_id
tools.description: Fetches a single stored article by id. Returns the article record if found; raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not accessible.

max_summary_length.description: Presentation-only summary truncation length in characters; does not modify stored articles.

tools.name: update_article
tools.description: Updates writable fields of an existing article, including driving allowed status lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated article. Raises NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a status transition is not permitted, and CONFLICT if canonical_url uniqueness would be violated.

summary.description: Updated stored summary (full text, not truncated).

status.description: Set article lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→removed/tombstoned; removed→active/tombstoned; tombstoned has no outgoing transitions.

tools.name: create_rss_category
tools.description: Creates a new RSS category configuration. Returns the created rss_categories record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid fields and CONFLICT if slug or rss_url already exists where uniqueness is enforced by the service.

slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier used by get_latest_news.category.

rss_url.description: RSS feed URL for this category.

sort_order.description: Sort position; lower values appear first.

is_active.description: Whether the category is active for listing/selection.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the category.

tools.name: update_rss_category
tools.description: Updates an existing RSS category and/or drives allowed status lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated rss_categories record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the category does not exist and VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a status transition is not permitted.

is_active.description: Updated active flag used for filtering/selection.

status.description: Set category lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active→deprecated/disabled; deprecated→active/disabled; disabled→active.

tools.name: search_google_scholar_key_words
tools.description: Runs a keyword search against Google Scholar–style indexing and returns up to `num_results` publication results for `query`, while recording the request and the returned result set for later retrieval/analytics (this endpoint is not paged; increase `num_results` to retrieve more). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `query` is empty/invalid or `num_results` is not a positive integer, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when request/rate limits are reached. Raises `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the Scholar provider cannot be reached or returns an unusable response.

tools.name: search_google_scholar_advanced
tools.description: Executes an advanced Scholar search for `query` with optional `author` and `year_range` filters and returns up to `num_results` publication results, persisting the query and response for reuse/analytics (this endpoint is not paged; increase `num_results` to retrieve more). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `query` is empty/invalid, `num_results` is not a positive integer, or `year_range` is not a valid range (e.g., wrong types or start year greater than end year). Raises `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when request/rate limits are exceeded and `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the upstream Scholar source fails or returns an invalid payload.

tools.name: get_author_info
tools.description: Fetches an author profile for `author_name` and returns the resolved author information, caching/refreshing the stored profile to support reuse and rate-limiting. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `author_name` is empty/invalid and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when profile lookups exceed configured rate limits. Raises `NOT_FOUND` when no matching author profile can be resolved and `UPSTREAM_ERROR` when the upstream provider is unavailable or returns an invalid response.

tools.name: get_current_api_key
tools.description: Returns the calling API key identity and entitlement snapshot, including key status, configured per-minute/per-day limits, and current request counters. Refuses with `UNAUTHORIZED` when no/invalid credentials are presented and `FORBIDDEN` when the key is not usable for this operation.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (used for authentication and quota enforcement).

tools.name: list_scholar_searches
tools.description: Lists previously recorded Scholar searches for the calling API key, newest-first, with optional filtering by status and search_type. Returns a paged list and refuses with `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when the API key is invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

query_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the stored query.

created_after.description: Only return searches created strictly after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return searches created strictly before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response; when provided, other paging params are applied after the cursor position.

tools.name: get_scholar_search
tools.description: Fetches one recorded Scholar search by id for the calling API key, including its execution metadata and terminal/error fields when present. Refuses with `NOT_FOUND` if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row to fetch.

tools.name: list_search_results
tools.description: Lists persisted publication results for a recorded search, ordered by rank ascending. Returns a paged list of result rows with embedded publication fields and refuses with `NOT_FOUND` if the search is unknown/inaccessible or `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row whose results should be returned.

include_raw_result.description: When true, includes the stored raw_result payload for each row; when false, omits it to reduce response size.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tools.name: cancel_scholar_search
tools.description: Attempts to cancel an in-flight search by transitioning its status to `cancelled` (allowed only from `queued` or `running`). On success, sets `completed_at`, clears any pending result materialization, and returns the updated search record. Refuses with `CONFLICT` when the search is already terminal (`succeeded`/`failed`/`cancelled`), `NOT_FOUND` when inaccessible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when credentials are invalid or not active.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller.

search_id.description: Primary key of the scholar_searches row to cancel.

reason.description: Optional human-readable cancellation reason to record for diagnostics.

tools.name: update_api_key_status
tools.description: Transitions the calling API key between lifecycle states (`active` ↔ `suspended`, or to `revoked`). This is intended for self-serve key control (e.g., pause a compromised key); once `revoked`, it cannot be reactivated. Returns the updated API key record and refuses with `CONFLICT` on invalid transitions and `UNAUTHORIZED` when credentials are invalid.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (the key being updated).

status.description: Target lifecycle status. Valid transitions: active→suspended|revoked; suspended→active|revoked; revoked→(none).

step_seconds.description: Query step in seconds for metric/range queries (when applicable).

tools.name: query_prometheus

tools.name: getwalletnfts
tools.description: Returns the NFTs owned by a given wallet on the specified chain, optionally filtered to specific NFT contract addresses, with numeric fields formatted per `format` and optional normalized metadata and media items. Results are paginated with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` returned in the response for the next page; when `excludeSpam` is true we omit items flagged or suspected as spam. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid `address`, invalid `tokenAddresses`, or out-of-range `limit`; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED when your API key cannot access this chain or endpoint; RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: Wallet address to fetch NFTs for.

format.description: Numeric fields formatting.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

excludeSpam.description: Whether to exclude NFTs marked or suspected as spam.

tokenAddresses.description: Optional list of NFT contract addresses to filter results by.

tools.name: getmultiplenfts
tools.description: Returns metadata for up to 25 NFTs on a given chain, where each entry is identified by `token_address` and `token_id`, and may include on-chain details plus off-chain metadata, market data (such as floor price), rarity, and media when available. The response is a single, non-paginated batch corresponding to the submitted `tokens` array, with optional normalized metadata and media items. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `tokens` is empty, exceeds 25 items, contains malformed addresses or token ids, or if `chain` is unsupported; NOT_FOUND when an NFT identifier cannot be resolved or is not indexed for that chain; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

tokens.description: Array (max 25) of NFT identifiers to fetch metadata for.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, invalid `tokenId`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract (or the specific token when `tokenId` is provided) cannot be found or is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to identify owners for.

tokenId.description: Optional token id to get owners of a specific NFT (if omitted, returns owners across the contract).

limit.description: Maximum number of owners to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getnftcontracttransfers
tools.description: Returns transfer events for an NFT contract on the specified chain, optionally filtered by `tokenId` and by an ISO-8601 time window using `fromDate` and `toDate`. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, invalid `tokenId`, malformed dates, `fromDate` after `toDate`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract (or token if specified) is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to fetch transfers for.

tokenId.description: Optional token id to filter transfers to a specific NFT.

fromDate.description: Filter transfers occurring at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

toDate.description: Filter transfers occurring at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getnftbycontracttraits
tools.description: Returns NFTs within a given contract on the specified chain whose metadata matches all provided `traits` (each with `trait_type` and `value`), with optional normalized metadata and media items. Results are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, empty or malformed `traits`, invalid cursor, or out-of-range `limit`; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed or trait search is unavailable due to missing metadata for the collection; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address to search within.

traits.description: Trait filters to match NFTs by attributes.

trait_type.description: Trait name (attribute key) to filter by.

value.description: Trait value to match.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

normalizeMetadata.description: Whether to return normalized metadata fields when available.

mediaItems.description: Whether to include media items (images/animation) when available.

tools.name: getnfttraitsbycollection
tools.description: Returns the distinct trait keys and values observed for NFTs in the specified collection on the given chain, suitable for building attribute filters and discovery. The response is not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain` or invalid contract `address`; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed or has no traitable metadata available; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

address.description: NFT contract address (collection) to explore traits for.

tools.name: getnfttrades
tools.description: Returns indexed trade events for the given NFT contract on the specified chain, optionally filtered by `marketplace` and an ISO-8601 time window using `from_date` and `to_date`. Results are paginated with `limit` (1–100) and an opaque `cursor` returned in the response for subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported `chain`, invalid contract `address`, malformed dates, `from_date` after `to_date`, invalid cursor, or `limit` outside 1–100; NOT_FOUND when the contract is not indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/NOT_ALLOWED and RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tools.name: getnfttradesbytoken
tools.description: Get NFT trades for a specific NFT by specifying a contract addres and token ID.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tools.name: getnfttradesbywallet
tools.description: Returns indexed NFT trade events involving the given wallet on the selected chain, optionally filtered by marketplace and time window, sorted by block_timestamp in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and an opaque cursor; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if chain/address are invalid, limit/order/dates are out of range or from_date > to_date, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your API key cannot access the chain or endpoint, NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: Wallet address to fetch NFT trades for (0x-prefixed for EVM).

marketplace.description: Filter trades by marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return.

tools.name: getnftbulkcontractmetadata
tools.description: Returns contract-level metadata for up to 25 NFT contract addresses on the selected chain (e.g., name, symbol and any available enrichment such as off-chain details and optional floor price fields). Results are returned in request order and may be paginated with limit and cursor when supplied by the backend; use the returned cursor to retrieve remaining contracts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any address is malformed, addresses exceeds 25, or limit is outside 1–25, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

addresses.description: List of NFT contract addresses (max 25; 0x-prefixed for EVM).

include_floor_price.description: Whether to include floor price fields when available.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (if backend paginates results).

limit.description: Maximum number of contracts to return (max 25).

tools.name: getnftmetadata
tools.description: Returns metadata for a single NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, including on-chain fields and any available off-chain/enriched attributes (and normalized fields when normalize_metadata is true). This endpoint returns a single object (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid chain/address/token_id format, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the contract/token_id is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

normalize_metadata.description: Whether to normalize/standardize off-chain metadata fields if available.

tools.name: getnfttransfers
tools.description: Returns indexed transfer events for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, optionally filtered by timestamp window, sorted by block_timestamp in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and cursor; provide the cursor from the previous response to continue. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid (including from_date > to_date or limit/order out of bounds), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT or chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

tools.name: getnfttokenidowners
tools.description: Lists current owner records for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) on the selected chain, typically including each owner wallet and balance/quantity where applicable. The response is paginated using limit and cursor; pass cursor to fetch subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain/address/token_id or limit out of bounds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT or chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

token_id.description: NFT token id (as a string, supports large integers).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of owner records to return.

tools.name: getnftcontractsaleprices

This is an aggregate response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if days is outside 1–3650 or inputs are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the contract is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id or Moralis chain key).

address.description: NFT contract address (0x-prefixed for EVM).

days.description: Lookback window in days to aggregate sale price statistics.

marketplace.description: Filter sale price stats to a single marketplace name (as indexed in events.marketplace).

tools.name: getnftsaleprices
tools.description: Returns aggregated sale-price statistics for the specified NFT (contract address + token_id) over the requested window, including last/low/high/average sale and total trades, optionally filtered by marketplace. If from_date and to_date are provided, the window is defined by those timestamps; otherwise days is used as the lookback window (ending at to_date when provided, or now). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs (including from_date > to_date or days out of 1–3650), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the NFT is not indexed or the chain is unsupported, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

address.description: NFT collection contract address.

token_id.description: NFT token id within the collection.

days.description: Number of days to look back for sales.

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace filter (as indexed on events.marketplace).

from_date.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the sales window; overrides days if provided with to_date.

to_date.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the sales window; defaults to now.

tools.name: getswapsbytokenaddress
tools.description: Returns indexed DEX swap events involving the specified ERC20 token on the selected chain, optionally filtered by block range and/or timestamp range, sorted by block_number/log_index in the requested order. The response is paginated with limit and cursor; supply the returned cursor to continue listing swaps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if token_address/chain are invalid, ranges are inconsistent (e.g., from_block > to_block or from_date > to_date) or limit/order are out of bounds, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the token/chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

token_address.description: ERC20 token contract address to fetch swaps for.

from_block.description: Start block number (inclusive) to filter swaps.

to_block.description: End block number (inclusive) to filter swaps.

limit.description: Maximum number of swap events to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: gettokenholders
tools.description: Returns holder analytics for the specified ERC20 token on the selected chain, including total holders and aggregated holder-supply metrics, with optional trend, distribution, and acquisition sections computed over the requested lookback window. This is an aggregate response (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if token_address/chain are invalid or days is outside the allowed range for requested metrics, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials, NOT_FOUND if the token/chain is not indexed/supported, and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

include_trends.description: Whether to include holder trends metrics in the response.

include_distribution.description: Whether to include holder distribution breakdown in the response.

include_acquisition.description: Whether to include holder acquisition metrics in the response.

days.description: Lookback window in days for computed trend/acquisition metrics.

to_block.description: Compute stats at a specific historical block (if supported by index).

tools.name: gethistoricaltokenholders
tools.description: Track changes in the holder base of an ERC20 token over time. Supports timeseries data for total holders as well as change metrics such as holder distribution and holder acquisition.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

from_date.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the timeseries window.

to_date.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the timeseries window.

interval.description: Bucket size for the holder timeseries.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getmultipletokenprices
tools.description: Returns the latest price (or the price at `to_block` when provided) for up to 100 ERC‑20 contracts on the given `chain`, quoted in the chain’s native currency and USD, and may enrich each result with the requested `include` fields (e.g., metadata, logo, liquidity, market) while optionally filtering illiquid assets via `exclude_low_liquidity`. The response is a single (non-paginated) array aligned to the submitted `tokens` list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain` is invalid, the `tokens` array is empty/over 100, a token entry is missing `token_address`, `to_block` is negative, or `include` contains unsupported values; raises NOT_FOUND when a token contract cannot be resolved on the specified chain (or the requested `exchange` source is unknown for that chain); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or plan quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

to_block.description: Historical block number to price at (if omitted, returns latest).

exchange.description: DEX/exchange identifier to source the price from (if applicable).

include.description: Optional list of extra fields to include per token.

exclude_low_liquidity.description: Whether to exclude tokens below the service's liquidity threshold.

tools.name: gettokenowners
tools.description: Lists top owners for an ERC‑20 `token_address` on `chain`, returning balances and ownership percentages sorted by `order`, and optionally enriching each owner with known entities/labels when `include_entities` is true. Results are cursor-paginated using `limit` (max 500) and `cursor`, and may be filtered by `min_percentage` to only include owners at or above the given threshold. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `chain`/`token_address`, invalid `order`, `limit` outside 1–500, `min_percentage` outside 0–100, or an invalid/expired `cursor`; raises NOT_FOUND if the token does not exist on the specified chain; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of top owners to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

min_percentage.description: Minimum ownership percentage threshold to include an owner.

include_entities.description: Whether to enrich owners with known entities/labels.

tools.name: gettokenmetadata
tools.description: Returns ERC‑20 contract metadata for up to 100 addresses on the given `chain`, including on-chain fields (name, symbol, decimals) and, when available, additional enrichments such as logo/off-chain metadata, total supply, categories, and spam status. The response is a single (non-paginated) list of metadata objects for the requested `addresses`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain` is invalid, `addresses` is empty/over 100, or any address is malformed; raises NOT_FOUND when an address cannot be resolved as a token contract on the specified chain; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

addresses.description: One or more ERC20 contract addresses to fetch metadata for.

tools.name: gettokencategories
tools.description: Lists ERC‑20 token categories available for the specified `chain`, optionally filtered by the search query `q`. Results are cursor-paginated via `limit` (max 1000) and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `chain`, `limit` outside 1–1000, or an invalid/expired `cursor`; raises NOT_FOUND if the chain is unsupported for categories; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

q.description: Search query to filter categories by name.

tools.name: gettokentransfers

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

include_metadata.description: Whether to include event metadata payloads when available.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

address_ids.description: List of wallet address ids to fetch native balances for.

tools.name: getwalletapprovals

token_contract_address_id.description: Optional ERC20 contract address id to filter approvals to a single token.

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

wallet_address_id.description: Wallet address id to fetch decoded transaction history for.

include_internal_transfers.description: Whether to include native/internal transfer-like movements derived from decoded traces.

include_token_transfers.description: Whether to include ERC20 transfer events in the history view.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getwallettokenbalancesprice
tools.description: Fetch ERC20 and native token balances for a given wallet address, including their USD prices. chains.description: List of chain ids to include in the cross-chain net worth calculation.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude tokens marked as suspected_spam/spam.

exclude_low_liquidity.description: Whether to exclude tokens with very low or missing liquidity metrics.

exclude_inactive.description: Whether to exclude tokens with status not equal to active.

tools.name: gettransactionverbose

chain_id.description: Chain id to query (Moralis internal chain id).

tools.description: Returns the most recently indexed block number for the specified `chain`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for invalid credentials or insufficient access, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. 'eth', 'polygon', 'bsc').

tools.name: gettoperc20tokensbymarketcap
