Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for invalid credentials or insufficient access, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: gettoperc20tokensbypricemovers
tools.description: Lists ERC20 tokens with the largest price movements for the selected `timeframe`, returning either `gainers` or `losers`, and returns a paged result set controlled by `limit` with `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `direction` is not `gainers|losers`, `timeframe` is not one of `1h|24h|7d`, `limit` is out of range, or `cursor` is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if price-mover analytics are not available for the requested scope (Ethereum only). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for invalid credentials or insufficient access, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

direction.description: Whether to return top gainers or top losers.

timeframe.description: Time window used to compute price movement.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: gettopnftcollectionsbymarketcap
tools.description: Lists NFT collections ranked by current market cap (Ethereum only) and returns a paged result set controlled by `limit`, using `cursor` from a previous response to continue pagination; `order` controls ascending/descending ranking. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range, `order` is not `asc|desc`, or `cursor` is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the market-cap dataset is not available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for invalid credentials or insufficient access, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFT collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: gethottestnftcollectionsbytradingvolume
tools.description: Lists NFT collections ranked by trading volume for the specified `timeframe` (fixed to `24h`) and returns a paged result set controlled by `limit` with `cursor` pagination; `order` controls ascending/descending ranking. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `timeframe` is not `24h`, `limit` is out of range, `order` is not `asc|desc`, or `cursor` is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if 24h volume analytics are not available (Ethereum only). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for invalid credentials or insufficient access, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are exceeded.

timeframe.description: Trading volume window (fixed to 24h for this endpoint).

limit.description: Maximum number of NFT collections to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: gettopcryptocurrenciesbymarketcap
tools.description: Returns a paged ranking of cryptocurrencies scoped to an optional chain, sorted by market cap in the requested order and optionally filtered by minimum USD market cap, asset type(s), and spam exclusion; the response includes up to `limit` items and a `cursor` you can pass to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range, `min_market_cap_usd` is negative, `sort_order`/`asset_types` contain unsupported values, the `chain` key is not recognized, or the `cursor` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key lacks access to this product and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier to scope market cap rankings (use a chain key such as 'eth').

limit.description: Maximum number of cryptocurrencies to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

min_market_cap_usd.description: Filter out assets with market cap below this USD value.

asset_types.description: Asset types to include in the ranking.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude suspected spam assets.

tools.name: gettopcryptocurrenciesbytradingvolume
tools.description: Returns a paged ranking of cryptocurrencies scoped to an optional chain, sorted by 24h trading volume in the requested order and optionally filtered by minimum USD volume, asset type(s), and spam exclusion; the response includes up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range, `min_volume_usd` is negative, `window`/`sort_order`/`asset_types` contain unsupported values, the `chain` key is not recognized, or the `cursor` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key lacks access and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

chain.description: Chain identifier to scope volume rankings (use a chain key such as 'eth').

limit.description: Maximum number of cryptocurrencies to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

window.description: Time window for trading volume computation.

min_volume_usd.description: Filter out assets with 24h volume below this USD value.

asset_types.description: Asset types to include in the ranking.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude suspected spam assets.

tools.name: getdefisummary
tools.description: Returns a wallet-level DeFi summary for the given `address` and `chain`, including total USD value and active protocols, and includes unclaimed rewards when `include_rewards` is true and data is available (optionally excluding suspected spam assets from valuation). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address format is invalid for the selected chain or the chain key is not recognized. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

address.description: Wallet address to summarize (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chain.description: Chain identifier for the wallet query (use a chain key such as 'eth').

include_rewards.description: Whether to include unclaimed rewards in the response if available.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude suspected spam assets from valuations.

tools.name: getdefipositionsbyprotocol
tools.description: Returns detailed DeFi positions for the specified wallet, chain, and protocol identifier, optionally excluding suspected spam assets; results are paged with up to `limit` positions per page and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address format is invalid for the chain, the chain key is not recognized, `limit` is out of range, `cursor` is malformed, or `protocol` is empty/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the requested protocol is not supported on the given chain, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

address.description: Wallet address to query (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chain.description: Chain identifier for the wallet query (use a chain key such as 'eth').

protocol.description: Protocol identifier (slug/name) to fetch positions for.

limit.description: Maximum number of positions to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude suspected spam assets from the returned positions.

tools.name: getdefipositionssummary
tools.description: Returns a concise, protocol-aggregated overview of a wallet’s DeFi positions on the specified chain, optionally excluding suspected spam assets from the summaries. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address format is invalid for the selected chain or the chain key is not recognized. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

address.description: Wallet address to summarize positions for (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chain.description: Chain identifier for the wallet query (use a chain key such as 'eth').

exclude_spam.description: Whether to exclude suspected spam assets from the position summaries.

tools.name: getwalletactivechains
tools.description: Returns a paged list of chains where the wallet has indexed activity, including first-seen and last-seen timestamps, optionally restricted to the provided `chains` filter; responses return up to `limit` items and a `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address is invalid, any chain key in `chains` is not recognized, `limit` is out of range, or the `cursor` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

address.description: Wallet address to look up activity for (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chains.description: Optional list of chain identifiers (chain keys) to query cross-chain.

limit.description: Maximum number of active chains to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getwalletstats
tools.description: Returns key wallet statistics for the given `address` and `chain` (such as transaction counts and activity) and restricts calculations to the optional [`from_date`, `to_date`) window when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the address format is invalid for the chain, the chain key is not recognized, timestamps are not valid RFC3339 date-times, or `from_date` is after `to_date`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed plan quotas.

address.description: Wallet address to compute stats for (0x… for EVM, base58 for Solana).

chain.description: Chain identifier for the wallet query (use a chain key such as 'eth').

from_date.description: Start time (inclusive) for the activity window.

to_date.description: End time (exclusive) for the activity window.

tools.name: getnftcollectionstats
tools.description: Returns summary statistics for an NFT collection on the specified chain—such as total transfers, total tokens, and total owners—and when `token_id` is provided, scopes the stats to that specific item within the collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the chain key is not recognized, the collection `address` is not a valid EVM contract address, or `token_id` is not a valid identifier for the collection standard. Raises NOT_FOUND when the collection (or the requested token when `token_id` is provided) is not indexed for that chain, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier for the NFT collection (use a chain key such as 'eth').

address.description: NFT collection contract address (0x… for EVM).

token_id.description: Optional token id to scope stats to a specific NFT item within the collection.

tools.name: getnftfloorpricebycontract
tools.description: Returns the latest computed floor price for the specified NFT collection identified by `chain_id` and `contract_address_id`, refreshed approximately every 30 minutes, and includes stored collection metadata when `include_metadata` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain_id` or `contract_address_id` do not match the required `mor_chain_*` / `mor_addr_*` formats. Raises NOT_FOUND if the chain or contract address id does not exist or the collection has no floor-price coverage, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope the NFT collection (chains.id).

contract_address_id.description: Contract address id for the NFT collection (assets.contract_address_id / addresses.id).

include_metadata.description: Whether to include the stored asset metadata for the collection.

tools.name: getnfthistoricalfloorpricebycontract
tools.description: Returns a paged time-series of historical floor price points for the specified NFT collection (`chain_id`, `contract_address_id`) over the optional [`start_at`, `end_at`] window, bucketed by `interval`; each response returns up to `limit` points and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids don’t match required formats, `interval` is unsupported, `limit` is out of range, timestamps are invalid or `start_at` is after `end_at`, or the `cursor` is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the chain/contract id is unknown or the collection has no historical floor-price coverage, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope the NFT collection (chains.id).

contract_address_id.description: Contract address id for the NFT collection (assets.contract_address_id / addresses.id).

start_at.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the historical floor price window.

end_at.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for the historical floor price window.

interval.description: Time bucket interval for returned floor price points.

limit.description: Maximum number of time buckets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getfilteredtokens
tools.description: Returns a filtered, searchable list of tokens (native and/or ERC‑20) scoped by chain, lifecycle/spam status, and optional market metrics (liquidity, market cap, latest price), sorted by the requested field and direction; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any parameter is invalid (including chain_id format, enum values, limit out of range, or min_* greater than max_*), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the endpoint. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to filter tokens on a specific chain (chains.id).

q.description: Search query matched against token name/symbol.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort the token results.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getrisingliquiditytokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain whose liquidity has increased over the selected window, optionally filtering by minimum current liquidity and spam_status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain_id/window/limit are invalid or min_liquidity_usd is not a valid number, and raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced chain_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access is not allowed and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed quota.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope liquidity trends (chains.id).

window.description: Time window used to measure liquidity increase.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Minimum current liquidity (USD) required for inclusion.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getbuyingpressuretokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain with strong aggregated buy-side activity over the selected window, optionally requiring minimum USD value and/or minimum contributing transaction count; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when parameters are invalid (including chain_id format, window enum, negative thresholds, or limit out of range) and NOT_FOUND when chain_id is unknown. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope buying pressure computation (chains.id).

window.description: Time window used to aggregate swap/trade activity.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum aggregated USD value threshold for inclusion.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getsolidperformerstokens
tools.description: Returns tokens on the specified chain that meet “solid performer” criteria over the selected lookback window, with optional minimum liquidity/market-cap filters and sorting by the supported metrics; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain_id/window/sort options, out-of-range limit, or invalid numeric thresholds, and NOT_FOUND when the chain_id does not resolve to a known chain. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not authorized and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope performance metrics (chains.id).

min_market_cap_usd.description: Minimum market cap (USD) required for inclusion.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort the results.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getexperiencedbuyerstokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain that are being bought by experienced/high-volume buyers over the selected window, optionally filtering by minimum experienced-buyer USD value and minimum distinct buyer count; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any parameter is invalid (including chain_id format, window enum, negative thresholds, or limit out of range) and NOT_FOUND when chain_id is not recognized. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope experienced-buyer detection (chains.id).

window.description: Lookback window used to identify experienced buyer activity.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum aggregated USD buy value attributed to experienced buyers.

min_buyer_count.description: Minimum number of distinct experienced buyers.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getriskybetstokens
tools.description: Returns tokens on the specified chain flagged for higher-risk trading behavior over the chosen window, optionally requiring minimum liquidity and optionally including suspected-spam tokens; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain_id/window/limit, invalid min_liquidity_usd, or non-boolean include_suspected_spam, and NOT_FOUND when the chain_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope risk signals (chains.id).

window.description: Lookback window used to compute risk/volatility signals.

include_suspected_spam.description: Whether to include tokens marked as suspected spam.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getbluechiptokens
tools.description: Returns a curated list of established “blue-chip” tokens, optionally restricted to the provided chain IDs and sorted by the selected metric and direction; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor from the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any chain ID is malformed, sortBy/sortDirection are not supported, or limit is out of range, and NOT_FOUND when a provided chain ID does not correspond to a known chain. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort the blue-chip token list.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettopgainerstokens
tools.description: Lists tokens with the highest price gains over the requested lookback window (days), optionally scoped to specific chains and sortable by the supported fields; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor from the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when days is out of range, chain IDs are malformed, sortBy/sortDirection are invalid, or limit is out of range, and NOT_FOUND when a specified chain is unknown. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access is not allowed and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed quota.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute gainers.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank top gainers.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettoploserstokens
tools.description: List tokens with the largest price decreases over a period.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute losers.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank top losers.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: getdiscoverytoken
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific token, including metadata and stats. For more detailed tokens stats we recommended to use `getTokenAnalytics` or `getMultipleTokenAnalytics`. For pair stats, we recommend to use `getPairStats`.

chain.description: Chain ID the token belongs to.

token_address.description: ERC20 contract address for the token.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include token metadata (logo/metadata object) in the response.

tools.name: getwalletprofitabilitysummary
tools.description: Computes a wallet-level profit and loss summary for the given wallet_address on the specified chain over the last days, and returns aggregated realized/unrealized/total PnL and related totals for that window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain, wallet_address, or days are missing or do not match the required formats/ranges; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access this endpoint or chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID to compute profitability on.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to compute profit and loss for.

days.description: Lookback window in days to include trades/transfers in PnL computation.

tools.name: getwalletprofitability
tools.description: Returns a per-token profitability breakdown (optionally filtered to token_addresses) for the given wallet_address on the specified chain over the last days, sorted by sortBy/sortDirection, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, any address is not a valid 0x…40 hex string, days/limit are out of range, or sortBy/sortDirection are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key lacks access to profitability data for the requested chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID to compute profitability on.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to compute profit and loss for.

days.description: Lookback window in days to include trades/transfers in PnL computation.

token_addresses.description: Optional list of ERC20 token contract addresses to filter the breakdown to.

limit.description: Maximum number of token rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort the per-token profitability breakdown.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettopprofitablewalletpertoken
tools.description: Lists wallets ranked by profitability for trades involving token_address on the specified chain over the last days, sorted by sortBy/sortDirection, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain/token_address/days are missing or invalid, or when limit/sortBy/sortDirection are out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access this endpoint or chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID where the token is traded.

token_address.description: ERC20 contract address of the token to rank wallets for.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute wallet profitability for the token.

limit.description: Maximum number of wallets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank the most profitable wallets.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: searchtokens
tools.description: Searches tokens by query (contract address, pair address, name, or symbol) across all chains by default or restricted to the provided chains, returning a sorted result set and paging with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is empty, chains contain invalid chain IDs, or limit/sortBy/sortDirection are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot use token search or is not allowed for one of the requested chains; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

query.description: Search query (contract address, pair address, token name, or symbol).

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to filter results; cross-chain when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort token search results.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: searchentities
tools.description: Searches entity intelligence by q across entity names, labels, ENS names, and raw addresses, returning results grouped into entities, addresses, and categories, with each group limited by limit and pageable via cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when q is missing/empty, or when chainId/category/addressKind/limit are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

q.description: Free-text query to search across entity names, labels, ENS names, and raw addresses.

chainId.description: Optional chain scope for address-based matches.

addressKind.description: Optional filter for returned address results by kind.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per category array.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getentity
tools.description: Retrieves an entity by entityId and returns its metadata (name, logo, description, links) and, when includeAddresses is true, a paged list of related addresses controlled by limit and cursor. Raises NOT_FOUND when entityId does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR when entityId format is invalid or when limit/cursor are provided inconsistently with includeAddresses; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is restricted or request quotas are exceeded.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the entity to retrieve.

includeAddresses.description: Whether to include related addresses for the entity.

limit.description: Maximum number of related addresses to return (when includeAddresses is true).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for related addresses (when includeAddresses is true).

tools.name: getentitycategories
tools.description: Returns the list of supported entity categories and, when includeCounts is true, includes the number of entities in each category. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when includeCounts is not a boolean; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

includeCounts.description: Whether to include the number of entities per category.

tools.name: getentitiesbycategory
tools.description: Lists entities for the requested category, optionally filtered by status, sorted by sortBy and sortOrder, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when category/status/sortBy/sortOrder are invalid or limit is out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

sortBy.description: Field to sort entities by.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getpaircandlesticks
tools.description: Returns OHLCV candlesticks for the specified pairAddress on chainId for the given timeframe between from (inclusive) and to (exclusive), limited by limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chainId/timeframe are invalid, from/to are not RFC3339 timestamps, from is after to, or limit is out of range; raises NOT_FOUND when the pairAddress is unknown for the given chainId; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is restricted or request quotas are exceeded.

pairAddress.description: Pair contract address (or pair identifier) to retrieve candlesticks for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the pair belongs to.

timeframe.description: Candlestick interval.

from.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the candlestick range.

to.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the candlestick range.

limit.description: Maximum number of candlesticks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getpairstats
tools.description: Access key statistics for a token pair, such as price, buyers, sellers, liquidity, volume and more.

pairAddress.description: Pair contract address (or pair identifier) to retrieve stats for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the pair belongs to.

tools.name: gettokenpairs
tools.description: Lists DEX trading pairs for the given ERC20 token on the specified chain and returns a cursor-paginated collection of pair rows (up to `limit`) including pricing and liquidity/volume fields, ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`. Results are paged with the opaque `cursor` returned in the previous page; omit `cursor` to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `chainId`, `tokenAddress`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, or `cursor` are invalid; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access the chain or feature; NOT_FOUND when the token is not indexed on that chain; and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

tokenAddress.description: ERC20 token contract address to list trading pairs for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the token belongs to.

sortBy.description: Field to sort pairs by.

limit.description: Maximum number of pairs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getswapsbywalletaddress
tools.description: Lists swap events for a wallet on a given chain (optionally only those involving `tokenAddress`) and returns a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) sorted by block timestamp according to `sortOrder`. Results are paged using the opaque `cursor` from the response; omit `cursor` to fetch the first page, and use `from` (inclusive) / `to` (exclusive) to bound the time window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed addresses, invalid chain id, invalid date range (`from` after `to`), invalid `limit`/`cursor`, or unsupported `sortOrder`; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; NOT_FOUND when the wallet or token has no indexed activity on that chain; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to list swap transactions for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier to query swaps on.

tokenAddress.description: Optional token contract address to filter swaps involving a specific token.

from.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) to filter swaps by block timestamp.

to.description: End timestamp (exclusive) to filter swaps by block timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of swap events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getswapsbypairaddress
tools.description: Returns DEX events for the given `pairAddress` on `chain`, including swaps and (optionally filtered) liquidity add/remove events, as a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) ordered by block/time according to `order`. You may filter by block range (`fromBlock`/`toBlock`) and/or time range (`fromDate`/`toDate`); when provided, ranges must be coherent and are applied as inclusive bounds as documented. tools.name: getnftsaleprices

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

token_address.description: ERC20 token contract address to fetch swaps for.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getmultipletokenprices
tools.description: Returns the latest price (or the price at `to_block` when provided) for up to 100 ERC‑20 contracts on the given `chain`, quoted in the chain’s native currency and USD, and may enrich each result with the requested `include` fields (e.g., metadata, logo, liquidity, market) while optionally filtering illiquid assets via `exclude_low_liquidity`. The response is a single (non-paginated) array aligned to the submitted `tokens` list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain` is invalid, the `tokens` array is empty/over 100, a token entry is missing `token_address`, `to_block` is negative, or `include` contains unsupported values; raises NOT_FOUND when a token contract cannot be resolved on the specified chain (or the requested `exchange` source is unknown for that chain); raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate or plan quotas are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

to_block.description: Historical block number to price at (if omitted, returns latest).

exchange.description: DEX/exchange identifier to source the price from (if applicable).

include.description: Optional list of extra fields to include per token.

exclude_low_liquidity.description: Whether to exclude tokens below the service's liquidity threshold.

tools.name: gettokenowners
tools.description: Lists top owners for an ERC‑20 `token_address` on `chain`, returning balances and ownership percentages sorted by `order`, and optionally enriching each owner with known entities/labels when `include_entities` is true. Results are cursor-paginated using `limit` (max 500) and `cursor`, and may be filtered by `min_percentage` to only include owners at or above the given threshold. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid `chain`/`token_address`, invalid `order`, `limit` outside 1–500, `min_percentage` outside 0–100, or an invalid/expired `cursor`; raises NOT_FOUND if the token does not exist on the specified chain; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing or insufficient API credentials and RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED when rate or quota limits are exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of top owners to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

min_percentage.description: Minimum ownership percentage threshold to include an owner.

include_entities.description: Whether to enrich owners with known entities/labels.

tools.name: gettokenmetadata

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

chain.description: Chain identifier (EVM chain id as string or chain key).

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getnftcollectionstats
tools.description: Returns summary statistics for an NFT collection on the specified chain—such as total transfers, total tokens, and total owners—and when `token_id` is provided, scopes the stats to that specific item within the collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the chain key is not recognized, the collection `address` is not a valid EVM contract address, or `token_id` is not a valid identifier for the collection standard. Raises NOT_FOUND when the collection (or the requested token when `token_id` is provided) is not indexed for that chain, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain.description: Chain identifier for the NFT collection (use a chain key such as 'eth').

address.description: NFT collection contract address (0x… for EVM).

token_id.description: Optional token id to scope stats to a specific NFT item within the collection.

tools.name: getnftfloorpricebycontract
tools.description: Returns the latest computed floor price for the specified NFT collection identified by `chain_id` and `contract_address_id`, refreshed approximately every 30 minutes, and includes stored collection metadata when `include_metadata` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chain_id` or `contract_address_id` do not match the required `mor_chain_*` / `mor_addr_*` formats. Raises NOT_FOUND if the chain or contract address id does not exist or the collection has no floor-price coverage, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope the NFT collection (chains.id).

contract_address_id.description: Contract address id for the NFT collection (assets.contract_address_id / addresses.id).

include_metadata.description: Whether to include the stored asset metadata for the collection.

tools.name: getnfthistoricalfloorpricebycontract
tools.description: Returns a paged time-series of historical floor price points for the specified NFT collection (`chain_id`, `contract_address_id`) over the optional [`start_at`, `end_at`] window, bucketed by `interval`; each response returns up to `limit` points and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids don’t match required formats, `interval` is unsupported, `limit` is out of range, timestamps are invalid or `start_at` is after `end_at`, or the `cursor` is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the chain/contract id is unknown or the collection has no historical floor-price coverage, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED for access and quota enforcement.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope the NFT collection (chains.id).

contract_address_id.description: Contract address id for the NFT collection (assets.contract_address_id / addresses.id).

start_at.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the historical floor price window.

end_at.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for the historical floor price window.

interval.description: Time bucket interval for returned floor price points.

limit.description: Maximum number of time buckets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getfilteredtokens
tools.description: Returns a filtered, searchable list of tokens (native and/or ERC‑20) scoped by chain, lifecycle/spam status, and optional market metrics (liquidity, market cap, latest price), sorted by the requested field and direction; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor returned for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any parameter is invalid (including chain_id format, enum values, limit out of range, or min_* greater than max_*), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the endpoint. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to filter tokens on a specific chain (chains.id).

q.description: Search query matched against token name/symbol.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort the token results.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getrisingliquiditytokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain whose liquidity has increased over the selected window, optionally filtering by minimum current liquidity and spam_status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain_id/window/limit are invalid or min_liquidity_usd is not a valid number, and raises NOT_FOUND when the referenced chain_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access is not allowed and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed quota.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope liquidity trends (chains.id).

window.description: Time window used to measure liquidity increase.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Minimum current liquidity (USD) required for inclusion.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getbuyingpressuretokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain with strong aggregated buy-side activity over the selected window, optionally requiring minimum USD value and/or minimum contributing transaction count; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when parameters are invalid (including chain_id format, window enum, negative thresholds, or limit out of range) and NOT_FOUND when chain_id is unknown. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope buying pressure computation (chains.id).

window.description: Time window used to aggregate swap/trade activity.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum aggregated USD value threshold for inclusion.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getsolidperformerstokens
tools.description: Returns tokens on the specified chain that meet “solid performer” criteria over the selected lookback window, with optional minimum liquidity/market-cap filters and sorting by the supported metrics; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain_id/window/sort options, out-of-range limit, or invalid numeric thresholds, and NOT_FOUND when the chain_id does not resolve to a known chain. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not authorized and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope performance metrics (chains.id).

min_market_cap_usd.description: Minimum market cap (USD) required for inclusion.

sort_by.description: Field used to sort the results.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getexperiencedbuyerstokens
tools.description: Lists tokens on the specified chain that are being bought by experienced/high-volume buyers over the selected window, optionally filtering by minimum experienced-buyer USD value and minimum distinct buyer count; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any parameter is invalid (including chain_id format, window enum, negative thresholds, or limit out of range) and NOT_FOUND when chain_id is not recognized. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for access violations and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope experienced-buyer detection (chains.id).

window.description: Lookback window used to identify experienced buyer activity.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum aggregated USD buy value attributed to experienced buyers.

min_buyer_count.description: Minimum number of distinct experienced buyers.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getriskybetstokens
tools.description: Returns tokens on the specified chain flagged for higher-risk trading behavior over the chosen window, optionally requiring minimum liquidity and optionally including suspected-spam tokens; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain_id/window/limit, invalid min_liquidity_usd, or non-boolean include_suspected_spam, and NOT_FOUND when the chain_id does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain_id.description: Chain id to scope risk signals (chains.id).

window.description: Lookback window used to compute risk/volatility signals.

include_suspected_spam.description: Whether to include tokens marked as suspected spam.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tools.name: getbluechiptokens
tools.description: Returns a curated list of established “blue-chip” tokens, optionally restricted to the provided chain IDs and sorted by the selected metric and direction; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor from the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any chain ID is malformed, sortBy/sortDirection are not supported, or limit is out of range, and NOT_FOUND when a provided chain ID does not correspond to a known chain. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort the blue-chip token list.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettopgainerstokens
tools.description: Lists tokens with the highest price gains over the requested lookback window (days), optionally scoped to specific chains and sortable by the supported fields; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor from the response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when days is out of range, chain IDs are malformed, sortBy/sortDirection are invalid, or limit is out of range, and NOT_FOUND when a specified chain is unknown. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access is not allowed and RATE_LIMITED when you exceed quota.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute gainers.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank top gainers.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettoploserstokens
tools.description: List tokens with the largest price decreases over a period.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute losers.

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to scope results to.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank top losers.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: getdiscoverytoken
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific token, including metadata and stats. For more detailed tokens stats we recommended to use `getTokenAnalytics` or `getMultipleTokenAnalytics`. For pair stats, we recommend to use `getPairStats`.

chain.description: Chain ID the token belongs to.

token_address.description: ERC20 contract address for the token.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include token metadata (logo/metadata object) in the response.

tools.name: getwalletprofitabilitysummary
tools.description: Computes a wallet-level profit and loss summary for the given wallet_address on the specified chain over the last days, and returns aggregated realized/unrealized/total PnL and related totals for that window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain, wallet_address, or days are missing or do not match the required formats/ranges; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access this endpoint or chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID to compute profitability on.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to compute profit and loss for.

days.description: Lookback window in days to include trades/transfers in PnL computation.

tools.name: getwalletprofitability
tools.description: Returns a per-token profitability breakdown (optionally filtered to token_addresses) for the given wallet_address on the specified chain over the last days, sorted by sortBy/sortDirection, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, any address is not a valid 0x…40 hex string, days/limit are out of range, or sortBy/sortDirection are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key lacks access to profitability data for the requested chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID to compute profitability on.

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to compute profit and loss for.

days.description: Lookback window in days to include trades/transfers in PnL computation.

token_addresses.description: Optional list of ERC20 token contract addresses to filter the breakdown to.

limit.description: Maximum number of token rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort the per-token profitability breakdown.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: gettopprofitablewalletpertoken
tools.description: Lists wallets ranked by profitability for trades involving token_address on the specified chain over the last days, sorted by sortBy/sortDirection, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chain/token_address/days are missing or invalid, or when limit/sortBy/sortDirection are out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access this endpoint or chain; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

chain.description: Chain ID where the token is traded.

token_address.description: ERC20 contract address of the token to rank wallets for.

days.description: Lookback window in days used to compute wallet profitability for the token.

limit.description: Maximum number of wallets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to rank the most profitable wallets.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: searchtokens
tools.description: Searches tokens by query (contract address, pair address, name, or symbol) across all chains by default or restricted to the provided chains, returning a sorted result set and paging with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is empty, chains contain invalid chain IDs, or limit/sortBy/sortDirection are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot use token search or is not allowed for one of the requested chains; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

query.description: Search query (contract address, pair address, token name, or symbol).

chains.description: Optional list of chain IDs to filter results; cross-chain when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sortBy.description: Metric used to sort token search results.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for the selected sortBy metric.

tools.name: searchentities
tools.description: Searches entity intelligence by q across entity names, labels, ENS names, and raw addresses, returning results grouped into entities, addresses, and categories, with each group limited by limit and pageable via cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when q is missing/empty, or when chainId/category/addressKind/limit are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

q.description: Free-text query to search across entity names, labels, ENS names, and raw addresses.

chainId.description: Optional chain scope for address-based matches.

addressKind.description: Optional filter for returned address results by kind.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per category array.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getentity
tools.description: Retrieves an entity by entityId and returns its metadata (name, logo, description, links) and, when includeAddresses is true, a paged list of related addresses controlled by limit and cursor. Raises NOT_FOUND when entityId does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR when entityId format is invalid or when limit/cursor are provided inconsistently with includeAddresses; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is restricted or request quotas are exceeded.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the entity to retrieve.

includeAddresses.description: Whether to include related addresses for the entity.

limit.description: Maximum number of related addresses to return (when includeAddresses is true).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for related addresses (when includeAddresses is true).

tools.name: getentitycategories
tools.description: Returns the list of supported entity categories and, when includeCounts is true, includes the number of entities in each category. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when includeCounts is not a boolean; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

includeCounts.description: Whether to include the number of entities per category.

tools.name: getentitiesbycategory
tools.description: Lists entities for the requested category, optionally filtered by status, sorted by sortBy and sortOrder, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when category/status/sortBy/sortOrder are invalid or limit is out of range; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key is not permitted to access entity intelligence; raises RATE_LIMITED when you exceed your plan’s request limits.

sortBy.description: Field to sort entities by.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getpaircandlesticks
tools.description: Returns OHLCV candlesticks for the specified pairAddress on chainId for the given timeframe between from (inclusive) and to (exclusive), limited by limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when chainId/timeframe are invalid, from/to are not RFC3339 timestamps, from is after to, or limit is out of range; raises NOT_FOUND when the pairAddress is unknown for the given chainId; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or RATE_LIMITED when access is restricted or request quotas are exceeded.

pairAddress.description: Pair contract address (or pair identifier) to retrieve candlesticks for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the pair belongs to.

timeframe.description: Candlestick interval.

from.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for the candlestick range.

to.description: End timestamp (exclusive) for the candlestick range.

limit.description: Maximum number of candlesticks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getpairstats
tools.description: Access key statistics for a token pair, such as price, buyers, sellers, liquidity, volume and more.

pairAddress.description: Pair contract address (or pair identifier) to retrieve stats for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the pair belongs to.

tools.name: gettokenpairs
tools.description: Lists DEX trading pairs for the given ERC20 token on the specified chain and returns a cursor-paginated collection of pair rows (up to `limit`) including pricing and liquidity/volume fields, ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder`. Results are paged with the opaque `cursor` returned in the previous page; omit `cursor` to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `chainId`, `tokenAddress`, `limit`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, or `cursor` are invalid; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your API key cannot access the chain or feature; NOT_FOUND when the token is not indexed on that chain; and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

tokenAddress.description: ERC20 token contract address to list trading pairs for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier the token belongs to.

sortBy.description: Field to sort pairs by.

limit.description: Maximum number of pairs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getswapsbywalletaddress
tools.description: Lists swap events for a wallet on a given chain (optionally only those involving `tokenAddress`) and returns a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) sorted by block timestamp according to `sortOrder`. Results are paged using the opaque `cursor` from the response; omit `cursor` to fetch the first page, and use `from` (inclusive) / `to` (exclusive) to bound the time window. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed addresses, invalid chain id, invalid date range (`from` after `to`), invalid `limit`/`cursor`, or unsupported `sortOrder`; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; NOT_FOUND when the wallet or token has no indexed activity on that chain; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to list swap transactions for.

chainId.description: Chain identifier to query swaps on.

tokenAddress.description: Optional token contract address to filter swaps involving a specific token.

from.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) to filter swaps by block timestamp.

to.description: End timestamp (exclusive) to filter swaps by block timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of swap events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getswapsbypairaddress
tools.description: Returns DEX events for the given `pairAddress` on `chain`, including swaps and (optionally filtered) liquidity add/remove events, as a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) ordered by block/time according to `order`. You may filter by block range (`fromBlock`/`toBlock`) and/or time range (`fromDate`/`toDate`); when provided, ranges must be coherent and are applied as inclusive bounds as documented. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain, address, enum values, negative blocks, inconsistent ranges (e.g., `fromBlock` > `toBlock` or `fromDate` > `toDate`), or invalid pagination parameters; NOT_FOUND when the pair is not indexed on that chain; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key or numeric chain id as a string, e.g. 'eth', '0x1').

pairAddress.description: DEX pair contract address to fetch swaps/liquidity events for.

fromBlock.description: Start block number (inclusive) for filtering results.

toBlock.description: End block number (inclusive) for filtering results.

eventType.description: Filter returned rows by swap/liquidity event type.

order.description: Sort order by block/time, ascending or descending.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return per page.

tools.name: getsnipersbypairaddress
tools.description: Analyzes the specified DEX pair and returns a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) of wallets that bought within `blocksAfterCreation` blocks after pair creation, including buy totals and—when `includeSoldStats` is true and data is available—sell totals and PnL-related fields, ordered by `orderBy`/`order`. Pagination uses the opaque `cursor` returned in prior responses; omit `cursor` to start from the first page, and use `minBuyAmountUsd` to exclude wallets below the USD threshold. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain/pair address, non-positive `blocksAfterCreation`, invalid `minBuyAmountUsd`, unsupported ordering values, or invalid pagination; NOT_FOUND when the pair or its creation block cannot be resolved/indexed; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key or numeric chain id as a string, e.g. 'eth', '0x1').

pairAddress.description: DEX pair contract address to analyze for snipers.

blocksAfterCreation.description: Number of blocks after pair creation to consider buys as snipes.

minBuyAmountUsd.description: Minimum total buy volume in USD for a wallet to be included.

includeSoldStats.description: Whether to include sold amount and realized/estimated PnL fields when available.

orderBy.description: Field used to order sniper wallets.

order.description: Sort order for the ordering field.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of wallets to return per page.

tools.name: getvolumestatsbychain
tools.description: Returns aggregated volume, active-wallet, and transaction statistics for the requested `timeframe` across all supported chains in a single response (no pagination). Set `includeSolana` to include Solana in the cross-chain aggregation when supported for your plan. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported `timeframe` values or invalid parameters; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials or plan restrictions; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

timeframe.description: Time period over which to aggregate volume and activity.

includeSolana.description: Whether to include Solana in cross-chain results when supported.

tools.name: getvolumestatsbycategory
tools.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list (up to `limit`) of volume and activity statistics for the specified `chain`, grouped by entity/category for the requested `timeframe`, ordered by `orderBy`/`order`. Use the opaque `cursor` from a previous page to continue pagination; omit `cursor` to retrieve the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain id, unsupported `timeframe`/ordering values, invalid `limit`/`cursor`, or other parameter violations; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; NOT_FOUND when the chain is unknown or has no indexed category rollups for the timeframe; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier to filter results to a single chain (Moralis chain key or numeric chain id as a string).

timeframe.description: Time period over which to aggregate stats per category.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return per page.

orderBy.description: Field used to order category rows.

order.description: Sort order for the ordering field.

tools.name: gettimeseriesvolume
tools.description: Returns a time-series of aggregated volume, liquidity, and FDV for the specified `chain`, bucketed by `interval`, using either the provided `timeframe` lookback or a custom range (`fromDate`/`toDate`) when supplied. The response is a single array of points (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid chain, unsupported `interval`/`timeframe`, invalid timestamps, or an inconsistent custom range (`fromDate` after `toDate`); UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; NOT_FOUND when the chain is unknown or lacks indexed timeseries for the requested window; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain.description: Chain identifier to fetch timeseries for (Moralis chain key or numeric chain id as a string).

timeframe.description: Overall lookback window for the timeseries.

interval.description: Bucket size for the timeseries points.

tools.name: gettimeseriesvolumebycategory
tools.description: Returns a time-series of buy volume, sell volume, liquidity, and FDV for the specified `category`, optionally restricted to a single `chain`, bucketed by `interval`, using either the provided `timeframe` lookback or a custom range (`fromDate`/`toDate`) when supplied. The response is a single array of points (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported `category`, invalid chain, unsupported `interval`/`timeframe`, invalid timestamps, or an inconsistent custom range (`fromDate` after `toDate`); UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for missing/insufficient credentials; NOT_FOUND when the category (or category+chain filter) has no indexed timeseries for the requested window; and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

chain.description: Optional chain identifier to restrict category timeseries to a single chain.

timeframe.description: Overall lookback window for the timeseries.

interval.description: Bucket size for the timeseries points.

tools.name: gettimeseriestokenanalytics
tools.description: Fetch timeseries buy volume, sell volume, liquidity and FDV for multiple tokens. Accepts an array of up to 200 `tokens`, each requiring `chain` and `tokenAddress`.

tokens.description: Array of token descriptors to fetch timeseries analytics for (max 200).

chain.description: Chain identifier for the token (Moralis chain key or numeric chain id as a string).

timeframe.description: Overall lookback window for the timeseries.

interval.description: Bucket size for the timeseries points.

tools.name: gettrendingtokensv2
tools.description: List top tokens trending based on trading activity, volume, liquidity and more. By default this returns cross-chain results, including Solana. Optionally filter by `chain` for single chain results.

chain.description: Optional chain identifier to restrict trending results to a single chain; omit for cross-chain (may include Solana).

timeframe.description: Time period used to compute trending metrics.

limit.description: Maximum number of tokens to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

orderBy.description: Field used to order the trending list.

order.description: Sort order for the ordering field.

minLiquidityUsd.description: Minimum liquidity in USD for tokens to be included.

minVolumeUsd.description: Minimum volume in USD for tokens to be included.

tools.name: getmultipletokenanalytics
tools.description: Returns token analytics for up to 200 tokens per request, including buy/sell volume, buyers/sellers, transaction counts, liquidity, and FDV trends over the requested time range and timeframe, and responds with a page of results plus an opaque `cursor` when more results are available (use `limit`/`cursor` to paginate). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `tokens` is missing/empty, contains more than 200 entries, any entry is missing `chain`/`tokenAddress`, `tokenAddress` is not a valid EVM address, `timeframe` is not one of the supported values, `limit` is out of range, or `fromDate`/`toDate` are invalid or in the wrong order. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the API key is missing/invalid or the key is not permitted to access the requested chains, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tokens.description: List of tokens to fetch analytics for (max 200).

chain.description: Chain identifier to query (Moralis chain key, e.g. 'eth', 'polygon', 'bsc').

fromDate.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) for analytics time-series.

toDate.description: End of the time range (inclusive) for analytics time-series.

timeframe.description: Aggregation interval for trends over time.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

limit.description: Maximum number of token analytics rows to return per page.

tools.name: getchains
tools.description: Lists supported chains and their current indexing status. Returns a paginated list of chain records filtered by status and/or chain type. Refuses unsupported filter values and out-of-range pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of chains to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: getchain
tools.description: Returns a single chain record for the given Moralis chain key. Refuses an unknown chain key.

chain.description: Chain identifier (Moralis chain key, e.g. "eth", "polygon").

tools.name: parse_documents
tools.description: Submits a document to the MinerU conversion pipeline, creates a new conversion job, and returns the created job record (including its initial lifecycle state and any persisted source metadata such as filename, content type, size, and sha256 when provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if source_kind is not one of the allowed values, if required source details are missing/inconsistent for the chosen source_kind (e.g., url/local_path without a locator), or if requested_ocr_language is provided but does not match an existing ocr_languages.code; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to submit jobs; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if job submission limits are reached; raises CONFLICT if the request attempts to create a duplicate/incompatible job for the same sha256 according to server deduplication rules.

source_kind.description: Type of document source being submitted for conversion.

source_locator.description: Location of the source document (e.g., URL or local path); ignored for upload-based submissions.

original_filename.description: Original filename for the submitted document (useful for auditing and downstream naming).

content_type.description: MIME content type of the source document (e.g., application/pdf).

size_bytes.description: Size of the source document in bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source document for deduplication/integrity checks.

requested_ocr_language.description: Requested OCR language code (must exist in ocr_languages.code).

tools.name: get_ocr_languages
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of OCR languages known to the service (optionally filtered by is_enabled and/or engine_provider) along with a next-page cursor when more results are available; results are ordered by the requested sort and page size is controlled by limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is invalid, cursor is malformed/expired, sort is not supported, or engine_provider is not one of the allowed values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view the language catalog.

is_enabled.description: If provided, filters languages by enabled/disabled status.

engine_provider.description: If provided, filters languages by OCR engine provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of languages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: list_conversion_jobs
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of conversion jobs, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, source_kind, requested OCR language, and created_at range. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter is malformed (e.g., invalid status/source_kind), if limit is out of range, or if cursor is malformed/expired.

status.description: If provided, filters jobs by lifecycle status.

source_kind.description: If provided, filters jobs by source kind.

requested_ocr_language.description: If provided, filters jobs by requested OCR language code.

created_at_gte.description: If provided, filters to jobs created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_at_lte.description: If provided, filters to jobs created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: get_conversion_job
tools.description: Fetches a single conversion job by id and returns the persisted job record including lifecycle status and timestamps. Raises NOT_FOUND if no such job exists or is not visible to the caller.

tools.name: cancel_conversion_job
tools.description: Requests cancellation of a conversion job by id. If the job is in queued or running, transitions it to cancelled, sets finished_at, and returns the updated job record. If the job is already succeeded/failed/cancelled, returns the current record without changing state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for auditing.

tools.name: list_conversion_outputs
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of conversion outputs for a given job_id, optionally filtered by output_type and/or format. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid or cursor is malformed/expired.

job_id.description: Conversion job id whose outputs should be listed.

output_type.description: If provided, filters outputs by output type.

format.description: If provided, filters outputs by format (e.g., markdown, json, txt).

limit.description: Maximum number of outputs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tools.name: list_job_artifacts
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of artifacts produced for a given job_id, optionally filtered by artifact_type and/or page_number. Results are ordered by the requested sort and include a next-page cursor when more results are available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid or cursor is malformed/expired.

job_id.description: Conversion job id whose artifacts should be listed.

artifact_type.description: If provided, filters artifacts by type.

page_number.description: If provided, filters artifacts to a specific page number (1-based).

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.
