tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Creates a new table in the specified account and region with the requested key schema and billing mode, and returns the created table record (including its generated table_id and initial status/capacity settings). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if range_key_type is provided without range_key_name (or vice versa), or if PROVISIONED is selected without both read_capacity_units and write_capacity_units set to values >= 1. Raises CONFLICT if a table with the same name already exists for the same account/region, and raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to create tables for the account or the account is over its table quota.

table_name.description: Human-readable name for the new table.

account_id.description: Account identifier that owns the table.

region.description: Region in which to create the table.

range_key_type.description: Sort (range) key attribute type (required if range_key_name is set).

read_capacity_units.description: Provisioned read capacity units for the table (required for PROVISIONED).

write_capacity_units.description: Provisioned write capacity units for the table (required for PROVISIONED).

tools.name: update_capacity
tools.description: Updates provisioned throughput and/or billing mode for a table or a specific GSI and returns the updated target configuration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_id/index_id formats are invalid, if target_type is GSI without index_id, or if PROVISIONED is selected without read_capacity_units and write_capacity_units >= 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist or if target_type is GSI and the index_id is not found on that table; raises CONFLICT if the target is not in a state that allows capacity/billing changes; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify the table/index or exceeds capacity-update limits for the account.

table_id.description: ID of the table whose capacity should be updated.

target_type.description: Whether the capacity change targets the table or a GSI.

index_id.description: ID of the GSI to update (required when target_type is GSI).

billing_mode.description: Requested billing mode for the target.

read_capacity_units.description: Requested provisioned read capacity units (used for PROVISIONED).

write_capacity_units.description: Requested provisioned write capacity units (used for PROVISIONED).

requested_by.description: Identifier of the caller requesting the capacity change.

tools.name: put_item
tools.description: Inserts a new item or fully replaces the existing item with the same primary key in the specified table, and returns the stored item (including its key attributes). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the table_id is invalid, if pk/sk are not a single typed value (S/N/B), if sk is provided for a table without a sort key (or missing for a table that requires it), or if key types do not match the table schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the table is not in a writable state; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to write to the table or exceeds write throughput/quota.

table_id.description: ID of the table to write the item into.

pk.description: Primary partition key value for the item.

sk.description: Primary sort key value for the item (only for tables with a sort key).

attributes.description: Non-key attributes to store for the item.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Fetches a single item by its primary key from the specified table and returns the item if present, otherwise returns no item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the table_id is invalid, if pk/sk are not a single typed value (S/N/B), if sk is missing/provided inconsistently with the table key schema, or if provided key types do not match the table schema. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the table is not in a readable state; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the table or exceeds read throughput/quota (including when consistent_read is requested).

table_id.description: ID of the table to read from.

pk.description: Primary partition key value to fetch.

sk.description: Primary sort key value to fetch (only for tables with a sort key).

consistent_read.description: Whether to use a strongly consistent read.

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Queries items that match the partition key (and optional sort key condition) on the base table or the specified index, then applies the optional non-key attribute filter, returning up to limit items plus a next cursor when more results are available (pass cursor to continue). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key values/conditions are malformed (including BETWEEN requiring exactly two values), if types do not match the queried table/index key schema, if an index_id is provided but not usable for the requested key condition, or if limit is < 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist or if index_id is provided and not found on the table; raises CONFLICT if the table/index is not in a readable state or if consistent_read is requested where it is not supported; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to query the table/index or exceeds read throughput/quota.

table_id.description: ID of the table to query.

index_id.description: Optional index ID to query against instead of the base table.

pk.description: Partition key value to query (equality condition).

sk_condition.description: Optional sort key condition for the query.

operator.description: Operator used for the sort key condition.

value.description: Single sort key value used by EQ/LT/LE/GT/GE/BEGINS_WITH.

between.description: Two sort key values used by BETWEEN (low, high).

filter.description: Optional non-key attribute filters applied after key conditions (attribute -> exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue a previous query.

scan_index_forward.description: Whether to return results in ascending sort key order (false for descending).

consistent_read.description: Whether to use a strongly consistent read (not applicable to all index types).

tools.name: scan_table
tools.description: Scans items in the table, optionally applying the attribute filter, returning up to limit items plus a next cursor when more results are available (pass cursor to continue). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is < 1 or if the filter is not a valid attribute->exact-match map. Raises NOT_FOUND if the table_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the table is not in a readable state; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to scan the table or exceeds read throughput/quota.

table_id.description: ID of the table to scan.

filter.description: Optional attribute filters applied to scanned items (attribute -> exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue a previous scan.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns the full metadata for the specified table, including key schema, billing mode, provisioned throughput settings, and index configuration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if table_id does not match the expected format. Raises NOT_FOUND if no table exists for the given table_id; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the table.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists tables for the given account_id and returns a paged collection of table summaries ordered by creation/name as defined by the service, returning a next cursor when more results are available (pass cursor to continue). region.description: Optional region filter for returned tables.

status.description: Optional status filter for returned tables.

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue a previous list.

return_values.description: Controls whether to return no attributes, the updated item, or the prior item.

tools.name: upsert_entities
tools.description: Upserts a batch of entities into the knowledge graph and returns the created/updated entity records; entities are addressed by unique `name` and include `entityType`, `observations`, and optional `context`. If `update` is false, an item is created only when the name does not already exist; if `update` is true, an existing entity with that name is fully replaced. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided, and raises CONFLICT when `update` is false and an entity with the same name already exists.

observations.description: Facts or observations about the entity

context.description: Optional context or situation relevant to this entity (e.g., project, meeting, or scenario)

update.description: If true, will fully replace an existing entity; if false, will only create if entity doesn't exist

entities.description: Array of entities to create or update

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Creates a batch of directed relations (`from` → `to`) with a `relationType` and returns the created relation records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any relation is missing required fields/has empty strings or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when either endpoint entity name does not exist, and raises CONFLICT when an identical relation already exists.

from.description: Source entity name

to.description: Target entity name

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Appends new observation strings to existing entities and returns the updated entity records (or the observations added) for each input item. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `entityName`/`contents` are missing, empty, or include unknown fields, or if any observation is not a string. Raises NOT_FOUND when `entityName` does not match an existing entity.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to add observations to

contents.description: Observations to add to the entity

observations.description: Array of entity observations to add

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Deletes the specified entities and removes any relations associated with them, returning a summary of deletions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `entityNames` is missing, contains empty names, or includes unknown fields. Raises NOT_FOUND when any requested entity name does not exist.

entityNames.description: Array of entity names to delete

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description: Removes specific observation strings from the specified entities and returns the updated entity records (or a per-entity removal summary). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, unknown fields are provided, or observations are not strings. Raises NOT_FOUND when the entity does not exist, and raises NOT_FOUND when a specified observation is not present on that entity.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to remove observations from

observations.description: Observations to remove from the entity

deletions.description: Array of entity observations to delete

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Deletes a batch of relations identified by (`from`,`to`,`relationType`) and returns a summary of deletions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when a specified relation does not exist (including when `from`/`to` do not correspond to existing entities).

from.description: Source entity name

to.description: Target entity name

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Returns the complete knowledge graph, including all entities (with observations/context) and all relations; results are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if unexpected parameters are provided. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access to the graph is not permitted.

dummy.description: Placeholder parameter - this tool doesn't require parameters but returns the complete knowledge graph with entities and relationships

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Searches entities in the knowledge graph by the provided `query` string and returns the matching nodes; results are returned as a single set and are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access to the graph is not permitted.

query.description: Search query to find matching entities

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Fetches the specified entities by `names` and returns their full node records (including observations/context and any available relation info); results are returned as a single set and are not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `names` is missing, contains empty strings, or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when any requested name does not exist.

names.description: Array of entity names to retrieve

tools.name: update_relations
tools.description: Updates a batch of existing relations identified by (`from`,`to`,`relationType`) and returns the updated relation records. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or unknown fields are provided. Raises NOT_FOUND when a specified relation does not already exist (or when `from`/`to` do not correspond to existing entities), and raises CONFLICT when the requested update would duplicate an existing relation.

from.description: Source entity name

to.description: Target entity name

tools.name: memory_query
tools.description: Searches stored observations (memories) using optional filters (keyword text match, created-by agent, tag, and ISO-8601 time window via before/after) and returns up to `limit` matching observations. Results are returned as a single page limited by `limit` (no cursor-based pagination is supported on this endpoint). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter value is malformed (e.g., non-ISO dates) or unknown fields are provided, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to read memories.

keyword.description: Text to search for in observations

before.description: ISO date to filter observations before

after.description: ISO date to filter observations after

tag.description: Tag to filter observations by

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: think
tools.description: Appends a structured thinking entry to the Think Tank thinking log and returns the recorded entry; if `storeInMemory` is true, it also persists the thought as an observation optionally associated with `associateWithEntity`. This endpoint does not perform external research unless `allowResearch` is enabled and a `researchQuery` is provided, and it never modifies tasks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/too short or enums are invalid, NOT_FOUND when `associateWithEntity` refers to an entity that does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot write to the log or memory store.

structuredReasoning.description: A structured thought process to work through complex problems. Use this as a dedicated space for reasoning step-by-step.

associateWithEntity.description: Optional entity name to associate this thought with

tags.description: Optional tags to help categorize and find this thought later

storeInMemory.description: Whether to store this thought in the knowledge graph memory

context.description: Optional context or situation relevant to this thought (e.g., project, meeting, or scenario)

plannedSteps.description: The total number of steps planned for this thinking process

currentStep.description: The current step number in the thinking process

selfReflect.description: Whether to perform a self-reflection pass after generating the answer

allowResearch.description: Whether to allow research via external tools during the reasoning process

reflectPrompt.description: Custom prompt for the self-reflection stage

researchQuery.description: Optional research query to execute during the reasoning process

formatOutput.description: Whether to apply markdown formatting to the output

formatType.description: The type of formatting to apply

tools.name: plan_tasks
tools.description: Creates multiple tasks from the provided `tasks` array, generates server-side task IDs, stores `sourcePlanId` on each created task, and syncs the tasks to the knowledge graph; returns the list of newly created tasks with their assigned IDs. Tasks are created in a single request without pagination, and each task may optionally link to an existing entity via `entityId`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including invalid ULID formats or invalid `dueAt`), NOT_FOUND if any provided `entityId` does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not allowed to create tasks.

tasks.description: Array of tasks to create from a plan (IDs generated server-side).

details.description: Optional task details/notes.

sourcePlanId.description: External plan identifier to store on each created task.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks matching the optional filters (`status`, `priority`, `entityId`) and returns a paged result set ordered by `sortBy`/`sortOrder` up to `limit`. Pagination is cursor-based: pass the returned opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page until no further cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, malformed IDs, out-of-range limits, or unknown fields, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to list tasks.

entityId.description: Filter tasks by linked entity id (tt_ent_... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by.

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Selects the next available highest-priority task in `todo` status (optionally restricted to a specific `entityId`), transitions it to `in_progress`, and returns the updated task. If no eligible task exists, it returns NOT_FOUND. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed `entityId`, NOT_FOUND if the provided `entityId` does not exist, CONFLICT if the selected task cannot be transitioned to `in_progress` due to its current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks.

entityId.description: If provided, selects the next task only among tasks linked to this entity.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Marks the specified task as `completed` and returns the updated task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `taskId` is malformed, NOT_FOUND if no task exists for `taskId`, CONFLICT if the task cannot transition to `completed` from its current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to update tasks.

taskId.description: Task id to mark completed (tt_tsk_... ULID).

tools.name: update_tasks
tools.description: Applies updates to multiple tasks and returns the updated tasks after setting any provided fields (title, details, priority, status, dueAt, entityId). This endpoint performs a batch update in a single response without pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, invalid date-time values, or unknown fields, NOT_FOUND if any referenced task (or any newly linked `entityId`) does not exist, CONFLICT if a requested status change is not allowed from the task’s current status, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot update tasks.

tasks.description: Array of task updates to apply.

details.description: New task details/notes.

dueAt.description: New due date/time (ISO 8601), or null to clear.

entityId.description: New linked entity id (tt_ent_... ULID), or null to unlink.

tools.name: show_memory_path
tools.description: Returns the absolute path to the currently active Think Tank knowledge graph storage location. This endpoint is not paged and returns a single string value. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to view environment/storage configuration and VALIDATION_ERROR if unexpected fields are provided.

tools.name: exa_search
tools.description: Executes a web search via the Exa API for `query` with optional constraints (result count, search `type`, publish-date window, domain allow/deny lists, `category`, and `live_crawl`) and returns up to `num_results` results. Results are returned as a single page capped by `num_results` (no cursor-based pagination is supported on this endpoint) and the request/response are recorded for traceability and reuse. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums, out-of-range `num_results`, malformed dates, or unknown fields; AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if Exa access is not enabled for the caller; and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the Exa request budget/rate limit is exhausted.

query.description: The search query to execute

type.description: Search type: auto (default), keyword (exact matching), or neural (semantic search)

start_published_date.description: Filter results published after this date (ISO format)

end_published_date.description: Filter results published before this date (ISO format)

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains

live_crawl.description: When to use live crawling: 'always' or 'fallback' (when cached not available)

tools.name: exa_answer
tools.description: Ask a question and get a sourced answer via Exa /answer API.

question.description: The question to ask and get an answer with sources

max_citations.description: Maximum number of citations to include in the answer (1-10)

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Lists active entities in the knowledge graph with optional filtering and pagination. Returns entity records ordered by `updated_at` desc by default; refuses invalid filters and will not return deleted entities.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against `name` (and optionally `entityType` when `searchInEntityType=true`).

tools.name: create_entities

Raises CONFLICT if an entity cannot be created due to a backend uniqueness/consistency constraint in your workspace.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of the entity.

properties.description: Arbitrary structured properties for the entity.

confidence.description: Initial confidence score for the entity (typically 0.0-1.0).

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Creates multiple relations between existing entities and returns the created relation records (including their assigned mmt_rel_* ids, predicate, properties, and confidence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any relation is missing required fields, contains unknown fields, has an invalid id format, or provides an invalid confidence value/type; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced from_entity_id or to_entity_id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the relation cannot be created due to a backend consistency constraint.

relations.description: List of relations to create between entities.

properties.description: Arbitrary structured properties for the relation.

confidence.description: Initial confidence score for the relation (typically 0.0-1.0).

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Adds one or more observations to existing entities and returns the created observation records (including their assigned mmt_obs_* ids and stored fields such as content, source, observed_at, and confidence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any observation is missing required fields, contains unknown fields, uses an invalid entity_id format, or provides an invalid observed_at timestamp or confidence value/type; raises NOT_FOUND if any target entity_id does not exist (or is not visible to you). observations.description: List of observations to add to entities.

entity_id.description: Entity id the observation is attached to (mmt_ent_... ULID).

source.description: Source of the observation (e.g., URL, note, system, person).

observed_at.description: When the observation was observed (RFC3339 datetime).

confidence.description: Confidence score for this observation (typically 0.0-1.0).

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks for the account, optionally filtered by status, project/category membership, parent_task_id (subtasks), and due/scheduled/completed date ranges; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned as a page of tasks with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter has an invalid value or format (including invalid ULID prefix/pattern, invalid enum, invalid date-time, or limit out of range). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; does not raise NOT_FOUND for missing project/category/parent IDs and simply returns an empty list when nothing matches.

project_id.description: Filter tasks by project (categories.id) ULID.

category_id.description: Filter tasks by category (categories.id) ULID.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task (tasks.id) ULID (subtasks of this task).

due_before.description: Include tasks with due_date earlier than this ISO datetime.

due_after.description: Include tasks with due_date later than this ISO datetime.

scheduled_before.description: Include tasks with scheduled_for earlier than this ISO datetime.

scheduled_after.description: Include tasks with scheduled_for later than this ISO datetime.

completed_before.description: Include tasks with completed_at earlier than this ISO datetime.

completed_after.description: Include tasks with completed_at later than this ISO datetime.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Lists projects (categories with type="project") for the account, optionally filtered by status/archived and by parent_category_id; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned paged with up to limit items plus an opaque cursor for the next page when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, invalid ULID format for parent_category_id, or limit out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; missing parent_category_id does not raise NOT_FOUND and instead yields no matches.

archived.description: If provided, filter projects by archived flag.

parent_category_id.description: Filter projects by parent category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_categories

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid (enum/value mismatch, invalid ULID format, invalid limit). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; non-existent parent_category_id does not raise NOT_FOUND and simply returns an empty list.

archived.description: If provided, filter categories by archived flag.

parent_category_id.description: Filter categories by parent category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_due_items

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if now is not a valid ISO date-time, if IDs are not valid ULIDs, or if limit is out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; unknown project/category IDs do not raise NOT_FOUND and instead return no tasks.

now.description: Override the current time (ISO datetime) used to determine what is overdue (due_date < now).

project_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific project (categories.id) ULID.

category_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of due/overdue tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tools.name: get_child_tasks
tools.description: Lists the immediate children of a parent task or project, returning both child tasks and sub-projects/categories; when recursive=true, it returns descendants (depth-first/expanded) as a paged list with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when available.     Returns:
        A dictionary with the new access token or error information

tools.name: superset_auth_authenticate_user
tools.description:
Authenticate with Superset and get access token

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/security/login endpoint to authenticate and obtain an access token.
    If there's an existing token, will first try to check its validity.
    If invalid, will attempt to refresh token before falling back to re-authentication.

    Args:
        username: Superset username (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        password: Superset password (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        refresh: Whether to refresh the token if invalid (defaults to True)

    Returns:
        A dictionary with authentication status and access token or error information

tools.name: superset_dashboard_list
tools.description: Lists dashboards the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes the dashboards for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list dashboards, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of dashboards to return per page.

tools.name: superset_dashboard_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single dashboard by `dashboard_id` and returns the dashboard record as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible dashboard exists with that id.

tools.name: superset_dashboard_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset dashboard with `dashboard_title` and optional `json_metadata`, returning the created dashboard (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or `json_metadata` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create dashboards, and CONFLICT if Superset rejects the create due to a uniqueness/constraint violation (for example, a conflicting slug/title policy).

tools.name: superset_dashboard_update
tools.description: Updates an existing dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated dashboard as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the dashboard, NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint violation (for example, slug conflicts).

tools.name: superset_dashboard_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes the dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_chart_list
tools.description: Lists charts (slices) the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes charts for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list charts, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of charts to return per page.

tools.name: superset_chart_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single chart by `chart_id` and returns the chart record as provided by Superset, including visualization configuration fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the chart, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible chart exists with that id.

tools.name: superset_chart_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset chart using `slice_name`, `datasource_id`, `datasource_type`, `viz_type`, and `params`, returning the created chart (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing, `datasource_type` is unsupported, or `params` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create charts, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced datasource cannot be found or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_chart_update
tools.description: Updates an existing chart identified by `chart_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated chart as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the chart, NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint or incompatible state.

tools.name: superset_chart_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes the chart identified by `chart_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the chart, and NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_database_list
tools.description: Lists Superset database connections the current user can access and returns a paginated result set for the requested page/page_size, including each database’s basic metadata (for example id, name, and configuration summary where allowed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page or page_size are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Number of databases to return per page.

tools.name: superset_database_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single Superset database by database_id and returns the database record (including configuration fields that the caller is permitted to view). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if no database with that id exists or it is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to read database details.

tools.name: superset_database_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset database connection using the provided engine, configuration_method, database_name, and sqlalchemy_uri, and returns the created database object (including its assigned id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or the configuration_method/engine is unsupported, CONFLICT if a database with the same identifying properties already exists (as enforced by Superset), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: superset_database_get_tables
tools.description: Returns the list of tables visible in the specified database_id, including schema and table identifiers as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse tables for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate tables.

tools.name: superset_database_schemas
tools.description: Lists schemas available in the specified database_id and returns a collection of schema names from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse schemas for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate schemas.

tools.name: superset_database_test_connection
tools.description: Tests a set of database connection parameters (database_data, including sqlalchemy_uri and related options) and returns the connection test result from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_data is missing required fields or contains unsupported values, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to run connection tests, and BAD_REQUEST if Superset rejects the connection parameters or the database cannot be reached/authenticated.

tools.name: superset_database_update
tools.description: Updates an existing Superset database identified by database_id with the provided data fields and returns the updated database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid or the update payload contains invalid/unsupported fields, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the update would violate Superset constraints (for example duplicate naming/identifiers), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to edit the database.

tools.name: superset_database_delete
tools.description: Deletes the Superset database identified by database_id and returns the deletion result; this is permanent and may also remove dependent objects such as associated datasets as handled by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the database cannot be deleted due to existing dependencies or protected state enforced by Superset, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete databases.

tools.name: superset_database_get_catalogs
tools.description: Lists catalogs available in the specified database_id and returns a collection of catalog names for engines that support catalogs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse database metadata, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate catalogs.

tools.name: superset_database_get_connection
tools.description: Retrieves connection information for the specified database_id and returns the connection details that Superset allows the caller to view. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to view connection details (including cases where sensitive fields are restricted).

tools.name: superset_database_get_function_names
tools.description: Retrieves the list of SQL function names supported by the specified database and returns them as a list in a response object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance or the database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist.

tools.name: superset_database_get_related_objects
tools.description: Returns counts and references for charts and dashboards that depend on the specified database. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the Superset instance or database metadata, and NOT_FOUND if the database cannot be found.

tools.name: superset_database_validate_sql
tools.description: Validates the provided SQL string against the specified database and returns the validation outcome (including any error messages returned by Superset). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty/invalid or database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to validate SQL for that database, and NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist.

tools.name: superset_database_validate_parameters
tools.description: Validates the supplied database connection parameters without creating a database and returns the validation result from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters is missing or not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to validate connection parameters.

tools.name: superset_dataset_list
tools.description: Lists datasets the current user can view and returns a paged result set controlled by page (1-indexed) and page_size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page/page_size are not valid integers or are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance or dataset listing.

page_size.description: Number of datasets to return per page.

tools.name: superset_dataset_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single dataset, including available columns and metrics, and returns the dataset record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if dataset_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view the dataset, and NOT_FOUND if no dataset exists with that id.

tools.name: superset_dataset_create
tools.description: Creates a new dataset for the given database_id and table_name (optionally schema and owners) and returns the created dataset record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including owners not being an array of integers), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to create datasets or access the target database, NOT_FOUND if the referenced database does not exist, and CONFLICT if a dataset for the same database/table/schema already exists.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_execute_query
tools.description: Executes the provided SQL against the specified database via SQL Lab and returns the execution response (including identifiers needed to inspect results in subsequent calls). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty/invalid or database_id is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot execute queries on that database, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the Superset instance rejects execution due to configured limits.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_get_saved_queries
tools.description: Lists saved SQL Lab queries the current user can access and returns a paged result set controlled by page (1-indexed) and page_size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page/page_size are not valid integers or are out of range, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access saved queries.

page_size.description: Number of saved queries to return per page.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_format_sql
tools.description: Formats the provided SQL string using Superset’s formatter and returns the formatted SQL. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty or not a string, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance formatting endpoint.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_get_results
tools.description: Retrieves the results for a previously executed asynchronous SQL Lab query by its result key and returns the result payload (for example, columns/rows and related metadata) as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `key` is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access the query results, and NOT_FOUND if the result key does not exist or is no longer available.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_estimate_query_cost
tools.description: Estimates execution cost for a SQL statement against a given database (and optional schema) and returns the cost/size estimates Superset provides without running the query. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `database_id` or `sql` is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks access to the target database/schema, and NOT_FOUND if `database_id` does not refer to an accessible database.

tools.name: superset_sqllab_export_query_results
tools.description:
Export the results of a SQL query to CSV

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/sqllab/export/{client_id} endpoint to download
    query results in CSV format.

    Args:
        client_id: Client ID of the query

    Returns:
        A dictionary with the exported data or error information

tools.name: superset_sqllab_get_bootstrap_data
tools.description: Returns SQL Lab bootstrap/configuration data used by the SQL Lab UI, such as available databases and relevant settings, as provided by Superset. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available and FORBIDDEN if the current user is not permitted to access SQL Lab/its bootstrap endpoint.

tools.name: superset_saved_query_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches a single saved query by id and returns its saved query details (such as SQL text and associated database/schema metadata) as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_id` is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot read that saved query, and NOT_FOUND if no saved query exists with that id (or it is not accessible to the user).

tools.name: superset_saved_query_create
tools.description: Creates a new saved query in Superset from `query_data` and returns the created saved query record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_data` is missing required fields or fails Superset validation (for example invalid database/schema references), UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot create saved queries or lacks access to the referenced database, and NOT_FOUND if referenced resources (such as the database id) do not exist or are not accessible.

tools.name: superset_query_stop
tools.description: Stops (cancels) a running SQL query identified by `client_id` and returns Superset’s confirmation payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `client_id` is missing/empty, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user is not allowed to stop the target query, NOT_FOUND if the `client_id` does not match any known query, and CONFLICT if the query is already finished and cannot be stopped.

tools.name: superset_query_list
tools.description: Lists SQL query executions from Superset query history and returns a paginated result set; pagination is controlled by `page` (1-based) and `page_size`, and results can be filtered/sorted using `search`, `status`, `order_column`, and `order_direction`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination values or unsupported sort/filter values, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access query history.

page.description: Page number of results to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of queries to return per page.

order_column.description: Column name to sort by as supported by Superset query listing.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for the query list.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied by Superset to query history.

tools.name: superset_query_get_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single query execution by id and returns the full query execution record as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_id` is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view that query, and NOT_FOUND if the query id does not exist (or is not accessible).

tools.name: superset_activity_get_recent
tools.description: Returns the current user’s recent activity log as a paginated list; use `page` (1-based) and `page_size` to page through results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination values, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access recent activity.

page.description: Page number of recent activity items to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of recent activity items to return per page.

tools.name: superset_user_get_current
tools.description: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated Superset user, including identity and related account metadata Superset exposes. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available and FORBIDDEN if the Superset instance refuses access to the current-user endpoint for this account.

tools.name: superset_user_get_roles
tools.description: Returns the set of Superset roles assigned to the currently authenticated user by calling Superset’s /api/v1/me/roles/ and returning the role payload as provided by Superset. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when no valid Superset session/token is available and FORBIDDEN when the Superset account is not permitted to access its own role listing; may also raise UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset is unreachable or returns a non-success response.

tools.name: superset_tag_list
tools.description: Lists tags from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/ and returns the page of tag records along with Superset’s pagination metadata; results are paged with 1-based page and page_size and can be sorted and searched using the provided fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid (e.g., non-positive) or order_direction is not one of the allowed values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot list tags in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request (including invalid order_column/search syntax as enforced by Superset) or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tags to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tags to return per page.

order_column.description: Column name to sort tags by as supported by Superset.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for the tag list.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied by Superset to tags.

tools.name: superset_tag_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset tag via /api/v1/tag/ (POST) and returns the created tag record as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when name is missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create tags, and CONFLICT when Superset refuses the create due to a duplicate tag name or other uniqueness constraint. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures or connectivity issues.

tools.name: superset_tag_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches a single tag by id from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/{id} and returns the tag details as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tag_id is not a valid integer identifier, NOT_FOUND when no such tag exists in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot view tags. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset returns an unexpected error or is unreachable.

tools.name: superset_tag_objects
tools.description: Returns Superset’s grouped view of tagged objects from /api/v1/tag/get_objects/, optionally filtered by object_type, and returns a single page of groups with Superset’s pagination metadata (1-based page and page_size). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid or object_type is not one of the supported values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot read tag associations in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tagged object groups to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tagged object groups to return per page.

object_type.description: Restrict results to a specific object type.

tools.name: superset_tag_delete
tools.description: Deletes a tag in Superset via /api/v1/tag/{id} (DELETE) and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when tag_id is not valid, NOT_FOUND when the tag does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to delete tags. Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses deletion due to existing constraints or state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tools.name: superset_tag_object_add
tools.description: Associates an existing tag (by tag_name) to a Superset object identified by object_type and object_id, returning Superset’s response for the created association. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when object_type/object_id/tag_name are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the referenced object or tag cannot be resolved in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to edit tags on the target object. Raises CONFLICT when the association already exists or Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side errors.

tools.name: superset_tag_object_remove
tools.description: Removes the association between tag_name and the specified Superset object (object_type, object_id), returning Superset’s response for the removal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the object, tag, or the association does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot modify tags on the target object. Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tools.name: superset_explore_form_data_create
tools.description: Stores (or registers) Explore form_data via Superset’s /api/v1/explore/form_data (POST) and returns the generated key/descriptor that can be used to retrieve the same configuration later. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when form_data is missing or not an object, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot use Explore APIs in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the payload (e.g., invalid datasource/fields as enforced by Superset) or is unreachable.

tools.name: superset_explore_form_data_get
tools.description: Retrieves previously stored Explore form data from Superset’s /api/v1/explore/form_data/{key} and returns the saved configuration payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when key is missing/blank, NOT_FOUND when the key does not exist or has expired in Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access Explore form data. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset returns a non-success response or is unreachable.

tools.name: superset_explore_permalink_create
tools.description: Creates a Superset Explore permalink by posting the provided Explore state (including form_data) and returns the created permalink payload (including the generated key/URL details from Superset). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if state is missing or not an object, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to access Explore, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Superset rejects the state or returns an error response.

tools.name: superset_explore_permalink_get
tools.description: Retrieves a previously saved Explore permalink state for the given key and returns the stored exploration state as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the permalink key does not exist (or is not accessible to the current user), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to read the permalink.

tools.name: superset_menu_get
tools.description: Fetches the current user’s Superset navigation menu structure from Superset and returns the menu items/configuration computed from that user’s permissions. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid Superset authentication is available, FORBIDDEN if the authenticated user is not permitted to access menu metadata, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for non-success responses from Superset.

tools.name: superset_config_get_base_url
tools.description: Returns the configured base URL of the Superset instance this service is connected to. Raises NOT_CONFIGURED if no Superset base URL has been set for the current environment, and UNAUTHORIZED if access to integration configuration is restricted to authenticated callers.

tools.name: superset_advanced_data_type_convert
tools.description: Converts the provided value to the specified Superset advanced data type by calling Superset’s conversion endpoint and returns the converted representation from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if type_name is missing/empty or value is omitted, NOT_FOUND if the requested advanced data type is not recognized by Superset, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to use the endpoint.

tools.name: superset_advanced_data_type_list
tools.description: Lists the advanced data types supported by the connected Superset instance and returns their names/configuration; when refresh=true, bypasses any local cache and refetches from Superset, otherwise a cached result may be returned. This endpoint is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to read advanced data types, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if Superset returns an error response.

refresh.description: Whether to bypass any local cache and fetch the latest advanced data types from Superset.

tools.name: superset_instance_list
tools.description: Lists locally-configured Superset instances, optionally filtered by lifecycle `status`, returning a paged result set (1-indexed `page`/`page_size`) ordered deterministically (oldest created first). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to view configured instances.

page_size.description: Number of instances to return per page.

tools.name: superset_instance_update
tools.description: Updates a locally-configured Superset instance identified by `id` and returns the updated instance record. Supports lifecycle state changes via `status` (active/disabled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is invalid or payload is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if no instance exists with that id, and CONFLICT if enabling an instance violates server rules (e.g., multiple active instances when not supported).

base_url.description: Base URL of the Superset server (e.g., https://superset.example.com).

api_prefix.description: API prefix path for Superset (defaults to /api/v1).

verify_tls.description: Whether to verify TLS certificates when calling Superset.

default_timeout_ms.description: Default request timeout to Superset in milliseconds.

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the instance.

tools.name: superset_auth_session_create
tools.description: Creates (or reuses) a local auth session for a Superset instance and optionally authenticates immediately. Returns the stored auth session record (with tokens when authenticated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs, NOT_FOUND if `superset_instance_id` does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if Superset rejects the provided credentials.

superset_instance_id.description: Local Superset instance id to bind the session to.

username.description: Superset username to authenticate with. If omitted, an anonymous session is created.

password.description: Superset password to authenticate with (required when username is provided).

provider.description: Superset auth provider for /security/login (typically 'db').

tools.name: superset_auth_authenticate_user
tools.description:
Authenticate with Superset and get access token

    Makes a request to the /api/v1/security/login endpoint to authenticate and obtain an access token.
    If there's an existing token, will first try to check its validity.
    If invalid, will attempt to refresh token before falling back to re-authentication.

    Args:
        username: Superset username (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        password: Superset password (falls back to environment variable if not provided)
        refresh: Whether to refresh the token if invalid (defaults to True)

    Returns:
        A dictionary with authentication status and access token or error information

tools.name: superset_dashboard_list
tools.description: Lists dashboards the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes the dashboards for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list dashboards, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of dashboards to return per page.

tools.name: superset_dashboard_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single dashboard by `dashboard_id` and returns the dashboard record as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible dashboard exists with that id.

tools.name: superset_dashboard_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset dashboard with `dashboard_title` and optional `json_metadata`, returning the created dashboard (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or `json_metadata` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create dashboards, and CONFLICT if Superset rejects the create due to a uniqueness/constraint violation (for example, a conflicting slug/title policy).

tools.name: superset_dashboard_update
tools.description: Updates an existing dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated dashboard as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the dashboard, NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint violation (for example, slug conflicts).

tools.name: superset_dashboard_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes the dashboard identified by `dashboard_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `dashboard_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the dashboard, and NOT_FOUND if the dashboard does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_chart_list
tools.description: Lists charts (slices) the current authenticated Superset user can view and returns a paged result set using 1-indexed `page` and `page_size` (response includes charts for that page plus Superset pagination metadata). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page`/`page_size` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list charts, and RATE_LIMITED if Superset rejects the request due to quota/too many requests.

page_size.description: Number of charts to return per page.

tools.name: superset_chart_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single chart by `chart_id` and returns the chart record as provided by Superset, including visualization configuration fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is not a valid integer, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot view the chart, and NOT_FOUND if no accessible chart exists with that id.

tools.name: superset_chart_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset chart using `slice_name`, `datasource_id`, `datasource_type`, `viz_type`, and `params`, returning the created chart (including its id and Superset-provided fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any required field is missing, `datasource_type` is unsupported, or `params` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create charts, and NOT_FOUND if the referenced datasource cannot be found or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_chart_update
tools.description: Updates an existing chart identified by `chart_id` with the provided `data` payload and returns the updated chart as returned by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid or `data` is not an object, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user cannot edit the chart, NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible, and CONFLICT if the update is rejected due to a constraint or incompatible state.

tools.name: superset_chart_delete
tools.description: Permanently deletes the chart identified by `chart_id` and returns Superset’s deletion confirmation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `chart_id` is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if there is no valid Superset session/token, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete the chart, and NOT_FOUND if the chart does not exist or is not accessible.

tools.name: superset_database_list
tools.description: Lists Superset database connections the current user can access and returns a paginated result set for the requested page/page_size, including each database’s basic metadata (for example id, name, and configuration summary where allowed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page or page_size are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to list databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Number of databases to return per page.

tools.name: superset_database_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full details for a single Superset database by database_id and returns the database record (including configuration fields that the caller is permitted to view). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is not a positive integer, NOT_FOUND if no database with that id exists or it is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to read database details.

tools.name: superset_database_create
tools.description: Creates a new Superset database connection using the provided engine, configuration_method, database_name, and sqlalchemy_uri, and returns the created database object (including its assigned id). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid or the configuration_method/engine is unsupported, CONFLICT if a database with the same identifying properties already exists (as enforced by Superset), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to create databases, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

tools.name: superset_database_get_tables
tools.description: Returns the list of tables visible in the specified database_id, including schema and table identifiers as provided by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse tables for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate tables.

tools.name: superset_database_schemas
tools.description: Lists schemas available in the specified database_id and returns a collection of schema names from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to browse schemas for that database, and BAD_GATEWAY if Superset cannot reach the underlying database to enumerate schemas.

tools.name: superset_database_test_connection
tools.description: Tests a set of database connection parameters (database_data, including sqlalchemy_uri and related options) and returns the connection test result from Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_data is missing required fields or contains unsupported values, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to run connection tests, and BAD_REQUEST if Superset rejects the connection parameters or the database cannot be reached/authenticated.

tools.name: superset_database_update
tools.description: Updates an existing Superset database identified by database_id with the provided data fields and returns the updated database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid or the update payload contains invalid/unsupported fields, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the update would violate Superset constraints (for example duplicate naming/identifiers), UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to edit the database.

tools.name: superset_database_delete
tools.description: Deletes the Superset database identified by database_id and returns the deletion result; this is permanent and may also remove dependent objects such as associated datasets as handled by Superset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if database_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not visible to the caller, CONFLICT if the database cannot be deleted due to existing dependencies or protected state enforced by Superset, UNAUTHORIZED if the Superset session is missing/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the user lacks permission to delete databases.

tools.name: superset_database_get_catalogs

tools.name: superset_dataset_get_by_id

tools.name: superset_dataset_create
tools.description: Creates a new dataset for the given database_id and table_name (optionally schema and owners) and returns the created dataset record. tools.name: superset_sqllab_execute_query

tools.name: superset_sqllab_get_saved_queries
tools.description: Lists saved SQL Lab queries the current user can access and returns a paged result set controlled by page (1-indexed) and page_size. tools.name: superset_sqllab_format_sql
tools.description: Formats the provided SQL string using Superset’s formatter and returns the formatted SQL. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if sql is empty or not a string, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the Superset instance formatting endpoint.

tools.name: superset_saved_query_get_by_id

tools.name: superset_saved_query_create
tools.description: Creates a new saved query in Superset from `query_data` and returns the created saved query record. tools.name: superset_query_stop

tools.name: superset_query_list
tools.description: Lists SQL query executions from Superset query history and returns a paginated result set; pagination is controlled by `page` (1-based) and `page_size`, and results can be filtered/sorted using `search`, `status`, `order_column`, and `order_direction`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination values or unsupported sort/filter values, UNAUTHORIZED if no Superset session is available, and FORBIDDEN if the user cannot access query history.

page.description: Page number of results to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of queries to return per page.

tools.name: superset_query_get_by_id

tools.name: superset_activity_get_recent
tools.description: Returns the current user’s recent activity log as a paginated list; use `page` (1-based) and `page_size` to page through results. page.description: Page number of recent activity items to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of recent activity items to return per page.

tools.name: superset_user_get_current
tools.description: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated Superset user, including identity and related account metadata Superset exposes. tools.name: superset_user_get_roles

tools.name: superset_tag_list
tools.description: Lists tags from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/ and returns the page of tag records along with Superset’s pagination metadata; results are paged with 1-based page and page_size and can be sorted and searched using the provided fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid (e.g., non-positive) or order_direction is not one of the allowed values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot list tags in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request (including invalid order_column/search syntax as enforced by Superset) or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tags to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tags to return per page.

order_column.description: Column name to sort tags by as supported by Superset.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for the tag list.

search.description: Free-text search filter applied by Superset to tags.

tools.name: superset_tag_create

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when name is missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to create tags, and CONFLICT when Superset refuses the create due to a duplicate tag name or other uniqueness constraint. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures or connectivity issues.

tools.name: superset_tag_get_by_id
tools.description: Fetches a single tag by id from Superset’s /api/v1/tag/{id} and returns the tag details as provided by Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset returns an unexpected error or is unreachable.

tools.name: superset_tag_objects

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page/page_size are invalid or object_type is not one of the supported values, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot read tag associations in Superset. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the request or is unavailable.

page.description: Page number of tagged object groups to return (1-based).

page_size.description: Number of tagged object groups to return per page.

object_type.description: Restrict results to a specific object type.

tools.name: superset_tag_delete

Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses deletion due to existing constraints or state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tools.name: superset_tag_object_add
tools.description: Associates an existing tag (by tag_name) to a Superset object identified by object_type and object_id, returning Superset’s response for the created association. Raises CONFLICT when the association already exists or Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side errors.

tools.name: superset_tag_object_remove
tools.description: Removes the association between tag_name and the specified Superset object (object_type, object_id), returning Superset’s response for the removal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when inputs are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the object, tag, or the association does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot modify tags on the target object. Raises CONFLICT when Superset refuses the change due to object state, and UPSTREAM_ERROR for other Superset-side failures.

tools.name: superset_explore_form_data_create
tools.description: Stores (or registers) Explore form_data via Superset’s /api/v1/explore/form_data (POST) and returns the generated key/descriptor that can be used to retrieve the same configuration later. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Superset rejects the payload (e.g., invalid datasource/fields as enforced by Superset) or is unreachable.

tools.name: superset_explore_form_data_get

tools.name: superset_explore_permalink_create

tools.name: superset_explore_permalink_get

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if key is missing/empty, NOT_FOUND if the permalink key does not exist (or is not accessible to the current user), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the Superset session is not authenticated or lacks permission to read the permalink.

tools.name: superset_menu_get
tools.description: Fetches the current user’s Superset navigation menu structure from Superset and returns the menu items/configuration computed from that user’s permissions. tools.name: superset_config_get_base_url
tools.description: Returns the configured base URL of the Superset instance this service is connected to. Raises NOT_CONFIGURED if no Superset base URL has been set for the current environment, and UNAUTHORIZED if access to integration configuration is restricted to authenticated callers.

tools.name: superset_advanced_data_type_convert
tools.description: Converts the provided value to the specified Superset advanced data type by calling Superset’s conversion endpoint and returns the converted representation from Superset. page_size.description: Number of instances to return per page.

tools.name: superset_instance_update
tools.description: Updates a locally-configured Superset instance identified by `id` and returns the updated instance record. Supports lifecycle state changes via `status` (active/disabled). default_timeout_ms.description: Default request timeout to Superset in milliseconds.

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the instance.

tools.name: superset_auth_session_create
tools.description: Creates (or reuses) a local auth session for a Superset instance and optionally authenticates immediately. Returns the stored auth session record (with tokens when authenticated). superset_instance_id.description: Local Superset instance id to bind the session to.

username.description: Superset username to authenticate with. If omitted, an anonymous session is created.

password.description: Superset password to authenticate with (required when username is provided).

provider.description: Superset auth provider for /security/login (typically 'db').

refresh.description: If true, attempts token validation/refresh before falling back to login when a session already exists.

tools.name: superset_auth_session_update
tools.description: Updates a local auth session identified by `id`, including driving lifecycle transitions such as revoke (authenticated→revoked) or clearing error back to anonymous. revoke_remote.description: If true and supported by the Superset deployment, attempts to revoke the remote session/token before marking locally revoked.
